college_info.intro:
Tribhuvan Sahkari University is known for its MBA in Rural Management course. It is approved by AICTE and offers core courses such as Rural Finance, Microfinance, Rural Society & Polity, Marketing Management and Brand Management. The course helps students to assume challenging responsibilities in rural cooperatives and development organisations. The curriculum includes both theory and practical learning.
The university has a special segment called Village Field Segment (VFS) for the practical learning of the students. VFS provides students with a chance to understand the rural realities first-hand. The VFS segment also offers guidance on navigating rural society, markets, politics, institutional connections, and livelihoods from a team of mentors.

reviews.review_text: The whole hostel blocks were well furnished and equipped with mineral water plants and Wi-Fi, with individual rooms for each student of the whole batch. There is a presence of a good cafeteria, a mess, a students' sports activity centre, a good gym, and a dispensary.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities, faculty and placements are the best at this college.
reviews.review_text: IRMA has an excellent infrastructure for our course. The college has the best-quality facilities for students. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports, etc. facilities are available for the students at our college. The food available at the college canteen was good to eat. Students were getting multiple sports facilities. Hostel rooms were well furnished and properly maintained. The food in the mess was good to eat.

reviews.review_text: The classroom infrastructure here was good and well-maintained. Unlimited Wi-Fi was provided both in the classroom and hostel with good speed which I liked. Non-stop electricity was also provided. The infrastructure of the hostel was good. Food quality in the mess was something most people liked the least. It was average.

admission_process.title: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agriculture University offers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels. The university offers courses in Agricutlure, Science, Engineering, Arts, etc. CCSU admissions are based on entrance test scores of the candidates. The university accepts scores in JEE Main, CAT, CMAT, etc. for admission to specific courses.

Candidates have to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria, followed by the other selection rounds for admission in the university. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related to CCS course admissions 2025:

CCS HAU fees includes components such as Tuition Fees, Admission Fees, etc. Candidates have to pay for a certain amount of fees at the time of admission. The below table mentions the CCS HAU fees for various UG & PG courses:

CCS HAU offers PG courses via its campus and various affiliated colleges. CCS HAU seats differs for both on-campus and affiliated colleges. Check below the seat bifurcation for various courses offered at CCS HAU:
CCSU admissions are entrance-based for most of the courses. Check below the complete admission process:
Step 1: CCS HAU Application Process 2025

The admission process at CCS HAU starts with the application stage. Prospective candidates can download the application form from the university's official website. Once duly filled, the application form must be submitted either through post or in person at the relevant department. The application and entrance test fees are to be paid online, with the pay slip attached along with two copies of the online bank challan.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to various programmes at CCS HAU follows different selection criteria. For MBA/PGDM programmes, candidates require a graduation degree with 55% and a valid score in CAT/CMAT, along with recommendations from ICAR. BE/BTech programmes require a minimum of 45-50% in Class 12 and qualify in JEE Main/ICAR AIEEA/HSTES. For BSc courses, a minimum of 50% in Class 12 and qualifying in ICAR AIEEA/CCSHAU entrance exam are required. Similarly, different criteria apply for other programmes like MSc, ME/MTech, and BDS.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

Following the completion of selection rounds, candidates proceed to the counselling process for their respective courses. Subsequently, CCS HAU releases the merit list in multiple rounds, listing the selected candidates. Those whose names appear on the merit list must pay a stipulated fee to secure their seat.

hostel.description: Hostel Facilities Accommodation is provided in 14 hostels of the University out of which 12 hostels (8 for Male 3 for Female and 1 for married PG students) are situated at Hisar campus. All the modern facilities such as gas connection, furniture, TV with cable connection, leading News Papers and Magazine and solar water heating system are provided. All the hostels have EPABX phone facilities as well as in- coming calls facilities. Each hostel has been provided water cooler with aqua guard for safe drinking water. The messes of hostels are running on cooperative basis.

More than 150 CDs of Biological Abstracts, CABI, AGRICOLA, AGRIS, National Sample Survey, Indian Science Abstracts, and Encyclopedia Britannica form the back bone of CD-ROM database - based information services. In addition, there are more than 2000 CDs of books and dissertations. Videoconferencing facility, Multimedia library, Internet Lab, more than 2072 e-journals are the other feathers in the cap of library services.

BTech graduates can also start their own businesses or work as freelancers. SRM Chennai Kattankulathur also offers the BTech programme in combination many other major degrees or specialisations, including Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, etc. The university provides students with the opportunity to pursue the BTech programme in any of the majors along with a minor, specialisation or both.

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates cannot join SRM without entrance exam. The selection for MBA course is based on CAT/MAT/CMAT/NMAT/GMAT/SAT score. Candidates who have not qualified any of the accepted entrance exam can appear for SRMJEEM.Shortlisted aspirants need to pass PI round conducted by the university. faqs.answer: A:    SRM Institute of Science and Technology admission is entrance-based for most of the courses. The Institute accepts national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, TANCET, NATA, SRMJEEE, SRMJEEM etc. for admission to MBA, BArch, BTech, M.Tech and other courses. Offering more than 80 courses and providing an annual intake of 52 K+, SRM IST offers admission based on the counselling through SRMJEEE e-counselling. To conclude, it is not very difficult to seek admission at SRM IST.
faqs.question: Is SRM IST hard to get?

faqs.answer: A:    No, SRM IST does not accept CUET score for admission to any of its UG & PG courses. The university conducts its in-house entrance exam for BTech and MTech, i.e., SRM JEE. Further, for admission to MBA course, the university accepts scores of national-level entrance exams such as GMAT, CAT, MAT, TANCE, etc. SRM University also offers direct admission to courses such as BA, MSc, etc., based on the merit of last qualifying exams of previous education.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best and excellent college.

content.Placements: 70 percent of students got internship. 85 percent of students got placed. The top recruiting companies are Accenture, Google, and Microsoft. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA. The top roles are project manager and software developer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good in our college. The classrooms are neat and clean with comfortable benches. The washrooms are neat and clean. The labs are good. The books are available in the library. We have good Wi-Fi connection. The hostel facilities are good, and canteen is also available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college is asia number one of tamilnadu.

content.Placements: 90 above and average package and recruitment process and global and IT value to improve ourselves and prepare for the course. The package level is based on experience and knowledge, companies only give higher level monthly salaries to those who are capable of working in the company. Many companies are offered in my college.
content.Infrastructure: Food is available in the hostel and is strictly maintained. Students have fixed discipline and are given time for breaks in the main canteen. There are many canteens in the college for food, and temples are also present on the campus, as it is a big college in Tamil Nadu SRM campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: About good and enjoyable college.

content.Placements: From 7th semester, students become eligible for campus placements. Top companies are Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HUL, HCL, and so on. I got an offer in 2 companies, Infosys and Base Automation Technologies. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the average package is 3 LPA to 5 LPA. 90% of people are easily getting placed, and have plans after getting the placements to work.
content.Infrastructure: The main thing I would like to mention here is library, over 4 lakhs books are placed in the library including IAS, IFS, IPS, central and state government aspirants can also use it. The gym is overall good. Campus timing is 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, depending on the day of the order and departments. Security is very strict here so students can't do any unnecessary activities inside the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great campus life, Bad ROI.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed is very vague as a lot of students just opt out of placement because of their CGPA and they are not considered for placement. If you are an average student you can get around 6 to 7 LPA if you maintain your CGPA. Companies like Wipro and L&T are the top recruiters. Internship you have to secure at your college gives you almost zero support there.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and Classrooms are actually pretty good if you opt for CSE as the new building TP 2 is highly advanced. Library is also pretty good with a nighttime study facility. Hostels are expensive and the hostel staff is pretty annoying. You have an appointment at 9 o clock so beware of that.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college to study in, and we can choose it without any confusion.

content.Placements: The placement rate is about 70% or above. Students are placed mainly in fields such as digital marketing and IT. Eligibility for placements is generally 75% or above with no arrears.
content.Infrastructure: The college has very good infrastructure. It includes classrooms, labs, and a library. Hostel is very clean. Food provided is good for consumption. The college is very supportive of sports. They gives extra care to sports activities..
content.Faculty: Teachers are very good at teaching and help students score good marks. The pass percentage requirement is above 35%. As a student at SRM, teachers help prepare students for the industry, as they are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Teachers also train students for campus placements and examinations. Teachers teach every topic clearly, which helps students score well in semester examinations. They also regularly train students for internships.

hostel_campus.college_name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: SRM University has 14 blocks for boys and 7 blocks for girls. All the hostels have hi speed Wi-Fi connectivity and are provided with solar water have heating systems, mineral water supply, water cooler in each floor, generator power supply.Students are offered with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates and can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food for the benefit of our international students,.Rooms with single cot ,study table & chair, cupboard & common mirror are available. Most hostels have common washrooms, a few blocks are available with attached bath and AC rooms too. Facilities such as gym, prayer halls, games, sports and cultural activities has been facilitated. 3 International hostels with modernized kitchen,library,drinking water, water heater, telephone,power supply, medical care, recreation,stationery shop, laundry point, gym, playground, indoor games, banking facility, a/c dining hall, a/c study hall and one off campus international hostel is also available.
facilities: College Infrastructure: SRM has a well-defined layout in terms of infrastructure. The campus is spread over a large area, with all the basic facilities provided. There are huge grounds and indoor courts for sports; the gymnasium is made for the students of the college. The library is technically advanced and has a good collection of books. The classrooms are well maintained with smart boards installed, and the washrooms are clean. The canteen has diverse varieties of food that are hygienic and affordable.

Academics: CSE has proven to be a good course for me as it aligns with my interests and liking for computers and programming. The course is well updated, and even the curricula followed in college fall in line with the skills required in the job sector. The course has a lot of research and practicality, which definitely makes one job-ready. The teachers are cooperative and experienced, and they mentor each student at every point.

Placements: Approximately 70% of the students get hired in the recruitment drive held by the college. The placement drive is held in the most efficient manner. The average package is around 5 LPA, which is a good kickstart for any student in their respective fields. The college has a placement cell that is responsible for inviting firms to the college and guiding fellow students in getting placed, hence making the college supportive. The placements must be inclusive of all the courses, which is a demerit.

Value-for-money: The annual tuition fee structure was a bit on the expensive side, as my yearly fee was around 3 lacs p/a, which might not be affordable for many students. But the quality of services and education, with all the basic amenities, make SRM worth the investment. Personally, SRM is making each penny count.

Campus Life: Though the college is isolated from the main part of the city, it is glorious from the inside. There are sports activities in the college and many cultural societies, like dance and music societies. Moreover, there are various clubs that keep on participating in educational competitions. Various seminars are held and several festivals are conducted throughout the year, making college life happen. There's a medical room to handle any emergency as and when it arises!

library.description: The university library is fully air conditioned 15 storey building comprises a rich collection of books covering various branches of Engineering and Technology, Medical and Health Sciences and Science and Humanities. The library has stocked 140518 volumes of books consisting of 61289 titles. The collection also includes 1550 handbooks & 200 encyclopedias. Back volume is about 4105.  8235 above project thesis. 781 standards which include BIS, ISA & IEEE. NIT Trichy popular programmes are BTech and MTech. BTech is given in nine specialisations for a four-year duration spread over eight semesters. NIT Trichy BTech in Computer Science and Engineering students can look for career opportunities and can become Computer Engineers, Testing Engineers, Multimedia programmers, Full Stack Developers, and others. After doing a BTech in Civil Engineering, students will gain the ability to implement infrastructure development by using various sustainable technologies and materials.
NIT Trichy's MTech programme is a two-year postgraduate programme given in 23 specialisations. Some of the specialisations in which MTech is taught are Geotechnical Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, VLSI Systems, and others. NIT Trichy is ranked 9th under the Engineering category. course_faqs.question: Is it expensive to study MBA at NIT Trichy?
course_faqs.answer: The institute and hostel fees for the Open, Open-EWS, OBC-NCL, and EWS category is INR 4.35 Lacs (approximately). In addition, the institute and hostel fee for SC/ST category candidates is INR 3 Lacs (approximately. This fee is as per NIT Trichy MBA 2023 brochure. The tuition fee for a two-year MBA course at NIT Trichy is INR 1.4 Lacs as per unofficial sources.

course_faqs.question: Is MBA available in NIT Trichy?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Trichy offers a two-year MBA course via the Department of Management Studies. The DoMS-NIT Trichy is funded by the Ministry of HRD. Eligible candidates can visit the official website of NIT Trichy (nitt.edu) and fill an online application form along with submitting the relevant documents to apply. The Management degree course is available in seven specialisations, including Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, etc. Click here to find the details around NIT Trichy MBA course.

course_faqs.question: How is DoMS-NIT Trichy for MBA?
course_faqs.answer: NIT Trichy offers a full-time two-year MBA course via its Department of Management Studies. NIT Trichy is the only institute among other NITs, which is funded by the Ministry of HRD. As per observing the ranking trends for the Management category course offered at NIT Trichy, it was 39 in the year 2022, whereas it improved in the year 2023 and ranked 35 by NIRF. Further, the placement rate for MBA went up to 96.8% in the year 2022. Overall, DoMS NIT Trichy is a decent choice for pursuing MBA.

overview_faqs.question: How is the MCA programme at NIT, Trichy?
overview_faqs.answer: At the postgraduate level, NIT Trichy provides two-year MTech, MBA, MCA, and various other courses to students. The MCA program at NIT, Trichy is good. NIT Tiruchirappalli is ranked 701-710 by QS World University Rankings 2025. It is one of the top-ranked universities present in India. MCA students get great placement opportunities in top companies like Google, Infosys, Facebook, Oracle, and others. The university infrastructure is also very good. For MCA admission, candidates must qualify for the NIMCET, and for that, candidates must study according to the the NIMCET exam pattern.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Trichy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, but a bad climate in the summer. There are exceptional peers.

content.Placements: I'm not sure about the percentage of students who got internships or placements. I suggest that students just check it out on the college website. It is legitimate. But to be frank, the packages offered in core, as I know, in production are very few. But this branch is special in offering the connection between management and technical fields. Excellent packages and placements are available in non-core fields, especially consulting and management. The branch is a chill one, which offers ample time for studying anything or extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The library facility, octagon, or if I say anything in the college, is just on a different level, except for hostels. Being a college affiliated with NIRF 9, we expect much better from their side in hostel management. There is no responsibility on their part if a theft happens. Actually, two laptops were stolen. The library must have a proper internet connection, which is bad. The hostel is improving right now with proper renovation after our complaints. It serves very good mess food. I'll say much better than any college. Since I've been in some.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.

content.Placements: There is an 80 percent placement rate in B.Tech civil engineering. The lowest package offered is 3 LPA, and the highest package offered is 33 LPA. For tech fields, companies like Microsoft and Google, and for core companies like Dalmia, ACC Cement, L&T, etc., hire students. Internships are not very common in this branch, so we have to fight a bit more compared to other branches.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

content.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.

content.Placements: CSE / IT placements are around 95–100%, while the overall placement percentage at NIT Trichy is above 90%. The highest package offered is 45–55 LPA from international and top product companies, the average package is 25–30 LPA, and the lowest package is 6–8 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, and the major roles offered are Software Development Engineer (SDE), Backend / Full-Stack Developer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

faqs.question: Is JEE Main required for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Admissions to NIT (National Institute of Technology), Trichy is Entrance Based for almost all of the courses. The college accepts different exam scores for different levels of courses. Admissions are based on the marks scored in class 12thor equivalent as well as the JEE (Main) examination. Seats are allocated to students through Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA), Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB) and the Direct Admission of Students Abroad (DASA).

We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quali...

reviews.review_heading: It is a fine college if you take higher branches like ECE, CS, EEE, mechanical, and chemical.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and experience in NIT Trichy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classes for all department students occur in academic blocks like Orion and Logos, but we suffer in summer due to the high temperature of Trichy. I give 3/5 for the food because the taste does not seem good, and the varieties are also repeated. You can find many canteens, and you can also find Domino’s and CCD. The ...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure but disappointing in some aspects.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice. Hostels are not that much good as their NIRF is 9 but not too bad, it's okay to have such a hostel. College infrastructure is very nice. Library is also good. Food is not good in the first year but for North and South people they have different messes in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is right in its place. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel rooms with routers in each room. Labs are there in every department, and classrooms will be happening in Orion. The library is present with well-structured and department-wise sections. Every day, the hostel is cleaned by workers and is maintained very hygienically. For food, we have Annapurna mess, Mega mess, and Sabari mess. The quality of food varies from mess to mess, and overall quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for this course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in the room include a table, chair, almirah and a bed. The mess food is okay, not so good, but one will get used to it. If we talk about the books and journals available in the library, they are easily accessible to all the students and professors. The classrooms have high-quality projectors and speakers, and teachers use a microphone to deliver their lectures. There are a lot of sports available on campus, and everyone can play any sport they want to play.

reviews.review_heading: If you want, then you can join, but you have to score well on the GATE entrance.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are decent, I think. In the first year, there are 3 people in a single room, while the room can hold three people, the cupboards provided are for only two people. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Labs are good. The library is good, it has all types of books. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. There is also a swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good location, good IIT.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good, like every other college. Cleanliness is a factor that the hostels possess. Sports and extracurricular activities are good in college. But unlike many IITs, they won't offer coaches to the respective college teams. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and all types of books are available.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.

reviews.review_heading: I like my institute so much for the best environment.
reviews.review_text: The buildings of my institute, that is NIT Trichy, are so good and well structured, and the most important thing is that the greenery here is so good. The hostel is well-furnished and also provides Wi-Fi facilities, and the mess food is not that bad to eat.

faqs.answer: A:    The main details regarding entrance exam scores that Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS) accepts for MBA admission are as follows: SIMATS grants admission to MBA programs based on the results of standardized management entrance tests such as CAT, MAT, XAT, ATMA, and CMAT. The necessary percentile scores at a minimum are: 50 percentile of the CAT 60 percentile in MAT 60 percentile in XAT ATMA - 60% of the sample CMAT - 60% of the sample Those who pass any of these admission tests with a valid score can apply to SIMATS' MBA program. A bachelor's degree from an accredited university with a minimum of 50% overall grades is required of applicants in addition to their entrance exam results. Depending on the volume of applications, the exact deadlines for receiving an admission offer may change every year.

overview_faqs.question: Does Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences refund fees?
overview_faqs.answer: Several salient features of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences' return policy are: The majority of the institute's programs, including MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, and others, have clear return policies. After deducting administrative fees, funds are reimbursed to students who opt to withdraw their acceptance prior to the final day of admission. Usually, 1-2 weeks after classes begin, the deadline for admissions is reached. The following guidelines will apply to refunds in the event that a student departs after the final admissions date: Refundable 75% of fees if departure occurs within 30 days before the deadline (registration expenses excluded). Refundable 50% of fees if departure occurs within 30 to 90 days. If you depart after the final admittance date, you won't get a refund. A refund application must be completed.

overview_faqs.question: Is Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences a good college for MBA?
overview_faqs.answer: The main focus of SIMATS is its engineering, dental, and medical programs. The MBA programme is not as well-known or reputable as its other programs, despite that fact. Following are the points you can keep in mind before admission to MBA at SIMATS. AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) has granted SIMATS accreditation, and the university Saveetha is associated with it. Nevertheless, it lacks international accreditations that MBA candidates frequently pursue, like as AACSB or EQUIS. Rankings: According to well-known journals like Business Today, The Week, and Economic Times, SIMATS does not rank among the best MBA programs in India.SIMATS might offer a respectable MBA education, but if you're searching for a top MBA programme with good placement rates, strong industry contacts, and a global reputation, it might not be the ideal option.

reviews.review_heading: My college is awesome and done your admission for 2025 shine your life and knowledge in academics.

Wi-Fi facility and a library with a wide range of standard books are also available. Our college hostel offers many facilities, like good food served three times per day in a full hygienic way. There is a separate canteen for each department, and medical facilities are available for students. Many sports and game competitions are...

reviews.review_heading: A good college can be recommended but can improve in some things.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The classes are good. The hostel needs some improvement and the canteen foods are so good that they are just like in restaurants but a little high cost. The library is good but can keep the books that can be taken and read by the students but the books are locked in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and high placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college has one of the best infrastructures. Every classroom is provided with good tables and chairs, and each classroom has fans and AC. Wi-Fi is available inside the college premises. There are many hostels in our college, separate for boys and girls. Each college coming under our university has different hostels. Mess and canteen food are not up to the mark, but it's fine. Our college gives more importance to sports and other extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: My college experience at SIMATS .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. You will have air-conditioned classrooms, Wi-Fi facilities are there, a library, etc. In a hostel, you have 2 sharing, 4 sharing, and 12 sharing rooms with AC facilities. Mess and canteen foods are available. If you want to hike, there are so many places on campus.

reviews.review_heading: SIMATS: the more you explore, the more you know.
reviews.review_text: Every hostel has Wi-Fi. The infrastructure of this college is more attractive than expected. The classrooms are so clean and hygienic. The hostel is also so good. On our campus, there are more than 15 hostels. Every hostel has its own uniqueness, like 4 in 1 AC, 6 in 1 AC,  8 in 1 AC, and 2 in 1 AC and there are non-AC rooms in hostels. The food is better than any other college in Chennai.

reviews.review_heading: Top notch infrastructure and facilities, excellent campus life, average food quality.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-notch. One of the best infrastructures we can see. The classrooms are good, and the bathrooms are clean and neat. Wi-Fi is available 24 hours a day, and a projector is available for all classes. The labs are air-conditioned and well-cleaned. The library is very big, and it consists of all kinds of books related to your studies. Canteen food is above average, and a food court is available, but the management is poor. The quality of food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Saveetha college experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent, with all the basic and top-end facilities available in our college. There are separate laboratories for each and every department and there are different labs for each further division in each department. Wi-Fi is available for the students. There are 4 libraries in our college with a great atmosphere to study in. There are many hostels in our college (approximately 10), and each hostel has its own rules and regulations. Food is comparatively bette...

reviews.review_heading: Really satisfied with all the facilities provided by our college management.
reviews.review_text: Excellent facilities were offered by the college management. The quality of food will be very good, the classroom infrastructure is also good. Medical facilities were also good. Labs, classrooms infrastructure were also good. The facilities is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms have all the facilities with smart amenities. The infrastructure of the college is excellent. There were Library, Laboratories, Seminar halls, etc. and all of them were well maintained. The college campus has Wi-Fi facilities. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good place to gain and expand your knowledge and future but dissatisfied to the core in other areas.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar but my friends who reside in hostels weren't satisfied either. They showed me a picture of dead bugs and worms in their food. That alone is a major concern. No action was taken by the management related to the quality of the food provided. That explains a lot. The rooms are okay but not worth it. INR 80–90k in hostel fees is too much for a mediocre room and disease-carrying food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences, Poonamallee.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were decent. Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Computers were also available in this college. Laboratories were excellent. There was a decent library in this college. Hostel facilities were great. The security facility was good in our hostel. The food quality was decent. Sports were conducted in this college. Medical facilities were also provided for emergency purposes. Hospital was also available on our campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and experienced faculty with affordable fees.

content.Placements: In my course, Mechanical Engineering at LDCE, the placements are quite good. Almost 70% to 80% of students get placed every year. The highest salary package offered is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA, and the average package is about 5 LPA. Top companies like Reliance, Adani, L&T, and Tata Motors come to our campus.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of LDCE is decent. Since it is a very old government college, the buildings look old, but the Mechanical department has big classrooms and well-equipped labs for practicals. The library is vast and contains almost all the books required for our course. Wi-Fi is available in some areas of the campus. I am a day scholar, but my friends say the hostel is affordable and has basic facilities with an average mess. However, the campus has a big ground for sports, and there are facilities for indoor games too. Overall, the campus life is good and very active.

faqs.answer: Gujarat Technological University BBA admission for 2025 is merit-based. It considers Class 12 aggregate. To apply, students must visit official website (gtu.ac.in) and navigate to the 'Students' section, then 'Admission', and fill out the GCAS registration form. After uploading required documents and paying an application fee of up to INR 500, candidates have to wait for the GCAS-prepared merit list. Finally, to confirm admission, a fee of INR 10,000 is required. Full tuition fee for the BBA course of INR 90,000 is to be paid progressively.

paragraphs: IIM Amritsar admission processbegins with filling theCAT application formfor the MBA. For other programmes, students must apply on the official site of the college. The selection criteria may differ course-wise. Below is theIIM Amritsar admission process:
1: IIM Amritsar Application Process 2026

Candidates who wish to get admission in the courses available at the IIM Amritsar can apply for CAT examination by completing the CAT application process. This can be done by paying the complete application fee ofINR 2,400(for UR candidates) &INR 1,200(for reserved categories).
For other programmes, aspirants must fill out theIIM Amritsar form. Below is the course-wiseIIM Amritsar form fee:
2: IIM Amritsar Selection Criteria 2026

IIM Amritsar offers admission to its flagship programme MBA based on CAT score. Once theCAT resultsandCAT cutoffare out, the candidates are shortlisted for the PI round. During the interview, the panel will evaluate each candidate's academic background, quality of work experience and other personal traits.
3: Declaration of Merit List

The final ranking list of candidates for admission to the MBA 2026 programme will be based on the composite score. The composite score includes the PI score and the Post PI score. The post-PI score for each candidate is calculated based on the aggregate scores obtained in PI, work experience, gender diversity and academic diversity. The pre-PI score is calculated based on the CAT score, academic performance, gender diversity and work experience.
4: Admission Confirmation

The final offers of admission to candidates selected from each category will be made strictly based on the final rank based on the aggregate score. Selected candidates are required to confirm their seat in IIM Amritsar by paying the course fee.

reviews.review_heading: My college faculty is good.
reviews.review_text: The campus is equipped with state-of-the-art classrooms featuring modern amenities like smart technology, and the library is well-stocked. High-speed Wi-Fi is available at my college. The hostel accommodation for clean living species in my college offers a clean living space.

reviews.review_heading: Details about my college with my point of view.
reviews.review_text: Excellent online library and resource. Well-equipped classrooms with AC, projectors and teaching assistants. Sports facilities include various options like Pool, TT Volleyball etc. Numerous clubs and committees, organize academic and recreational events. Good hostel infrastructure with 2 BHK accommodation for 4 students.

reviews.review_heading: Take Admission in IIM Amritsar and it gives a wing to your dream .
reviews.review_text: The campus provides top-class classrooms with full facilities like smart classrooms. The library is highly equipped with top-class infrastructure, and high-speed Wi-Fi facilities are also provided. Hostel facilities include clean rooms, toilets, and quality food served at the mess.

reviews.review_heading: College placement is 100 percent.
reviews.review_text: Amritsar conducts 5 business conclaves in an academic year. Aarunya, the cultural, sports, and business fest, is organized by the college. IIM Amritsar currently does not have its own campus, and the transmit campus is situated at the Punjab Institute of Technology. The library consists of both offline and online materials to assist the students. Also, the institute ID enables the students to access premium journals and tools. All the classrooms are IT enabled and have all the necessary faciliti...

reviews.review_heading: Best among the baby Iims.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is very good with 2 bhk flats for students. There is a facility for indoor and outdoor sport. Hostel is equipped with 24*7 high-speed Wi-Fi connection. Mess food is also of quality having variety for people from all parts of country, so that everyone feels at home.

reviews.review_heading: Extremely good faculty members. Guest lectures and conclaves conducted for better exposure.
reviews.review_text: The campus and hostel infrastructure are having facilities which is sufficient and more comfortable for students. The library resources are helpful for gaining knowledge and the online library (remote library) facilities are available. Amritsar is known for food, IIM Amritsar is keeping the name and providing good quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has an absolutely fantastic environment to learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: There is a top-class infrastructure in our classrooms, along with smart boards, air-conditioners and microphone facilities. Our library is highly equipped with top-class infrastructure, and high-speed Wi-Fi facility is also available on the campus and in the hostel. Currently, our college is running on a temporary campus with hostels which are situated 8-10 km away from the campus. The quality of the facilities provided in the hostel is the same as the campus like high-class hostel rooms and pro...

reviews.review_heading: IIM Amritsar is a good college in the holy city.
reviews.review_text: Currently, we don't have a permanent campus, but that will be completed soon. But both are good as of now. Classes and hostels are well-equipped. We have high-speed Wi-Fi on campus and hostel. We have transport facility to reach campus and hostel. Hotel is awesome where we get a good learning experience.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied with placements, faculty and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: As of now the college does not have its permanent campus but there is nothing you are going to miss. Classes are well-equipped with whatever it needs to be. Hostel is the place which seems like home away from the home. There is separate playgrounds for games like volleyball, football, cricket and badminton.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Amritsar : the fastest growing IIM.
reviews.review_text: The Hostel and Campus are at different locations as we are currently in the transit campus. Both the campus and hostel facilities are up to the mark. The hostel as well as the campus is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, canteens, classroom with e learning facilities etc.

reviews.review_heading: Very good placements, holistic learning, diversity and some of the best minds across country.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is one of the best among many other Business Schools operating across India. The entire hostel is equipped with Wi-Fi, providing all the facilities a students need to focus on their studies. Additionally we have a badminton court, a playground where you will often find students playing football and cricket, Pool table, Chess and many other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college in the Holy City.
reviews.review_text: IIM Amritsar doesn't have its own campus and hostel right now, and it will take 2-3 years from now to have them. There are limited facilities, and the administration really did a phenomenal job in providing budgets so far. The hostel has a separate playground, activity room and enough space to stay.

reviews.review_heading: A full fledged MBA and LIFE experience.
reviews.review_text: Good quality hostel rooms with dual sharing rooms, clean and adequate toilets, good food quality and variety,  24 hrs medical facilities available, hostel warden available. The Convenience store arranged by the hostel is also very useful for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides excellent education with the best placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has good facilities with efficient management. They serve tasty food, and the hostel maintains good hygiene. It is near to the airport. They provide canteen and 24x7 medical facilities. The hostel has separate rooms, which are clean, and transport is also available. The library is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Placement, campus life & pedagogy, There's nothing you'll miss out in IIM Amritsar.
reviews.review_text: College is operating in a temporary facility which has all the basic requirements. However each day the college is getting ready to make the transition in its makeshift campus in Manewala. Wi-Fi is available in both hostels and college campuses. We have got one of the best hostels among all IIMs (Even the 2nd and 1st generation) as there are 2 and 4 BHK flats available in the hostel with adequate security.

faqs.question: What is the hostel fee structure of SOA University?
faqs.answer: The hostel fee structure for SOA University depends upon the number of accommodations, for double sharing with Air conditioning the fee is INR 1.20 Lacs per annum. For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum. Siksha O Anusandhan University provides separate hostels for boys and girls with 24-hour security and Wi-Fi facilities. There are 13 boys and 11 girls hostel. The hostels also have mess facilities providing hygienic and nutritious food. The mess charges are not included in the hostel fee, candidates need to pay INR 36,000 per annum to avail of the campus mess.

faqs.question: What is the total fees of SOA BTech programme?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BTech programme at SOA University ranges between INR 5.1 Lakhs - INR 11 lakhs. This range of fees does not include the cost of the mess or the hostel fee. There is a range in the fee structure because the fee for each specialisation can be slightly different from the other. The BTech programme at SOA University is also provided as a three-year lateral entry programme and in this case, the candidates will not have to pay for the first year of the prgramme. The fee mentioned here is taken from unofficial sources and can be indicative.

reviews.review_heading: I chose the best inter for real.
reviews.review_text: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.
reviews.review_text: The biggest relief here is that almost all our classrooms are air-conditioned. For CSE, the labs are pretty solid, and we have dedicated labs. reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely a good university in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: You will definitely like the infrastructure, and the food is 8.5/10, depending on your personal Taste. You should definitely try the Biriyani, which you will definitely like. Mostly, you will get a variety of food, and most of the time, the food is edible and properly cooked.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Institute of Technical Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: There are very bad facilities, as they do not have any proper behavior. reviews.review_heading: The campus is well organized. Professors are well qualified, and placement in the college is solid.

The drainage system is fine inside the campus. The hostels are perfect as well (from a male perspective). The food is good. If you don't like the food, you can complain about it. At the end of the day, you will like the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: SOA is a mix of pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure and good technical labs. Wi-Fi facility is available 24x7. All classrooms are smart. It also has a good central library where students can study. The hostel is not upto mark. Mess food is average. The hostel culture is also not that good.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. They should conduct more events.

reviews.review_heading: Inter and Teach sounds weird.
reviews.review_text: I mean the Wi-Fi all over college, food , even the cafeteria and all are not pocket friendly. The medical facilities are nice and fine. Inter is well known for sports. Out of all 5 campuses, it has been maintaining the streak of being the SOA cup winners. We had a sports fest from Dec 4 - Jan 7th 2026. Even you have Inter College leagues, etc.

reviews.review_heading: An absolutely mediocre college with basic facilities but decent food and infrastructure.

The campus does have a sports culture, but the area designed for sports related activities is quite small. Medical facilities are available. The college also hosts sports tournaments. I wi...

reviews.review_heading: Review of what a good experience was in my college life.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there were so many different types of courses available. Different courses had different blocks. Fully Wi-Fi available inside the college campus. Classrooms were smart rooms, and a big central library was also available on campus. In the hostel, they provided Wi-Fi, a gym, four times a day food, power backup, etc.

review_content.Placements: The placement for core and technology branches is excellent. No college of this rank can compete with it. This college is a savior for students with ranks below 60,000- 65,000. For CS/IT, the placement is average. reviews.review_heading: Oil Technology don't include mineral oils and gases in HBTU.
reviews.review_text: The college is equipped with Wi-Fi, advanced labs, and a vast library that has books that are almost 100 years old to the latest journals, research papers, and e-books. For oil, there are 3 labs (one for UG, one for PG, and one for advanced research and Ph.D.). The lab has some of the most advanced equipment in the field of oil, and even samples from IIT come to HBTU for testing in the field of oil. The campus has an infirmary for any medical issues, where a doctor is available 7 days a week, an...

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and has a powerful alumni network.
reviews.review_text: As we know, the college is very old thus the infrastructure is also very old but it gives chills too. The hostel is in bad condition. The mess food is below average for the first-year students. Water quality is bad as of now. Wi-Fi is available, which gives 8 GB per student per day but it is very slow.

reviews.review_heading: Average campus. Placements are excellent for technology & core branches, but average for CS and IT.
reviews.review_text: Currently, IT does not have its own department. First-year classes are held in the lecture hall complex. While second- and third-year classes are in the main building. Classroom infrastructure is average, with some air-conditioned rooms. Fourth-year classes are held in the Computer Science department, whose infrastructure is below average. A new extension for the CS department is being built, which will also accommodate IT students. Overall, the college infrastructure is average, similar to most...

reviews.review_heading: My hbtu 3  years journey.
reviews.review_text: The boys hostel is not too satisfying in terms of cleaning and the infrastructure is also not too good but the greenery is good in the college. The campus is too big and the boys hostel provides very limited restriction so students can do many extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is decent best.
reviews.review_text: HBTU has two campuses: East Campus and West Campus. The East Campus has two boys’ hostels for first-year students and a girls’ hostel for each year. The West Campus has hostels only for boys of 2nd, 3rd, and final year, Shatabdi Bhavan for cultural events, a cricket ground, a gymnasium, and other facilities. However, the condition of the hostel rooms is not of a very high standard. The hostels accommodate single, double, and three-seater rooms.

reviews.review_heading: The underrated college with a great scope of improvement and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: The classes are spacious and well-ventilated with ACs. The library is huge, with over 1 lakh books. HBTU also has multiple canteens across the campus, offering plenty of spots to explore and hang out, making the overall campus experience lively and enjoyable.

reviews.review_heading: College is good in academics and also in extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are so good, while the campus is fine, and libraries are so good. About 1 lakh books are available in the college, which is a good facility in the hostel, and the seniors are very supportive in the college, so the academics are going smoothly.

reviews.review_heading: Good college like in placements, course, alumni network.
reviews.review_text: The campus life is not that much good as compared to other colleges, and the location of the college is also a negative side. Hostel life is good until unless you are in East campus (where all the academic and administrative buildings are present). According to me, it’s better to take private hostel than choosing West campus hostel like Ambedkar and Aryabhatt in 1st year.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worthy to join this college as it has a nice network.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good and present all over campus. Food is good, and we can decide the menu by talking to our mess secretary. We can also add or subtract food items from the menu if people agree with us. The canteen is average, as we get normal things like samosas and parathas.

reviews.review_heading: Chemical/CT at HBTU is worth it, strong academics and consistently solid placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus is decent but mostly old. Buildings are functional, not modern. Labs are mixed, some are updated, while some are outdated. The hostel is basic with average maintenance; rooms are simple, and the mess food is consistent. Overall, it is a workable environment, but don’t expect premium facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Uttar Pradesh after the IIT.
reviews.review_text: There are several facilities in the hostels. There are separate hostels for girls and boys, in which facilities of mess and very variety of food and cultural diversity are also seen. Many students in Kanpur are from Kanpur itself as it offers a very good rate of interest to students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of HBTU (one of the top state universities).
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my department is quite old and needs renovation. Wi-Fi is available with good speed throughout the campus. If I talk about the library, it is well-maintained and you can get almost all books and journals from here. The quality of rooms in the hostel is average, and you'll get double and triply seated rooms in 1st,  2nd and 3rd year, while in the final year, you will get a personal single room for sure. The quality of the mess food is average, but it degrades as time passes.

reviews.review_heading: HBTU is a decent college with a long history and also good recognition in Uttar Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: Library in HBTU is very nice. Fully air-conditioned and have the best infrastructure. But the infrastructure of hostels on the East Campus is old. It needs yearly maintenance however, the West campus is a perfect example of good infrastructure. There are several auditoriums in college and multiple grounds for sports and physical activities.

reviews.review_heading: Choose this college if you are not getting good NITs and you are ready for the grind.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs and library are available, classrooms are average. Hostel is also average with all basic facilities, a mess, laundry, canteen, and basic equipments for sports. Infrastructure of both departmental and hostel building is average. Medical facilities are provided by a dispensary in college. Students also receive insurance cover from college supported by a company.

reviews.review_heading: Our infrastructure is improving day by day. Faculty members are really nice and help us.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure gets enhanced by our faculty members according to the requirements as new labs are designed for us to get into it deeper and understand the techniques used in biotechnology. We have a central library and classrooms with AC. Wi-Fi is provided all over the campus. My hostel is Vishwakarma, where facilities are really good. Canteen is also available for us. The quality of food is so good. On college campus medical facilities are also available.

reviews_list.batch_info: BMS in International Marketing with PWC Certification - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, college is good.

review_content.Placements: The placement rates are good. 80-90% placement rate is there. The average package is 5 LPA - 7 LPA. The placement rate is not as expected as we are investing such amount but its depend on our skills. If we have good skills, it will be a chance that we can get a high-paying job outside campus.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good but food quality is average. Campus is not such big, it's just a building not such physical activity. Study is good. College does not provide Wi-Fi. Hostels are good. Wi-Fi is there but hostels are not on campus, it is 3-5 KM away. But bus facility is included in hostel fees.

reviews_list.batch_info: Corporate BBA - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: The college is very good in the end.

review_content.Placements: 99.8% are placed by choosing this course. The highest package is 22 LPA, and the top company is Deloitte. 99% of the students got internships from this course and from very big companies. The college is very perfect, and the crowd and networking are very excellent.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms and library are very clean. Wi-Fi is working very nicely. The facilities, like medical and sports, are very nice. I'm very happy to join this college.
review_content.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and well-qualified. The curriculum is very relevant so that the students can score well and get better placements. The college semester exams are not as tough as I thought, they are nice and good for scoring well. The staff are very good.

reviews_list.review_title: My honest review of Jain University.

review_content.Placements: 99.8 percent students are placed in our course. This year, the highest package is 22 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Deloitte recruit. Almost every student got an internship in a top company.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are so good. Wi-Fi works very well, high-speed.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, with PhD qualifications and lots of experience, and very supportive. Our course for the corporate world is very relevant. The semester exams are a little hard, as they should be, because this is what we are learning, it's challenging.

reviews_list.review_title: Professors are also good case negotiators.

reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied because they give us a chance to do something new and show our talent.

review_content.Placements: The highest package is 53 LPA, the average is around 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 9 LPA. From my course, around 70 percent get internships with good compensation. There is a huge canteen with every facility, like AC and filtered water. Every day, there is a change in food variety. There are playing areas for every sport and indoor games.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Psychology (Clinical) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members, and placement record impressive.

review_content.Placements: The colleges placement record is always good. Every year, more than 85 to 90 percent of students get job offers from the campus. The highest salary package for the psychology students of our college is 42 LPA and the average package is 7 to 8 LPA. Students get jobs in different departments in different hospital through qualifications.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by CMS BangaloreReviewed on 27 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: My honest review of Jain University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are so good. Wi-Fi works very well, high-speed.

reviews.review_heading: Professors are also good case negotiators.
reviews.review_text: The fees and other processes were required to be completed on time to avoid any penalties. The digital library was accessed by all students with their individual IDs. reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because they give us a chance to do something new and show our talent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities I get here include almost everything, like Wi-Fi, library, labs, hall rooms for practice, and digital classrooms. There is a huge canteen with every facility, like AC and filtered water. Every day, there is a change in food variety. There are playing areas for every sport and indoor games.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Jain Deemed-to-be University, School of Allied Healthcare and SciencesReviewed on 30 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Faculty members, and placement record impressive.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is quite clean and large. The food in the canteen here is very goo. There are facilities for indoor and outdoor games for sports. There is also a large library and each classrooms have projectors, air conditioning, The hostels rooms have free Wi-Fi and air conditioning etc.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by School of Sciences, Jain Deemed-to-be University, BangaloreReviewed on 18 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a very good university.
reviews.review_text: Labs are perfect, and in the hostel, I would prefer to live in Mojo hostel, where the food is okay, and they provide good food. The hostel is clean, and the roommates are also good. Most importantly, it is nearer to the campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Jain Deemed -to- be University, Faculty of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 17 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college is neither very good nor very bad. Placements are possible if you work hard.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi speed is not good. Classrooms are well maintained but without AC. Still, they are neat and clean with projectors. The library has two floors with many books, and its infrastructure is good with air conditioning. For games, you get all opportunities at Jain University, but hostel food is not worth the money as the same gravy is used for every meal. However, students in the college hostel get 1.5 lakhs medical insurance.

reviews.review_heading: Experience in Jain University.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is fine, but there is no scope in playing sports and games because we could not find any ground to play those things. Also, the quadrangle which is used to conduct all the events is very small and congested, that needs to be corrected.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with great placements.
reviews.review_text: There is AC in each classroom, which is honestly great. The library is very helpful for students..

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Jain Deemed-to-be University, School of Allied Healthcare and SciencesReviewed on 2 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied till now, faculty is good and well qualified. It has good environment.
reviews.review_text: Library here is small, and there are not many books available. The infrastructure is good, with good lighting, air conditioning, and furniture. Wi-Fi in the college building is not provided. Wi-Fi, 3 meals, and snacks are available in hostel. It is hygienic. Power backup is kind of an issue in the hostel sometimes. Washing machines are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Highly qualified teaching staff, good crowd, great college life, and infrastructure is superb.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided, labs are accessible to everyone, and classrooms are neat, well-built, and spacious. All the necessary facilities and equipment are available for a standard class including chair, benches, tables, boards, markers, fans, air-conditioning, etc. Sports facilities are superb.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Jain Deemed -to- be University, Faculty of Engineering and TechnologyReviewed on 26 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Not good on the faculty members' side.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in our course and department, for example, Wi-Fi is not good, and the lab is okay. Classroom is not bad, and their library is so bad. There is no quality in the facilities of our hostel, and they are repeating the same menu for the food.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by School of Sciences, Jain Deemed-to-be University, BangaloreReviewed on 12 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is not good. There is no campus life in the college.
reviews.review_text: We have a well-equipped library. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-equipped with Wi-Fi. But I don't recommend taking the Jain hostel for accommodation. It is worthless. You have to pay 2 lakh for 1 year, and it is not worth paying 2 lakhs.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Center for Nano and Material Sciences, Jain Deemed-to-be University, BangaloreReviewed on 4 Aug 2025)

reviews.review_text: We have well-equipped lab, hostel facility, good infrastructure, well-trained faculty, pleasant campus, good placement, nice cafeteria, transport facilities, a temple on campus, industrial visits, ragging-free college, research-oriented lab, and library facility.

paragraphs: Jain University is a deemed-to-be university that offers scholarships to its students based on six different categories. These scholarships are offered by the Jain University Scholarship Committee (JUSC) and are classified in various areas ranging from academic to extra-curricular categories. Apart from its regular students, the University also provides opportunities to candidates who are differently abled. To be eligible for Jain University Scholarship program students need to fulfill minimum educational qualifications with other requirements specified for each category.

The sports scholarship will remain to continue for a period of three years. After the completion of one year, players’ performance will be analysed based on their performance/ achievements in the state-level/ national-level and All Indian Ranking tournaments. The same criteria will be followed for the extension of the second-year scholarship. The third-year scholarship will be based on players’ performance in the second year.
If any aspiring candidate is not able to perform well in the first year then, JUSC may terminate the scholarship granted to the upcoming sports scholar.

At Jain University, scholarships to students in any of the six categories are provided through the University Scholarship Committee. admission_process.title: KIIT School of Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: KIIT School of Management admission to all the UG & PG courses is entrance-based. The admission starts with an online registration process. To get admission to any of the UG & PG courses at KIIT School of Management, students must go through a multi-step admission process. Check the following steps for the complete details around KIIT School of Management admission:
Application Process

KIIT School of Management application process is conducted in two ways for PG courses. Students can apply directly to the online application portal of the institute with valid scores of any one of the national-level entrance exam. Another way is to apply for the KIITEE Management entrance exam at (admissions.ksom.ac.in/kiitee management). The second application process is valid for all UG, PG & PhD courses.
Selection Rounds

KIIT School of Management admission to all courses is entrance-based. Students either need to qualify for the institute-level KIITEE or KIITEE Management Test. However, a valid score of other national-level entrance exams conducted for admission to UG, PG & Doctoral level courses are also accepted for admission to respective courses. The institute shortlists students based on their past academic records and entrance exam scores. The final selection will be based on the performance of candidates in Group Discussion and Personal Interview rounds.
Result Declaration & Documents Submission

After the completion of all the selection rounds, the final result will be declared on the official website of KIIT School of Management. Candidates who pass the selection process must submit a list of documents for the verification.
Step 4: Final Admission

At last, students will be intimated for their final selection through a provisional offer letter. They need to confirm their offer with the terms and conditions for taking admission to the programme through an “Acceptance Letter”. Further, they must also pay the fee within the stipulated deadline to finalise the admission.

reviews.review_heading: College life is good enough to enjoy.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are varied, including sports and games. The hostel infrastructure is good enough to live in. There are various hostels, and they have both AC and non-AC options so that students can live according to their preferences. The mess food is average, but it is healthy and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: KIIT SCHOOL OF MANAGEMENT- A great institution of Management.
reviews.review_text: KSOM is known for the beauty of it? S infrastructure. Starting from the fountain which is the centre of attraction to spacious classrooms. It also has 2 Libraries for MBA and BBA each. The separate hostels for both girls and boys are within the campus. All kinds of facilities like geyser,  24*7 hours electricity and water is provided to the students. The variety of food provided in mess is still under progress but the quality is hygienic and nutritious. The janitors are hire for maintenance of h...

reviews.review_heading: A good wholesome experience for MBA at KIIT School of Management.
reviews.review_text: The KIIT School of Management has a stunning campus with world-class infrastructure, abundant greenery, and beautiful stone structures that enhance the ambiance. In the evenings, the campus becomes a perfect place for students to relax and unwind from their busy schedules. The classrooms, library, and Wi-Fi are well equipped with the latest technology, making learning smooth and efficient. The infrastructure and overall environment make student life easy and engaging. Additionally, the campus of...

reviews.review_heading: Completed MY MBA in KIIT.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and ambience at KIIT are phenomenal. KIIT is one of the most green campuses in the university. We have a departmental library on our campus and a central library for university students. We can get books from the library by just showing an ID card for the complete duration of our program. KIIT always believes in the overall development of students. We have a cricket field, a football field, a swimming pool, several gym and a basketball court. We have to pay a total of INR 85,0...

reviews.review_heading: I love this college and it is nice to live in the hostel.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good. We provided a bed, table, almirah, bed cover, pillow, pillow cover, etc. The meal given is good and tasty. They provide a strong network Wi-Fi facility as well. A gym is also available in the hostel building for students who are concerned about their physical fitness. The registration process is simple; we just have to go to the warden office and provide the required documents for registration. In our 10-kilometer radius, there are two villages and many PGs and rooms are availa...

reviews.review_heading: Life at KSOM was perfect.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the KIIT School of Management are a hostel with AC, Wi-Fi, a canteen, a cafeteria, a library, a gaming zone, a sports complex and gym, a digital classroom, laptops, and many other necessary facilities. And the quality of the facilities is perfect.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculties, good placement scenario and the facilities provided here.
reviews.review_text: KSOM offers state-of-the-art facilities including wi-fi enabled campus, modern classrooms, well-equipped labs and comprehensive library. The hostel facilities are great with clean rooms, nutritious food in the mess and canteen, and access to medical care. Sports and recreation options are also abundant promoting a balanced lifestyle.

reviews.review_heading: One of its kind : KIIT School Of Management.
reviews.review_text: No doubt, KIIT has the best infrastructure and not a single other university comes even close to it in Odisha. Just the best in class. It has the best Wi-Fi system, state-of-the-art classrooms, labs, an amphitheater, a library and everything else that you can imagine. Just to mention, the BBA/MBA campus is better than any other KIIT campus. Hostel rooms are quite good, with good space. Hostel food quality is also good. The general food court is really good, with good and tasty food. Really hygie...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the facilities, good placement in 2023 and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The libraries are renowned and the facilities are exceptional. The Wi-Fi is average, the labs are of high quality, and the hostels are also satisfactory. However, the only drawback is the limited timing until 6:30pm, which restricts the overall enjoyment. Unfortunately, the mess food quality is subpar, but the sports and gaming facilities are commendable.

reviews.review_heading: Whatever students want is provided here.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms and hostels are air-conditioned with proper 24-hour WI-FI support. The best part is that our library continues to publish all sorts of books by top authors. We have smart TVs as a system, which is not present in most of the B-schools right now.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best B-Schools in India.
reviews.review_text: KSOM has been ranked among the top premier institutes in the country for its infrastructure and course curriculum. The entire campus is surrounded by greenery. All the classrooms and halls are equipped with smart LED systems for classes. Most of the faculty members are from IIMs and other premium business schools in the country. We have a separate hostel for management students and the mess is only 50 meters away from the hostel premises. The food served is of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is beautiful.
reviews.review_text: There is a library facility available for the students, where they can read journals, books, and newspapers that guide them for the future. There is a Wi-Fi facility available for the students both in classrooms and in the hostel rooms. The mess food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: The teachers are helpful in nature.
reviews.review_text: There is a library facility available for the students. The Wi-Fi facility is available for the students in both Classrooms as well as in hostel rooms. The mess food is not good and can be improved. The college provides the medical facility to the students.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure of the college is beautiful.
reviews.review_text: There is a Wi-Fi facility available for the students in both classrooms as well as hostel rooms. There is a library facility available for the students. There are various games available for the students to play both indoor and outdoor games. The college provides the medical facility at a free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Review of KIIT School of Management, Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities and infrastructure. All classrooms are very well-equipped with Wi-Fi, air-conditioners, and cameras. We have a library. It has prescribed timings. The quality of the food is good.
