placements.overview: Established in 1987, Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The institute offers courses like B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, B.Sc. and M.Sc. These courses are offered in Full Time and Part Time mode. A total of 77 courses offered by the Institute are available across streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies and Science. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: Overview not available

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Vegetable Science - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied rude faculty no placement poor technology and a very small campus.

review_content.Placements: No placement I have seen in the last 3 years. No Placement campaign organised by institute and company. Due to poor education system and low class technologies and all the private companies are well aware of that. They do not offer any role in the company. If they get a job by their own effort they get 15 thousand per month.
review_content.Infrastructure: College building is okay otherwise all the Campus is full of jungle. No Road parking space on the Campus. No canteen and Hostel are very poor. No Drinking water mess cleaning and even all bathrooms are Dead. Frequently venomous snakes can be seen.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Now name is changed RABL CARS Chhuikhadan. Best college forever for agriculture students.

review_content.Placements: In the case of placement, there is no offering for placements. But now college is a growing phase, sometime later, placements can start from here. Our college is trying to collaborate with reservation company, nursery, etc. Roles offered in agriculture college. We get all practical knowledge about farming. We get internships in VNR nurseries, and other top SEED fertilizer companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. Wi-Fi is available 24X7 in this college and hostel. Lab is available only during college hours. Excellent and advanced features are also available at this college. Classrooms has smart board. Library and e-library are also available. Every year, here organize inter-college and internal sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: IGKV is one of the top colleges of CG.

review_content.Placements: Everyone has entered college through competitive exams from rank 1st to 500th. The highest package is in crores and the lowest is in thousands. Mostly, students get government jobs. 50-60% of students get placed. Roles like professors, scientists, researchers, etc., are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every wing. There are classrooms with a projector and a big library. The quality of the food in the mess is eatable. The canteen is excellent. There is a dispensary within walking distance and a big sports complex. This campus also has 3 auditoriums for extracurricular activities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: There are not as many placements in IGC anymore as there used to be.

review_content.Placements: IGKV had a placement cell that helped students find jobs in government and private companies. The college offers placements in the agriculture sector including seed and fertilizer companies, agro-based companies and more. Placement companies were Tokita Pvt. Ltd, Syzenta Pvt. Ltd, Bayer Pvt. Ltd and Byer Pvt. Ltd. The salary package offered ranges from 2 LPA to 5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: IGKV had a good infrastructure, including hostels, a library, and a canteen. Campus was also equipped with sports facilities and a dispensary. IGKV had two hostel buildings, one for girls and one for boys. Campus was developed to accommodate more hostels. Students could apply for hostel rooms through the DSW office.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Agriculture studies are a waste of time, and do not have opportunities.

review_content.Placements: Top roles offered in my course were agriculture development officer, assistant professor in allied disciplines of agriculture like horticulture and agronomy, and rural agriculture extension officer. Top recruiting companies are VNR, Syngenta, Agriculture Insurance Company of India AIC, and more. The highest salary package offered was 12 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provided good library. Infrastructure and hostel facilities were up to the mark. The quality of food served in the mess and canteen was up to the mark. Classrooms were well-equipped with modern-day learning and were teach-friendly and innovative.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The university is good if you are eager to learn agriculture.

review_content.Placements: I pursue Bachelor of Science in Agriculture (2021-2025). The course offers learning in Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant Science, Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Statistics, etc. Placement: There are no placement offers by the university. Internship: No internship program offered by the university.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are various facilities available. In every department, Wi-Fi is available, as well as classrooms and labs in every department. There is a library in the college named "Nehru Library" with thousands of books available. 5 boys' hostels and 4 girls' hostels are available separately. The food quality is average to bad, but in the canteen, good quality food is available. The university has one dispensary for faculty members and students, a big ground for games, and also a gym available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied rude faculty no placement poor technology and a very small campus.

reviews.review_heading: Now name is changed RABL CARS Chhuikhadan. Best college forever for agriculture students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. Wi-Fi is available 24X7 in this college and hostel. Lab is available only during college hours. reviews.review_heading: IGKV is one of the top colleges of CG.

reviews.review_heading: There are not as many placements in IGC anymore as there used to be.

IGKV had two hostel buildings, one for girls and one for boys. Campus was developed to accommodate more hostels. Students could apply for hostel rooms through the DSW office.

reviews.review_heading: Agriculture studies are a waste of time, and do not have opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The college provided good library. Infrastructure and hostel facilities were up to the mark. The quality of food served in the mess and canteen was up to the mark. Classrooms were well-equipped with modern-day learning and were teach-friendly and innovative.

reviews.review_heading: The university is good if you are eager to learn agriculture.
reviews.review_text: There are various facilities available. In every department, Wi-Fi is available, as well as classrooms and labs in every department. There is a library in the college named "Nehru Library" with thousands of books available. 5 boys' hostels and 4 girls' hostels are available separately. The food quality is average to bad, but in the canteen, good quality food is available. The university has one dispensary for faculty members and students, a big ground for games, and also a gym available for stud...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Dau Kalyan Singh College of Agriculture and Research Station - Indira Gandhi Krishi VishwavidyalayaReviewed on 5 Nov 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, good placements in 2024, really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure of this college, smart room classes, canteen facilities, laboratory facilities, library facility, and also a good environment for study, Wi-Fi facility available. The campus area of this is more than 1700 acres. There are two hostel buildings, one for girls and the other one for boys. The quality of food available in the mess is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good for studies and the loving people and teachers, but the food quality was so bad.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, sports, and games are available in college. The hostel rooms were nice, but the food was not so good at all. The mess was not clean, and the doors and windows of the hostel could be broken easily because they are of very low quality. Overall, it was good.

reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure for agriculture and the horticulture department. Labs, classrooms, libraries, orchards, fields, hostels, and cooperative mess are worth it for government colleges. As the college gets so many awards nation-wide too for the bastar coffee. The professors are so professional with their research and experiments. The college gave their crops variety too. Everyone who wants to go in this field must give an entrance exam for our college.

reviews.review_text: The hostel is currently under construction and may be completed by next semester. The canteen facility is available and good-quality food is provided. On smartboards, teachers teach so students can learn through better visualization. Labs and Wi-Fi are available in every classroom.

There are no medical facilities, and no sports games are held here.

reviews.review_text: A library, computer lab, and other labs are also available for practical purposes, such as soil science and pathology labs. This college provides excellent hostel facilities for both boys and girls. The campus building is also in good condition. Smart class with air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: This is a government college because the fees are low.
reviews.review_text: Labs, practical equipment, Wi-Fi, a digital board, and a library are available. We also have a canteen at our college. Facilities in our hostel are average. review_summary.college_name: Jaipuria Institute of Management Lucknow Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: PGDM in Financial Services - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good environment.

content.Placements: Overall placement is good. The institute has tie up with big and medium companies, start ups and unicorn. Also, the placement cell is very supportive towards building the career of the students. Companies like HCL, Deloitte, EY, Icici, SBI Purple, Darwinbox, Tata Chroma, Pantaloons, etc. offer placements.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are equipped with all the digital facilities like projector, Wi-Fi, and e-library. Environment is good. Hostel facilities are maintained. Food is also fine. Morning and evening snacks are tasty. Rooms are spacious with both single and double beds with air-conditioners and non-air-conditioners.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Best PGDM college in Lucknow in terms of faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: There are good number of companies that come for recruitment every year. The college has a structured placement cell that keeps track of every student and companies for placement purposes. Salary package ranges between 6-8 LPA on average. Management trainee is the most common role offered.
content.Infrastructure: A number of facilities are available in campus in terms of classrooms, Wi-Fi, library and hostel. The food quality is average and there is variety in canteen menu. Sports are encouraged through various indoor and outdoor sports setup. Medical facility is also there.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Placements offered are excellent.

content.Placements: Jaipuria offers top class placement in the best companies. Amazon, Tata AIG, Amul, Pantaloons and many other companies come for placements. Students can also apply for companies, in inter-campus. Average salary is around 6 LPA. The highest recorded has been approximately 18 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The campus facilities are great for students from the city and outside. Classrooms, Wi-Fi and hostel facility is available. Library has kindles as well for external sources of content. Food quality is good, Canteen is kept clean and fresh. Medical facility is available.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college, If your score in CAT like exam is around 70, this is best choice.

content.Placements: Around 90 percent students got placed during the 2021 placements. Top recruiters includes HUL, ITC, Genpact, HCL etc. The highest package was around 12 lacs per annum, average I think was around 5 lpa, IT placement is usually high but due to pandemic, placements have come down.
content.Infrastructure: All the necessary facilities are provided by the college, they have separate hostel for both girls and boys. Hostel is equipped with all the facilities like Wi-Fi, gatekeeper, gym etc. Campus has all the facilities which is required for the b school.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: Jaipuria provides great placement assistance to the students. Courses are offered here are PGDM, PGDM retail and PGDM finance and there are good number of recruiters for each course. The highest package offered was around 18 Lacs per annum in Amazon. Infact, internship opportunity is also given in Amazon.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is fabulous. Even though it is not very huge, all the facilities are offered like any other B-school in country. Extra curricular is considered just as important as academic activities. Hostel facility is there for both girls and boys with good quality of food.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good environment.

reviews.review_text: A number of facilities are available in campus in terms of classrooms, Wi-Fi, library and hostel. The food quality is average and there is variety in canteen menu. Sports are encouraged through various indoor and outdoor sports setup. Medical facility is also there.

reviews.review_heading: Placements offered are excellent.
reviews.review_text: The campus facilities are great for students from the city and outside. Classrooms, Wi-Fi and hostel facility is available. Library has kindles as well for external sources of content. Food quality is good, Canteen is kept clean and fresh. Medical facility is available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college, If your score in CAT like exam is around 70, this is best choice.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is fabulous. Even though it is not very huge, all the facilities are offered like any other B-school in country. reviews.review_heading: Very much satisfied with college facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of campus is great. It is always kept clean and fresh. Classroom have projectors and AC for comfortable learning. Wi-Fi connection is available in campus. Sports are highly encouraged through various tournaments. Food quality is satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Overall everything is quite decent.
reviews.review_text: You will get all kind of facilities around the college. Campus has good infrastructure and facilities provided are also good. Food in canteen as well as in the hostel is amazing they have a very diverse menu that suits the taste buds of everyone. Also has a gym facility .

reviews.review_heading: infrastructure is really good
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is really good, mess food is good as well, the college campus is at a walkable distance from the hostel, you will make abudent memories here, you would not want to leave the hostel trust me, college campus has all the facilities but it's too small to accommodate batch capacity.

reviews.review_heading: It is worth joining the college.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-equipped labs. The infrastructure of our college is overall good except for the hostels. The quality of the food served is good. The location where the hostel is situated is not up to the mark. There are helpful people around you.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Lucknow - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Students will find all amenities like a library with all of the latest books and fully air-conditioned classrooms. It also offers a student lounge where students can get together and relax after attending 1-1.5 hours of class.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaipuria Lucknow - Jaipuria Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Students can find all the facilities like a library with the latest collection of books on all the subjects. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned. We also have a students' area named a student lounge where all the students can interact with each other.

reviews.review_heading: My opinion as a student of Jaipuria.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure proper students room also a separate auditorium with proper seating and lighting facilities. They also offer a separate room for students who have interest in activities or indoor sports also they give ample opportunities for sports with mostly all the sporting equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is a bit small for the number of students that are pursuing the PGDM program. Due to Covid, I was not able to visit campus much but for some time interval, it was open and was good. The internet speed is a bit low. Food served is average.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied, and this college is a good choice for a career.

admission_process.title: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Jaipuria Institute of Management, Jaipur admission processincludes online registration, application shortlisting, selection rounds, and seat allotment. The institute considers national-level Management entrance exam scores for PGDM and conducts an aptitude test for FPM programme. Details about each of the stages in the admission procedure are provided below:
STEP 1: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur Application Process 2026

Candidates can fill out the Jaipuria College Jaipur application form through the institute's official website. During the form filling, aspirants shall ensure that they fill out all the details correctly in the application. Also, the application must be submitted within the due date. Aspirants have to pay INR 1,000 for PGDM and INR 1,050 for FPM programmes as application fee.
STEP 2: Shortlisting of Students

After the conclusion of the application process, applications are shortlisted based on respective entrance exam scores. For PGDM programmes, the accepted exams are CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT. Due weightage is also given to past academic achievements and work experience respectively. In addition, candidates applying for the FPM course, need to take the entrance test conducted by the institute for the doctoral course.
STEP 3: Group Discussion & Personal Interview
Candidates who are shortlisted for PGDM programme have to further pass the case-based group discussion and personal interview round. Aspirants only have to clear the PI round for admission to FPM.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation
The institute sends the admission offer to the shortlisted candidates. Further, aspirants are required to pay theJaipuria Institute of Management feesto confirm their seat.

college_info.college_name: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur Scholarship Details

paragraphs: Jaipuria Institute of Management Jaipur provides financial assistance to eligible and deserving students through scholarships. The college encourages meritorious students with several scholarships as it also enhances the college's diversity and enables them to enroll outstanding candidates from various backgrounds. Jaipuria Jaipur scholarships are provided to students under three categories, i.e. based on entrance exam scores, Sibling scholarship, and IDFC First Bank scholarship.
Category 1: The college accepts various entrance exam scores for admission to the PGDM programme.

Category 2: The college also offers a Sibling scholarship worth INR 1,00,000 to students. The scholarship will be awarded on a first come first served basis to a limited number of scholars subject to admission in PGDM/MBA courses. Further, the scholarship for the second year will be based on the academic performance of year one.

Category 3: Jaipuria Jaipur offers an IDFC First Bank MBA scholarship which is a need-based programme worth INR 2,00,000 for 2 years of full-time MBA programme. It is mainly designed for students who come from families with an annual income of less than INR 6 lakh.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee at IPU?
overview_faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University's annual hostel cost is INR 29,500. Mess and welfare fees are not included in the hostel fees. The fee for the mess is INR 36,000, while the cost of the welfare is INR 3,000. Candidates need to submit three demand drafts: one for hostel fees, one for mess charges, and one for welfare charges. Two hostels are maintained on campus for male students, and two are maintained for female students. There are more than 180 single-seat rooms in each hostel. Basic furnishings such as a cot, mattress, pillow, chair, table, cupboard, tube lamp, and fan are provided in each room. Mess facilities are available for residents in each hostel. Residents also have access to a common area, a gym, a reading room, and sports facilities. For the hostels, there is a provision for 24-hour water and electrical services.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is spread over 60 acres, and placements are average.

content.Placements: About 60% are placed in companies like Infosys, Cisco, Oracle, JP Morgan, and Unthinkable. About 20% students got internships at Cisco, Oracle, and Infosys. Roles offered are full-stack developer, software engineer, cybersecurity engineer, and data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The campus lacks Wi-Fi and internet connection in most parts, and even the library Wi-Fi does not work well. The hostel is pretty good, and separate rooms are provided to everyone. The campus offers different games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the atmosphere.

content.Placements: Many students were placed in my course, going as high as 60-70%. The average package offered in my course was easily around 10 LPA or more. Top recruiting companies from my courses are BMW Motors, SRM Chemical, etc. Almost all students got the opportunity for internships.
content.Infrastructure: Regarding the infrastructure and facilities available in our department, Wi-Fi is provided in all the departments. Labs are equipped with special equipment needed for the best performance and results. Classrooms are very good, and even the library is accessible.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with teachers, academics, college life. Not satisfied with placement and infrastructure.

content.Placements: 60-70% or even less are placed in the course I have admitted. The lowest package is around 3 LPA, the highest package is around 4.5 LPA, and the average is 3.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, and Infosys are the main recruiters, and then startups. Not a lot idea about the internship, but it isn't a lot. Most students had to look for internships outside the campus. Roles as Software Developer, Frontend Developer, AI related roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just okay, not a big campus, and also not a lot of sitting and playing area. Just a building block. The library, labs, and classroom are good, but you won't get Wi-Fi, so don't get your hope high. No hostel, so nothing related to that. The canteen is good, there are a few stalls of fast food, Nestlé, and all, so that works alright.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The best college for a technical course.

content.Placements: In my course, mostly 70% of students get placement. The highest package offered is 21 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zomato, Microsoft, Wipro, and LinkedIn. Top roles offered by the companies are telecalling, web development, data analysis, and purchase assistance.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure, college with helpful faculty members and an overall good experience.

content.Placements: Around 70 to 80 percent of students were placed in the last recruiting. The highest package offered 10 LPA, while the average was around 4.5 LPA, and the lowest was 3 LPA. faqs.question: I've scored less than 50% in graduation. Am I eligible for MBA at GGSIPU?

faqs.answer: Admissions in GGSIPU are done on entrance-basis. The basic eligibility requires the candidates to pass Class 12 or its equivalent exam with a minimum aggregate of 50%. Only those who meet the cut-off and satisfy all the parameters will be allocated a seat at GSSIPU for the BBA programme. In case the students are unable to clear the BBA cut-off released by the university, they can pursue the BBA Online courses offered by various other colleges.

placement_data.title: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: GGSIPU placement report for 2025 is yet to be released. However, as per the overall NIRF 2025 data, the median package offered UG-4 Year was INR 8.25 LPA . The median package offered to the UG 5-year was INR 8.39 LPA . While the median packages offered to the PG 1-Year and PG 2-Year students were INR 5.35 LPA and INR 6.95 LPA , respectively.

The University has released the placement report 2024 for GGSIPU’s University School of Information, Communication & Technology ( USICT ). The highest package offered at GGSIPU USICT was INR 41.2 LPA . The average package offered was INR 7.2 LPA . Further, 126 offers were made and 32 companies visited the campus during USICT placements 2024. Apart from this, according to USMS NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during IPU MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 6.18 LPA . In addition, a total of 160 students were placed out of 175 students during Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University MBA placements 2023.

reviews.review_heading: The college is spread over 60 acres, and placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The campus lacks Wi-Fi and internet connection in most parts, and even the library Wi-Fi does not work well. The hostel is pretty good, and separate rooms are provided to everyone. The campus offers different games.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: Regarding the infrastructure and facilities available in our department, Wi-Fi is provided in all the departments. Labs are equipped with special equipment needed for the best performance and results. Classrooms are very good, and even the library is accessible.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Institute of Information Technology & ManagementReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with teachers, academics, college life. Not satisfied with placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is just okay, not a big campus, and also not a lot of sitting and playing area. Just a building block. The library, labs, and classroom are good, but you won't get Wi-Fi, so don't get your hope high. No hostel, so nothing related to that. The canteen is good, there are a few stalls of fast food, Nestlé, and all, so that works alright.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The best college for a technical course.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by VIPS - Vivekananda Institute of Professional StudiesReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, college with helpful faculty members and an overall good experience.
reviews.review_text: VIPS has one of the best infrastructures in the whole of GGSIPU. Classes are very good with the whole campus being centralized and air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is available, a very good library. It does not have its hostel. The canteen is very good in our college with a variety of food options available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Dr. Akhilesh Das Gupta Institute of Technology and Management (Formerly Northern India Engineering College)
reviews.review_heading: It is a decent college with supportive faculty, average infrastructure, and good connectivity.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are decent with Wi-Fi, but it does not work properly. It has well-maintained labs and a library with enough books and e-resources. The hostel is not available here. The canteen food is quite good. Medical facilities are basic. Sports and games options are available but limited.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good in infrastructure, syllabus, and they conduct excellent training every semester.
reviews.review_text: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by VIPS - Vivekananda Institute of Professional StudiesReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good placements and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite cool, with well-maintained, good classes, a library with many study materials, labs, grounds, etc. The campus is clean and disciplined. Various seminars are organised regularly. College is very nice. We can actually grow here.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Maharaja Agrasen Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is an outstanding college as compared to other IPU colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite good. Labs, classrooms, and the library are all well maintained. Students can use books from the library to avoid expenses and to buy books. Sports facilities are available. Several canteens are on campus. Medical facilities are available in case of emergency.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Maharaja Agrasen Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 15 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Not very satisfied because placements have been going down right after I joined.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is good but not too big. It's average, we have a playing area, ground, and all basic facilities like Wi-Fi, a good library, and drinking water, and canteens are okay too, not very good, but they are good, and 1 doctor is always available on the campus. I personally have visited him.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Maharaja Surajmal Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The library (7/10), classrooms - school desks, and a few classes have ACs. All the labs are well-equipped and maintained (10/10). Wi-Fi facility is only in the boys' and girls' rooms. The food quality is mid in the canteen. There are zero sports and games facilities. Students can roam around, walk, sit, and play, but they have to bring sports stuff from their homes.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with good and experienced faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure with greenery. The size of the campus is very large. Hostels are also available that are separate for both boys and girls. Wi-Fi connectivity is also available, but it is only in the academic block and is weaker in hostels. The overall ecosystem promotes focused learning.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Echelon Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It has a modern cinematic campus with easy academics.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is super modern and better than that of other colleges in Faridabad. It is so good that web series and ads are often shot here. We have everything like Wi-Fi, great labs, a gym, and a sports room. It offers hostels for both boys and girls. The only thing missing is a swimming pool.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Maharaja Surajmal Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: An average college with good academics but boring campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. Windows of classrooms are broken. Fans are not running. AC is installed but not working. When I talked to my friend about hostel facilities, he told me that rooms are not that spacious. There are 4 students in a room, which is too many. Food is not that good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Greater Noida Institute of Technology, IPUReviewed on 11 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Neither the worst nor best, but worth the money you spend.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and hostel facilities are not top-notch, but they are worth the money. You can access Wi-Fi throughout the campus. As for hostels, you will receive your own personal Wi-Fi. Hostels, library, and classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and hostels provide mess and transport facilities.

paragraphs: Kuvempu University admissions are merit and entrance-based. Karnataka PGCET, UGC NET, GATE, etc. are also accepted for admission to certain courses by the university. Kuvempu University also organizes an entrance exam for MBA, BPEd, MPEd and MCA. PG, PhD and PG diploma courses are offered by the university in full-time and part-time modes. The university also contains a Directorate of Distance Education that provides UG, PG and PhD courses in various streams. Candidates who are interested can apply online from the official website of Kuvempu University.
Check out more details in the below video:

Kuvempu University courses are available in multiple streams. Candidates who have completed a minimum of Class 12 can apply for UG courses. However, graduation is required for PG courses. Applications are likely to open inMayfor all courses. Below are eligibility and selection criteria for topKuvempu University courses:

Kuvempu University feeincludes tuition fee, caution deposit, etc. There is relaxation in the fee amount for SC/ ST candidates. Under the Payment Category students, KU students have slightly lower fee than other university students.

After the completion of admission process, request for refund of fees shall not be considered under any circumstances. In respect of MBA and MCA courses, the refund of any excess fees paid by the students would be made only after the receipt of excess fees from the concerned authority. Check below Kuvempu University fee for popular courses:

Kuvempu University seats are offered under Merit-cum-Reservation and Merit Special Categories. Candidates are offered seat in the university based on their merit or entrance exam score. Below is total seat intake for popular courses of KU:
There is relaxation in the seats for reserved category students as mentioned below:

The Kuvempu University admission begins with registration. To attend the selection rounds, the candidates have to submit an application to the course of their preference. The following are the step-by-step admission details of the Kuvempu University:
STEP 1: Kuvempu University 2025 Application Process.

The eligible candidates would be able to apply online on the official site of the university. The applicant will be able to apply via UUCMS Portal with a fee of INR 300 (INR 150 in case of SC/ ST/ CAT-I). Students applying to join MBA, MCA, BPEd and MPEd programs must remit the extra fee on entrance test in Challan in SBI jnanasahyadri. PhD application fee is INR 1,000 (INR 750 in case of SC/ ST/ CAT-I).
STEP 2: Selection

Most of the courses offered in Kuvempu University are selected on the basis of merit in the final qualification exam. Applicants are required to take the university entrance exam of the MPEd, BPEd, MBA and MCA. MBA is also offered at the university on Karnataka PGCET score. In addition to that, PhD is subject to admission based on either UGC NET, GATE or KU Entrance Exam score.
STEP 3: Confirmation of Admission.

After the release of the entrance exam results, the university publishes a list of shortlisted candidates by publishing a list that gives the name of the selected people. The shortlisted applicants will then be expected to pay the course fee and confirm their seat.

For some of the courses, the university begins registration in April. Admission to most of the courses is based on merit in the last qualifying exam. Candidates have to appear for an entrance exam for admission to MBA, MCA, BPEd and MPEd.

faqs.answer: On completing Bachelor of Education course from Kuvempu University, aspirants can become teachers at the primary, secondary and senior secondary levels in private schools. faqs.question: What are the career prospects after completing Ph.D from Kuvempu University?
faqs.answer: Kuvempu University PhD passouts can apply in the respective fields. The PhD holders can find job opportunities in academia, research and development (R&D) roles, etc. There are job roles offered by various private and government organisations. hostel.description: The University has four hostels for the post-graduate students on the main campus - two men’s hostels and two women’s hostels. Besides, there is a working women’s hostel on the campus providing accommodation to students and research scholars. The hostel for students belonging to backward classes and minorities (established near the main campus by the Government of Karnataka) provides hostel facility exclusively for the post-graduate students of the university. Students are advised to apply for hostels immediately after admission (on the same day).

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Acharya Tulsi National Commerce CollegeReviewed on 4 Sep 2024)

The library is very big, and the medical facilities are also good. The college campus also has the canteen facility, and the food is also good in taste.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Sahyadri Commerce and Management CollegeReviewed on 15 May 2024)
reviews.review_heading: In this college, placement is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good, and the infrastructure is well-designed. They provide Wi-Fi facilities, labs for each batch, classrooms with smartboards, and hostels. The food is both good and healthy, and medical facilities are provided.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Sahyadri Science College,Kuvempu UniversityReviewed on 13 Nov 2023)

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It is satisfactory because of the training conducted internationally and nationally.

review_content.Placements: Percentage of students placed according to their course and subjects. The placement rate is 50-60%. The average salary is between 3-6 LPA. Companies like Mother Dairy and Saras hire our students. Our college provides 3 months of industrial training in the last semester for experience.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in hostels. Sports and gym facilities are available on the college premises. There is no personal gym at the hostels. The food quality is good, and the price per meal is also affordable. At the girls hostel, it is Rs.90 per day, which includes 3 meals. At the boys hostel, it includes 2 meals a day.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good if you want to explore yourself and don’t have any expectations.

review_content.Placements: There are only a few placements with very low-income package that vary between 15,000 to 20,000. There are no famous recruiting companies that ensure a settled future for the students. Only students with a higher GPA get placed.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is better than most agriculture colleges but lacks necessities like air conditioning and even working fans. Labs are also not well-equipped. Food in the hostel mess is not digestible, and there are often cases of diarrhea. There are no medical facilities, and no extracurricular activities are there except for the once-a-year sports meet.

review_summary.college_name: SOM, BML Munjal University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Mess food is good, which regularly changes.

content.Placements: Placements at college are quite decent. The MBA placements for the batch of 2019-21 got an average package of 7.13 LPA. The highest package is 11 LPA. The college has a strong placement team with various corporate tie ups. Some of the prominent recruiters are KPMG, Wipro, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There are a total of 5 hostels present in the college for both boys and girls. The mess is included in the hostel fees themselves, but there are only 2 messes for 5 hostels, and all are common for both boys and girls. The registration process in the hostel is very smooth, and the authorities will help us. The hostel fee is Rs. 10,000 per month, and it is 2 lakhs per year.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good hostel with spacious rooms.

content.Placements: If you prepare well, you get placed easily. And if you skip presentations, assignments and classes, then it will be tough for you. The highest package is approximately 15 Lacs in Federal Bank. Almost 80% of students are placed. I also got an internship as a PPO with a magic pin in Head Quarters Gurgaon.
content.Infrastructure: I live in a triple-sharing apartment. We get our own balcony and a living room with 2 sofas, a center table, a sink, kitchen cabinets, a microwave, and a mini fridge. We also get our own bathroom with 2 showers, 2 basis and 2 toilets. The apartment has 3 rooms so the facilities are shared among 9 people. There is a water cooler right outside and a washing machine as well. The mess is included as part of the hostel fee. My hostel fees are 2 LPA.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: MBA in BML Munjal University.

content.Placements: BML Munjal University has good placement records so far. Nearly 1200+ students graduate from our university yearly. Additionally, 93 percent of students got placed in various companies with decent salary packages. My friends and I got placed in Lead Square with a salary package of 7 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: We were encouraged to play sports when we were interested in them. Apart from studies, they also allocate some time for playing sports. We won a lot of matches and trophies in sports tournaments conducted at the zonal level. The laboratories were properly maintained with all the necessary facilities.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Highly recommended college for MBA.

content.Placements: BML learning is very much related to the industry; anyone with good knowledge can easily get a job. Hyundai, Reliance Retail, Hero, Ola, and Axis Bank are top recruiters. Students are offered project-based internships. I got an internship at Reliance Retail. Top recruiters are Hero MotoCorp, KPMG, and others. Major companies are automobile companies. The average pay is 7.56 LPA, and the maximum package is 12.65 LPA. The college's relationship with companies is very strong, which helps in placements.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is amazing and is surrounded by lush greenery. The college is good in terms of amenities, with Wi-Fi available on campus, and labs are furnished with practice PCs. Some robberies occurred previously in the third wing of Hostel No. 1, but now security is very tight, with cameras everywhere. Parking space is limited, and sometimes hostel washrooms are not clean. The hostel mess offers many types of food, including snacks, breakfast, dinner, and lunch. There is a salon and branded medical safety services, but no hospital treatment is provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My college journey at BML munjal university.

content.Placements: The highest, average, and lowest salary packages offered by recruiters are up to 18.5 Lacs, 4.5 Lacs, and 3.6 Lacs per annum, respectively. As 100% of students from BML Munjal University got placed in the 2023 placements. They are actively providing internship opportunities to our students.
content.Infrastructure: All modes of transportation are available from our college, so there is no need to worry about medical facilities and other such things. It is a healthy and peaceful campus. There is a specific menu to be followed by our canteen management, and free Wi-Fi facilities are available within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Mess food is good, which regularly changes.
reviews.review_text: There are a total of 5 hostels present in the college for both boys and girls. The mess is included in the hostel fees themselves, but there are only 2 messes for 5 hostels, and all are common for both boys and girls. The registration process in the hostel is very smooth, and the authorities will help us. The hostel fee is Rs. 10,000 per month, and it is 2 lakhs per year.

reviews.review_heading: Good hostel with spacious rooms.
reviews.review_text: I live in a triple-sharing apartment. We get our own balcony and a living room with 2 sofas, a center table, a sink, kitchen cabinets, a microwave, and a mini fridge. We also get our own bathroom with 2 showers, 2 basis and 2 toilets. The apartment has 3 rooms so the facilities are shared among 9 people. There is a water cooler right outside and a washing machine as well. The mess is included as part of the hostel fee. My hostel fees are 2 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: MBA in BML Munjal University.
reviews.review_text: We were encouraged to play sports when we were interested in them. Apart from studies, they also allocate some time for playing sports. We won a lot of matches and trophies in sports tournaments conducted at the zonal level. The laboratories were properly maintained with all the necessary facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Highly recommended college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The campus is amazing and is surrounded by lush greenery. The college is good in terms of amenities, with Wi-Fi available on campus, and labs are furnished with practice PCs. Some robberies occurred previously in the third wing of Hostel No. 1, but now security is very tight, with cameras everywhere. Parking space is limited, and sometimes hostel washrooms are not clean. The hostel mess offers many types of food, including snacks, breakfast, dinner, and lunch. There is a salon and branded medica...

reviews.review_heading: My college journey at BML munjal university.
reviews.review_text: All modes of transportation are available from our college, so there is no need to worry about medical facilities and other such things. It is a healthy and peaceful campus. There is a specific menu to be followed by our canteen management, and free Wi-Fi facilities are available within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Review on BML munjal University.
reviews.review_text: The college intake is very high, and the campus has become small. There are a lot of students who are all very friendly. Annual festivals happen last month of the year; there are teachfests after the month of the semester. There are every required textbook and journal in the library. You can also make requests for books that are not available in the library. We have an E library and an E lab facility, but we do not require an E lab; it is for engineering students. Wi-Fi service is available in l...

reviews.review_heading: College is really good and fulfills all the requirements.
reviews.review_text: Life at the campus is really amazing, it is surrounded by lush greenery. The campus has modern well-equipped classrooms including digital boards and projectors. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. The hostel fees is 2 lacs per year. The campus has a small ground compared to the number of student intakes. The Library has the best infrastructure and is the best place to study. Mess food is of above average quality with veg and non veg food being served by the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities for the course of MBA.
reviews.review_text: BML University has a vibrant campus. Infrastructure of our college was good. Facilities available in the college for the students include labs, library, Wi-Fi, sports, big classrooms, canteen, etc. The facilities provided were of good quality. Hostel and medical facilities were also available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: BML Munjal is the best college for MBA.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure that are available to us here at BML Munjal University are the best; the college has been providing us with all the basic amenities throughout the year with the best quality and at very affordable prices; and the mess food at the college is also great.

reviews.review_heading: Our college doesn't provide good placements for marketing.
reviews.review_text: The pedagogy of the MBA is designed by imperial college London which makes this college unique. It lays more emphasis on practical knowledge rather than theoretical knowledge and promotes hands-on learning.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the Placement.
reviews.review_text: There is a inbuilt Wi-Fi connectivity through out the whole campus. Hostels are provided in the form of Towers and apartment. The maximum room sharing is 4. There are 2 mess in which food is served 4 times a day. There are indoor as well as outdoor sports in the college.

reviews.review_heading: In love with the campus not so much with the location.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure and facilities, I think our university does a great job in that. The library is one of the best places to be with plenty of books to read and study in a strict and quiet environment. Then comes hostel with good rooms and hygiene, toilets are cleaned every day as well as the rooms we live in. The quality of food is also okay not the best but not the worst too.

reviews.review_heading: It is a university with a practical approach to learning.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus is spread over around 50 acres of area. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, with multiple sports like football, lawn tennis, basketball, cricket, badminton, etc. We have two messes, along with that 2 separate cafeterias. The library is awesome, and facilities like the Bloomberg terminal are also available. The hostel is quite good, and the rooms are spacious. A lift facility is also available in both academic and hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Management, BML Munjal University.
reviews.review_text: Campus life is very good, with great infrastructure. The college has amazing and well-equipped Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms with all modern facilities. The college mess is quite hygienic, and the food available here is very good. The campus is lush green in and around. Hostel facilities are amazing on the campus, and students have access to games on the campus, such as cricket, football and tennis.

reviews.review_heading: BMU always emphasises on learning by doing methodology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available are good, and the quality of food available in mess and canteen is good. The hostel, medical facilities, sports, etc., are good. All the infrastructure is properly maintained and well furnished. Good security measures are taken for the safety of students.

review_summary.college_name: MJPRU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Overall, a good value for money campus I would say.

content.Placements: Almost 55 percent of the students are placed in our course and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA while the highest package is 7 LPA. 45 percent of the students get internships in various companies like Biocon, IVRI, Bharat Biotech, etc. I'm not sure about the top roles offered but some are recruited for HR and data management.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are good. The campus is full lush green with good classrooms and CCTV cameras almost in every class. The mess is somewhat okay, but the canteen is large with good quality items offered at affordable prices. A huge ground and sports equipment are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is good, especially value for money, and a good environment as well.

content.Placements: Almost 50 percent of the students were placed last year. The highest package was 7 LPA and the lowest one was 3.5 LPA. Some of the students were placed in good research positions, and even some at Byju's. I don't know much about the top recruiting companies, but last year, it was about 3-4 like research in IVRI, Byju's, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, the college is a full, lush green campus, and the college classrooms are not the best, but satisfactory. Wi-Fi is okayish, but having good labs and research, and a well-stocked library. Medical facilities are good for the students who suffer from any kind of problem or issue.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Disappoint of management.

content.Placements: Only 25% of students were placed during the last year. This college mainly relies on external recruiters, which is itself invited by colleges Boards of Directors. This college provides the basic knowledge required for obtaining a degree certificate and a few co-curricular activities. Although college placements have been made through TCS, Accenture, etc., they are too low to count.
content.Infrastructure: College classrooms are average. It's a small college, you can't expect it to have world-class facilities. There are Wi-Fi facilities, but in the reach of only staff. Students are not given any access to the Wi-Fi. The canteen here only keeps ready-made food items like chip packets, sandwiches brownie, etc. The quality is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Placement is okay, this can be looked through if you value for money.

content.Placements: Well, I am a first-year student so there is no recruitment yet, but last year the percentage of students is 55 percent, and the top roles offered were HR and data analyst, with the highest package being 7 LPA and the lowest 3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is well, there is a full good arena regarding sports activities and a good canteen which provides good food and items at affordable prices, but the hostel mess is not as good as it should be, and the quality of food is not all good as expected.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Decent college with good academics, facilities and campus exposure.

content.Placements: Around 85 percent of students got placed from this course. The highest package is 6 LPA-8 LPA and the lowest is 2 LPA-3 LPA. Wipro and Infosys are examples of recruiting companies. Internships are offered by TCS, Infosys, Wipro, startups, local IT firms, and through online platforms. Software developer, AI developer, etc., are roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The college has decent infrastructure for the students, staff, and departments. Classrooms are spacious, well-ventilated, and have basic teaching aids. The department has various computer labs and proper internet connections. The library is well stocked with books on different courses.

In order to be eligible, candidates must have qualified Class 12 with a minimum of 45% from any recognised national or state board. MJRPU only considers eligible candidates for admissions.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MJPRU Bareilly?
faqs.answer: MJPRU Bareilly admissions are both merit and entrance-based for respective UG and PG courses. For a few UG courses such as BA, BSc, BCom, etc., admissions are offered based on candidates' merit scores obtained in their last qualifying exam. Further, to get admission to courses such as LLB, MEd, MSc, etc., candidates have to qualify for the university-level entrance exam. For other UG and PG courses, Rohilkhand University accepts a valid scores of CUET UG and CUET PG entrance exams. Later on, the selected students are allocated seats via a counselling process. Read more about the detailed MJPRU admission process 2023,here.

faqs.question: Can I take direct admission at MJPRU?
faqs.answer: MJPRU admissions are either entrance or merit-based. Candidates have to qualify for the minimum eligibility criteria to apply for any of the UG & PG courses. For PG courses, MJPRU conducts the MJPRU entrance exam. Apart from that for courses such as BPharm, BTech, MBA, MCA, etc., the university accepts valid scores of JEE Main, CUET UG & CUET PG entrance exams. Further, for other UG courses, admissions are entirely based on the merit obtained in the previous qualifying exam.

faqs.question: How can I get LLM seat at MJPRU?
faqs.answer: Students who wish to getLLM seats at MJPRUmust follow the below-mentioned steps:1.Check the eligibility criteria. Only those who meet the eligibility criteria are considered for the selection process.2.If eligible, apply for theentrance test conducted by the university.3.After the exam results, the university releases the merit list based on entrance test scores.4.Based on this list, the seats are allocated. Those who get a seat must report to the institute.5.Pay the admission fee to secure the seat.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Khandelwal College of Management Science and Technology (KCMT)
reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good value for money campus I would say.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. The campus is full lush green with good classrooms and CCTV cameras almost in every class. The mess is somewhat okay, but the canteen is large with good quality items offered at affordable prices. A huge ground and sports equipment are available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Khandelwal College of Management Science and Technology (KCMT)
reviews.review_heading: It is good, especially value for money, and a good environment as well.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, the college is a full, lush green campus, and the college classrooms are not the best, but satisfactory. Wi-Fi is okayish, but having good labs and research, and a well-stocked library. Medical facilities are good for the students who suffer from any kind of problem or issue.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Roshan Lal Shanti Devi AcademyReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Disappoint of management.
reviews.review_text: College classrooms are average. It's a small college, you can't expect it to have world-class facilities. There are Wi-Fi facilities, but in the reach of only staff. Students are not given any access to the Wi-Fi. The canteen here only keeps ready-made food items like chip packets, sandwiches brownie, etc. The quality is average.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Khandelwal College of Management Science and Technology (KCMT)
reviews.review_heading: Placement is okay, this can be looked through if you value for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is well, there is a full good arena regarding sports activities and a good canteen which provides good food and items at affordable prices, but the hostel mess is not as good as it should be, and the quality of food is not all good as expected.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Future Institute of Management StudiesReviewed on 15 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Decent college with good academics, facilities and campus exposure.
reviews.review_text: The college has decent infrastructure for the students, staff, and departments. Classrooms are spacious, well-ventilated, and have basic teaching aids. The department has various computer labs and proper internet connections. The library is well stocked with books on different courses.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Government Raza Post Graduate CollegeReviewed on 15 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: I am not dissatisfied with the faculty and environment, but they can improve.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is old, it was built at least 50 years ago. There is no canteen inside. The classrooms are old, but the college is trying its best to renovate them. There is a library, which is great. There is also army-related training that is going on right now for the students who want to pursue it.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Khandelwal College of Management Science and Technology (KCMT)
reviews.review_heading: College is good and I am strongly satisfied with the faculty members. Environment is also developed.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. The college is a full lush green campus with well developed environment. A large canteen and labs are good, even experiments happen at times, when lab work is focused. Wi-Fi is okay. The library is big and a lot of reference books are available. Classroom is not as good as expected otherwise, games happen regularly.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Future Institute of Management StudiesReviewed on 17 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Nice faculty with great knowledge.
reviews.review_text: There are computer laboratory classes twice a week, and students enjoy a lot in the lab classes. Students gain great experience in programming and coding, which helps in boosting their knowledge and setting limitless boundaries for technical opportunities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Rajshree Institute of Management and TechnologyReviewed on 2 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It offers good faculty support and decent placements for the BBA students.
reviews.review_text: The campus is enabled with 24x7 Wi-Fi accessible in academic buildings, the library, and common areas. The speed is decent for academic tasks, online research, and project work. Labs are available depending on the course. Hostel rooms are clean and properly furnished. It has adequate lighting, fans, charging points, and basic amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Best University with NAAC A++  accreditation.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of the department are very good. Wi-Fi is not available in the classroom and labs are well maintained and library is also good. Quality of the hostel facility is good. The mess food is not good. Canteen does not work properly. Sports and games facilities are excellent.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Future UniversityReviewed on 19 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Thank you, Future University, for making my future bright and happy.
reviews.review_text: In Future University, many types of facilities are provided for students, such as a large library, computer labs, and pharmacy labs with important equipment and chemicals. The hostel quality is very good. The hostel management provides outdoor and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Average college needs better teachers. Placement programs and internships, but self-study is a must.

Hostel rooms are average, and washrooms need better cleaning. Mess food is okay. A medical room is available. The sports ground is present but not well-maintained.

reviews.review_text: We have labs, libraries, a very good model, and games, with a high quality of science. In my college, the hostel has a good token system, good food, and good facilities. So, we are proud of our college to describe the good things.

reviews_list.review_title: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.

review_content.Placements: Currently, the placements happening for us. In my senior batch, 90% of them were placed. Many companies come in looking for jobs, but most companies come in looking for employment and financial information. We had a great choice of dual specialisation, which made it easier for us to clarify what to do for the best placements. The roles offered were aeronautical engineer, laboratory technician, etc. Internships were offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

reviews_list.review_title: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.

review_content.Placements: There are 100 students in my course. The highest package is 5 lacs, and the lowest is 3 lacs. Others included several NGOs, schools, and coaching centers. The teaching role involved an internship in a government school. All students completed their internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

review_summary.college_name: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Affordable education with good infrastructure and below-average placement support.

content.Placements: I belonged to the B.Com (Hons) batch at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Lucknow. Placement opportunities are average. The highest package offered is around 4 LPA-5 LPA, the lowest package is about 1.8 LPA-2 LPA, and the average package stood at approximately 2.5 LPA-3 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies that visited the campus included TCS, Infosys (support roles), HDFC Bank, etc. About 40-50 percent of students managed to get internships mostly in banks. Many students also secured internships on their own through online platforms. The top roles offered are Accounts Executive, Junior Accountant, etc.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: College was pretty fine, value for money, but average compared to good media colleges.

content.Placements: Hardly 10% of students got placed. The highest package was 3.6 LPA, and the lowest was 2.2 LPA. Only 5 out of 50 students got placement, that too on the professor's personal favors and relations. So, you have to prepare and place yourself by searching for a decent job on your own, otherwise, it is tough here.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and labs were available, but we rarely had lab visits. The hostels were nice with average food. There were many hostels, only students from outside Uttar Pradesh got a hostel here, so be prepared for hostel and mess expenses if you are from Uttar Pradesh itself.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.

content.Placements: Currently, the placements happening for us. In my senior batch, 90% of them were placed. Many companies come in looking for jobs, but most companies come in looking for employment and financial information. We had a great choice of dual specialisation, which made it easier for us to clarify what to do for the best placements. The roles offered were aeronautical engineer, laboratory technician, etc. Internships were offered.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.

content.Placements: There are 100 students in my course. The highest package is 5 lacs, and the lowest is 3 lacs. Others included several NGOs, schools, and coaching centers. The teaching role involved an internship in a government school. All students completed their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Life Sciences - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Professors are very helpful in nature. It is a good university.

content.Placements: The batch is very good, there are 32 students in my class. The college faculty members do not allow us to do internships. In the last semester, there was a training program held by the university. The training programme is held by ICAR in Nainital. But they take money for this, and we go on to study tour in Uttarakhand.
content.Infrastructure: There is a very poor Wi-Fi connection, and the library is good. Classrooms do not have AC. In the hostel, the mess food is a disaster. The canteen is also not so good. Medical facilities are very fast but not so good. Sports and games are also available in this college. The central library is very good with full AC.

faqs.question: What is the admission policy of BBAU?

faqs.question: Is direct admission possible to BBA at BBAU?
faqs.answer: No, getting direct admission in BBA at BBAU without appearing in the CUET-UG exam is not possible at BBAU. BBAU being a public university follows the guidelines laid down by the Government of Uttar Pradesh, and for admission to any of the courses offered at BBAU, including BBA students, compulsorily need to take the CUET exam.Based on their CUET-UG score, applicants will be selected for the counselling process. reviews.review_heading: Affordable education with good infrastructure and below-average placement support.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is quite good and well spread across a large green campus. Classrooms for B.Com (Hons) are spacious and well-ventilated. The university has a central library with a good collection of commerce, management, and reference books along with reading halls. Wi-Fi facility is available on campus. Hostel facilities are decent with separate hostels for boys and girls. Rooms are clean and basic amenities like water and electricity are provided. T...

reviews.review_heading: College was pretty fine, value for money, but average compared to good media colleges.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs were available, but we rarely had lab visits. The hostels were nice with average food. There were many hostels, only students from outside Uttar Pradesh got a hostel here, so be prepared for hostel and mess expenses if you are from Uttar Pradesh itself.

reviews.review_heading: Best university for M.Sc. in physics course.
reviews.review_text: Hostel was nice and completely furnished with Wi-Fi and beds. The cuisine at the hostel was superb. The infrastructure of our lab was excellent. Our classrooms were tidy. Our college had digital classrooms. Hospital and eateries were beneficial. Our college promoted student participation in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a nice place with 24/7 library access.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The department had a library and a smart classroom, which was helpful for micro-teaching and simulated teaching. Most girls stayed in the hostel, while about 70% of the boys had to stay outside the campus. The food in the hostel was good.

reviews.review_heading: Professors are very helpful in nature. It is a good university.
reviews.review_text: There is a very poor Wi-Fi connection, and the library is good. Classrooms do not have AC. In the hostel, the mess food is a disaster. The canteen is also not so good. Medical facilities are very fast but not so good. Sports and games are also available in this college. The central library is very good with full AC.

reviews.review_heading: Good lush green campus and well-equipped library.
reviews.review_text: We have fully ventilated and Wi-Fi enabled classroom, computer labs, and library with all the relevant books for study. As for the hostels, they are very good in condition. The food in canteen is average. We also have a medical facility available for us. We have playground with all types of sports and one sports center for indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place for education. It has a good infrastructure, but there is a lack of placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a good infrastructure with pace and calmness. Every department has a Wi-Fi facility with good speed. All classrooms are also well-maintained and specially structured to prevent suffocation problems. It has good ventilation, a great library, etc.

reviews.review_heading: A college with attractive campus and helpful faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very excellent. Wi-Fi is also very good, and classrooms are fully AC. The library is also fully AC and Wi-Fi is available 24*7. Hostels are also very good, according to price. The mess and canteen food are far better than those at other colleges. There is a health centre in the university for students. Sports events are also organised at the university.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Central University, Lucknow.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are nice and clean, but the only demerit is that most people don't get a hostel as there is not a sufficient number of hostels. The rooms are okay, but not very good. Overall, the hostel facilities and mess are good, and you can expect a hostel if you are not close to the college.

reviews.review_heading: I hope for betterment soon.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are still lacking because this course is very new at the university. Hostels are pretty good, and the quality of food is also nice. There are many opportunities for a person if he or she is into sports. There are many clubs, and the library is one of the best in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with 80% placements in 2024. It has good staff members and professors.
reviews.review_text: We will get accommodation facility in form of hostels which is generally 2-3 seaters. Water, Wi-Fi, and electricity facilities are available for free. There is a fee of around Rs. 2,600 per semester for the hostel. Few hostels have a gym and common room with AC to study. Guest rooms for parents are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Some departments have good management but some do not. The college life is fun here.
reviews.review_text: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU) in Lucknow has areas that could be improved. The positive aspects are it is beautiful and green. Wi-Fi is available at departments and hostels. Some Classrooms are equipped with smart boards in some departments.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but placement and college life are not that good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of hostel is good. Wi-Fi is available all the time. Mostly books are available in library of our branch which are easily issued by students. Classroom conditions are good. Hostel food is also good and all sub-services are available in hostels. Lab equipment are not available in labs. Infrastructure is also not that good, it is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointed because of faculty and peer pressure of exams but satisfied with infrastructure 2025.
reviews.review_text: There is no such place which can be described as a lab. There is a dummy lab which contains a few computer systems, mainly used by professors, and most of them are faculty, so can't be used. The processors of computer systems can be compared with turtles. Hostels are fine enough to stay with the best facilities like geysers, water coolers, etc.

Wi-Fi: All the departments and buildings of the campus are installed with free Wi-Fi networks that every student can access using their unique login code and password.
