content.Placements: There are no placements from this college. The placement cell is also not working here. Here students are mainly preparing for any competitive exams. The placement cell has been inactive for many years. Companies do not visit the college to offer jobs. The only benefit we get is in preparing ourselves for any examinations.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good enough to survive. There is one separate study hall in every hostel building. The food in the mess is average, and the canteen is good here. Wi-Fi is available in libraries. The mobile network is not working in the hostel and classrooms.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Number 1 agriculture college.

content.Placements: The college has a specific placement cell office and they appointed one teacher as placement cell officer. But this office has not tried with lots of companies so there are very few job opportunities from this office. Only 1-2 companies come to college for interviews, and because of that, lots of students have to search for jobs on their own.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides hostel facilities to both boys and girl students. All of the boys get hostel rooms easily as compared to girls because the boys hostel is bigger than the girls hostel. Girls have to get higher grade marks to get rooms available in hostels. Cleaning in a hostel is good. A hostel is cheaper than that of a PG.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: India's Oldest and One of the Best Agriculture Colleges.

content.Placements: The College of Agriculture, Pune is a top government college in Maharashtra, so only top students are able to get admission to the college. So due to this, around 90-95% of students get placed in college. Around 240 students are in one batch per year. The college has a placement cell for placement opportunities, but few companies come to the college with low packages.
content.Infrastructure: The college has hostel facilities for boys and girls. Boys can easily get a room in the hostel by paying during the admission process. Hostel fees are around 6000 for one semester. The hostel also has a mess facility, which is run by the student body itself. The college library has a huge stock of books and newspapers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good Campus and Best Placements.

content.Placements: Between 50 to 60% of students were placed in this course. 2) Placement depends on the field; students in technology, pest control, agriculture business management, Ayurvedic medicine companies, and pathology have better job prospects.
content.Infrastructure: Competitive books are available. The college has a playground, gym, smart classes, labs, Wi-Fi, and clean hostels. There is security for both boys' and girls' hostels and throughout the campus. The college offers multiple games and extracurricular activities, including NCC enrollment and NSS activities.

individual_reviews.course: MBM in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The best government college for agribusiness management. Satisfied above expectations.

content.Placements: 1) A batch consists of 30 students, among which 80–90% get placed. 2) Packages range from INR 2.5 to 8 LPA for freshers. 3) Almost all of the reputed agri-input companies arrive for campus placements (Syngenta, Bayer, AgroStar, etc. ) 4) An internship is optional. Most of the students don't prefer doing it. Very few of them opt for it. 5) The roles offered may be sales officer, HRM, or marketing manager.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, Wi-Fi, comfortable chairs, etc. The computer lab is spacious and more than enough for the batch. The library is huge and houses books ranging from academics to non-curriculars as well. Hostel mess is average. The food is better than most of the canteens and more affordable. College has a huge ground. Inter-university sports keep happening. A gym facility is available.

individual_reviews.title: Good college, excellent teachers, and every year there is an annual function and sports meet.

content.Placements: If you do a master's degree, you could get a job in the teaching sector after graduation you can give government exams to get a good job, or you can do a master's degree and then a Ph.D. for lectureship, or you can apply to ICAR, ICMR, and other government institutes for internships.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology, Bhubaneswar.

content.Placements: Most of the students apply for civil services in Odisha. Many students getting selected for civil services from our college. Many banks like IDBI bank, Mother Dairy, Pradan, Srijan, Indian Potash Limited, Wassan, and MK Agrico visit our college. Top roles offered are AAO and ASCO.
content.Infrastructure: The college has Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned with digital boards. The library is big and clean. Hostels are neat and clean with tasty foods two times a day, lunch and dinner. The hostel doesn't have air-conditioner rooms. They clean and maintain the hostel on time.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Veterinary Science (BVSC) and Animal Husbandry (AH) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry - A Path Towards Your Dreams and Success.

content.Placements: This course, which I am pursuing, is Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (BVSc AH). Last year, 90% of the passing-out students from our college are doing service as Veterinary Assistant Surgeons in Odisha, and some opted for PG and higher studies in this college. The average salary offered here is 70,000. In internships, students are also paid.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. There are different buildings for different departments. All buildings are new and equipped with all facilities. There are smart classrooms with nice accommodation. Availability of Wi-Fi, advanced laboratories with recent new technologies, and a library with books on all subjects. There are also hostels for boys and girls. The food quality is of top level, with a restaurant-like taste. Free medical facilities for all. Different sports like cricket, volleyball, football, and badminton are available. Scope for NCC, NSS, and PE.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Not satisfied as my expectations were high, but the college is not as I expected it to be.

content.Placements: In Bhubaneswar, some students got placed, but in Chiplima Agriculture College, no one was placed because students don't want to work in private companies with a wage of 15,000 to 20,000. In our college, students are focusing on UPSC and banking-related examinations, and many students also get jobs every year. Many students are placed under OPSC as Assistant Agriculture Officers.
content.Infrastructure: In hostels, Wi-Fi is installed and in the college as well. Air conditioning is present in the classrooms, and smart boards are available for writing purposes. The hostel rooms are well-furnished with marble flooring and cupboards with a lock system provided. Each student is given a chair, study table, and bed by the college. In some rooms, one fan is provided, and in others, two fans are provided. Overall, the infrastructure is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Microbiology  - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College is very good in terms of quality of education.

content.Placements: College is good at providing internships. You will also get a scholarship here, no doubt. BSC and MSc degrees are both available here. Student union formation also takes place here so if a student is interested in a leadership program, he/she can start their career here also.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel takes little extra charge than other government colleges, but the quality of food is best here as they provide 3 to 4 days of non-vegetarian meals. And the hostel fees are also good and rooms are being cleaned here . New hostels are continuing to shift students from old to new.

admission_overview.college_name: OUAT Admission 2025: Eligibility, Application & Selection Criteria

paragraphs: Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology admissionis primarily entrance-based. The university offers an extensive range of courses in the fields of Agriculture, Science, Arts, Management, Technology, and more at undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. Students are offered seats based on their performance in the accepted national and state-level tests, such as ICAR AIEEA and Orissa SAMS. Students can apply at the admission portal of the university.Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology, also known asOUAT, offers more than ten courses across multiple specialisations. Interested students can read the following article to learn about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and admission process for the university.

Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology course admissionis subject to the fulfilment of the preset admission criteria. OUAT offers UG programmes such as BSc, BVSc, BTech and BFSc. Admission to all the UG programmes is based on the entrance test conducted by the University. For undergraduate course admissions, students need to complete Class 12 in a relevant field, whereas graduation is needed to enrol into the PG courses. Students must also appear for the accepted exams as selection is entirely entrance-based. Interested students can check out the following table to learn about the general eligibility & selection criteria forOUAT courses:

To get admission into Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology (OUAT), one must complete a multi-step process which starts with appearing for an entrance exam. The application process for the university mainly commences online.Students seeking to join the university are advised to go through the course details including the eamdission process before applying for the same. Candidates can follow the steps explained below to completeOUAT admission process:
Step 1: Entrance Examination

Interested students need to appear for the course-specific entrance test. The university accepts several national and state-level exams, such as ICAR AIEEA, OJEE, etc. Alternatively, students may also appear for the univeristy-level entrance test.
Step 2: Application

Once exam results are out, students may apply for the course of choice online. The process can be completed by registering oneself and providing the basic details. Students need to provide educational qualifications and other relevant information while submitting the form.
Step 3: Selection Rounds

Students are then selected based on several parameters, such as their academic performance, entrance exam scores, etc. A general idea forOUAT selection criteriacan be obtained from the table above for the popular courses:
Step 4: Seat Confirmation
Selected students need to go through document verification and pay OUAT admission fees to secure their spots at the university.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores does OUAT accept for admission to MBA?

Candidates must show up for a common entrance exam administered by the university in order to be admitted to the Ph.D. program.

Central Library, being part and parcel to the education and research system, is playing a vital role in the Orissa University of Agriculture and Technology (OUAT). reviews.review_heading: Review of Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology, Bhubaneswar.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned with digital boards. The library is big and clean. Hostels are neat and clean with tasty foods two times a day, lunch and dinner. The hostel doesn't have air-conditioner rooms. They clean and maintain the hostel on time.

reviews.review_heading: College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry - A Path Towards Your Dreams and Success.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. There are different buildings for different departments. All buildings are new and equipped with all facilities. There are smart classrooms with nice accommodation. Availability of Wi-Fi, advanced laboratories with recent new technologies, and a library with books on all subjects. There are also hostels for boys and girls. The food quality is of top level, with a restaurant-like taste. Free medical facilities for all. Different sports like cricket, volleyball, fo...

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied as my expectations were high, but the college is not as I expected it to be.
reviews.review_text: In hostels, Wi-Fi is installed and in the college as well. Air conditioning is present in the classrooms, and smart boards are available for writing purposes. The hostel rooms are well-furnished with marble flooring and cupboards with a lock system provided. Each student is given a chair, study table, and bed by the college. In some rooms, one fan is provided, and in others, two fans are provided. Overall, the infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good in terms of quality of education.
reviews.review_text: Our hostel takes little extra charge than other government colleges, but the quality of food is best here as they provide 3 to 4 days of non-vegetarian meals. And the hostel fees are also good and rooms are being cleaned here . New hostels are continuing to shift students from old to new.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the good teaching faculty.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides good hostel facilities with separate hostels for boys and girls. The hostel contains 24-hour hot water, and the food provided is good. We have a beautiful mess that can accommodate around 500 students. The infrastructure is good, and our department has separate blocks. The labs are well-equipped, and a library is also available, along with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Really satisfied with the faculty but not so much with the infrastructure. But it is getting better.
reviews.review_text:
The college has the availability of all basic facilities of classrooms, labs, a good library, and multiple other constructions for better facilities are going on. 
The hostel facility is good, with proper medical facilities available and proper space and competition for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus always encourages good studies.
reviews.review_text: In our college, they provide Wi-Fi and the latest technology installed in labs. Classrooms are digitalized and have AC-fitted rooms. In our hostels are developing now with new infrastructure. It will look like an old one, but the college is fully equipped with the latest technology, installed rooms, and mechanisms.

reviews.review_heading: College is best to explore.
reviews.review_text: The hostel offers excellent infrastructure, including well-maintained boarding facilities, high-quality food, and a reliable water supply. The boys' hostel provides free Wi-Fi, while some girls' hostels also offer this amenity. The college boasts well-equipped labs, a spacious central library, air-conditioned classrooms, and smart boards for interactive learning. Additionally, OUAT students and staff have access to a well-equipped hospital on campus. The college also provides various recreationa...

reviews.review_heading: Good for student life but no assurance of job.
reviews.review_text: The college and hostel infrastructure is good. The hostel and college are equipped with Wi-Fi. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. Classrooms are equipped with smartboards and projectors. All the classes are in AC. All the students were accommodated in the hostel. Both boys and girls hostels are available. The food is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for education.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned. Our campus has good environment. Laboratory is well-equipped. Mess is available. Canteen is very good. There is a dispensary on campus. Sports and games are conducted in this college. Wi-Fi is available in our college and hostel. There is a decent library in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. New buildings are being constructed for academic extension purposes. PG buildings are very good. There is no cafe in our college. Hostels are old. New hostels are good with study tables, chairs, dormitory, and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with this college because of its teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is spacious. Classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners. The library is a gem. Labs are average. Wi-Fi facility is not available in our college and hostel. The hostel is comfortable and hygienic. The food served in the mess is above average.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the campus and teachers, but there is a lack of recruitment from good company.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities available in our college. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Our labs are well maintained. Our classrooms are using digital modes of study. The central library has a large collection of books that students need. The hostel has good food service. Medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Depends upon a student career choice if he ar she wants to join the programme.
reviews.review_text: We have good electricity facility with good water supply. Wi-Fi facili is also there. Labs and classrooms are NEET and clean. Sometimes we suffer during summers due to maximum power cut. Mess food qyality is quite average, not so good and mostly depend on outside food. Medical facilities are available.

review_content.Placements: 5 percent of students get placed. The highest package is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.

review_content.Placements: Almost 70–80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. Recruiting organizations include some universities and hospitals. Roles offered are professor and physiotherapist roles in sports, neuro, musculoskeletal, and cardiovascular specializations. Many alumni start working abroad, and we have a wide range of options for how we want to work.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need improvement in all these areas.

overview_faqs.question: Is hostel fee refunded in case of admission cancellation at Jamia Hamdard?

review_summary.college_name: Jamia Hamdard Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.

content.Placements: About 70% student got placement. The highest package is 30 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Companies like Wipro, HCL, and some foreign companies recruit. Students got 100% internship roles like developed trainee and so on. My college fees are so high, about 9 lakhs too.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in International Studies and Global Politics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.

content.Placements: This is a new course in Jamia Hamdard. My batch is the second batch, so I don’t have any idea about placements, but the university also offers M.A. in this course as well as Ph.D. in this course. This course has good scope in India and especially outside.
content.Infrastructure: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.

content.Placements: 5 percent of students get placed. The highest package is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. TCS and Wipro are regular recruiting companies. 30 percent of students get internships in various companies like Infosys and TCS. Roles offered are software developer and web developer.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.

content.Placements: Almost 70–80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. Recruiting organizations include some universities and hospitals. Roles offered are professor and physiotherapist roles in sports, neuro, musculoskeletal, and cardiovascular specializations. Many alumni start working abroad, and we have a wide range of options for how we want to work.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need improvement in all these areas.

individual_reviews.course: BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Not the best but not the worst either.

content.Placements: As much as I have heard, the placement records are not very high. Teachers help in getting you placed, but it is your job to find a good job, and very few students get placed from the college itself. 30 percent of the students get placed maybe much less as specific records aren't mentioned. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2.8 LPA, and the average is 3 LPA-4.5 LPA. Several companies such as HCL, Tata, Coca-Cola, and others. From my course 70 percent of students got internships Roles that are offered are data analyst, customer executive, salesforce, managerial roles, etc.

faqs.question: Is Jamia Hamdard University under CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Hamdard offers admission to students on the basis of CUET entrance exam. The college will release the final merit list of the basis of scores obtained by the students in this exam. Candidates can check the official website for more information.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: Jamia Hamdard releases its recent admission guidelines or prospectus on the official website a the start of the admission for each academic year. Students must check the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria and follow the process. Admission to all the courses is either merit or entrance based. For instance, admission to the BTech and MBBS courses are subject to JEE Main and NEET UG exams, However, for courses, such as BCA, admission is subject to merit in Class 12 in the best of five subjects. Additionally,  the deemed-to-be University accepts CUET UG conducted by NTA for a few of its UG courses, namely BA, BA (Hons), BSc (Hons), BBA, BJMC and BCom.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff of Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: The cutoff for Jamia Hamdard University is the minimum marks that a candidate must achieve to get considered for admission to Jamia Hamdard University. The cutoff is diverse for each category and course. For example, the cutoff for the MBBS programme is quite different for General category students as compared with the OBC students. The cutoff marks and scores for Jamia Hamdard University are decided by quite a number of factors, including the total seats available for the students, the number of applicants, and the average scores of the various applicants. The cutoff is generally released after the results are released for the NEET. For cutoff-related details, please visit the official website of Jamia Hamdard University.

faqs.question: How to register for Jamia Hamdard admission for BA LLB?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking for admission to BA LLB at Jamia Hamdard must qualify for CLAT exam and wait for the result declaration. After the release of the final result, candidates must fill an online application on the official website of Jamia Hamdard University. Candidates can filll the Jamia Hamdard application form by using the following steps:Visit the official website of Jamia Hamdard, (jamiahamdard.ac.in).Under 'Admission & Examination' tab, select 'Online Admission Portal'.Click on 'Admission Open, Click Here to Apply'.Register with the basic details to generate login credentials.Login to fill out the application form and upload documents.Pay the application fee and submit the form.

faqs.question: What is the fees of Jamia Hamdard University for BA courses?
faqs.answer: The fee structure of the university include multiple components like hostel fee, tuition fee, alumni fund, library deposit, etc. Some of these components are one-time chargeable while some needs to be paid annually/semesterly. Jamia Hamdard fee varies from one BA course to another. The total tuition fee for BA courses ranges between INR 1 Lacs and INR 8.8 lakh . It must be noted that the given fee amount is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the fees of BPharm at Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: There are multiple components included in the total course fee, such as hostel fee, tuition fee, security deposit, and more. The total tuition fee for BPharm at Jamia Hamdard ranges between INR 5.8 lakh and INR 8.8 lakh . Inclusive of both regular BPharma and lateral entry programmes. Some of the fee components are one-time chargeable. While the tuition fee component has to be paid annually/semesterly. Students must note that the given fee amount is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the course fee for BSc at Jamia Hamdard University?
faqs.answer: Jamia Hamdard University BSc course fee is cumulative of various components, such as caution deposit, tuition fee, hostel fee, and more. These components are one-time chargeable or have to be paid annually/semesterly. The course tuition fee ranges between INR 3.3 Lacs - INR 4.2 lakh, one-time fee is INR 18,000 and the hostel charges range between INR 70,700 and INR 2.46 lakh. Some amount of the fee have to be paid after final selection for seat confirmation. Students must note that the gien fee is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. It is subject to change and hence, is indicative.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

reviews.review_heading: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need ...

reviews.review_heading: Not the best but not the worst either.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi service is available, but it rarely works, and data services are negligible here. A lot of issues arise because of that. Classrooms are normal college classrooms with no AC and old fans. The library is functional with a huge number of books but most are outdated. The hostel facilities are great with good rooms, AC, and water supply. The curfew time is 9:30 PM, and the food is a bit hygienic, but not that bad. The sports facilities are great with a huge ground available, and other sports eq...

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure, bad class management, no placements, but good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. Wi-Fi works only in specific places. Labs are okay, but water facilities and chemicals are missing, and equipment does not work. The hostel is good overall, and the food is good. Safety is a priority, and the hospital is nearby. There is a sports week, and the main focus is on sports and games too.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Hamdard Institute of Medical  Sciences And Research, New DelhiReviewed on 16 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a cute college with nice studies.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that great. Food is also okay, not very good, and not very bad either. Hostels are clean. College has an AC lecture theatre, library, and computer labs. Washrooms are nice. The college is overall not very big, but it has a cozy vibe.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Hamdard University review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are available for students, and a maximum of 60 students can be in a classroom. The library is also available to assist students. Safe and separate hostels with good hygienic food quality are available for boys and girls. Majeedia Hospital provides medical facilities, and sports grounds are available for games.

reviews.review_heading: Review by a CSE day scholar student.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classrooms are without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review by student living life on campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like classrooms are non-AC. Only the ground floor which are the LT classrooms are smart classes with AC and projector. Other classes also have projectors but without AC. The hostel is good with a lot of facilities like laundry, Wi-Fi and electricity all over. The mess is also good. The food is also good there.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the evergreen Jamia Hamdard University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is well-maintained. It has Wi-Fi, computer labs for doing editing on photoshops, Premiere Pro, Adobe software, and studios for news and radio. It provides a lot of hands-on workshops. The interior of the college where students sit is well-organised and has 99 names of Allah, where everyone feels peace alone at their free time.

reviews.review_heading: The college has supportive faculty, a room with solid placement, and is industry-ready.
reviews.review_text: Jamia Hamdard offers well-equipped laps, Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, a rich library diverse sports facilities, and so on. The campus has a hygienic mess and canteen, reliable medical services, and a sports complex for indoor and outdoor games ensuring holistic student development.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is so clean and green. It was not good in past 2010 but now it is so good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is provided on our campus like Wi-Fi and AC. Classrooms have desks and furniture. Especially every building has its own library. There are certain canteens also with good quality food. Boys and girls have separate hostels and hygiene is also good in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall the campus is beautiful teachers are helpful and cooperative, and the placements are okay.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi does not work properly and the college campus has jammers so cell internet doesn't work. Classrooms are getting better in facilities. There are overpriced snacks and food like coffee around 150ml is for Rs. 40 which is very helpful in summer. The campus events can be good if the management is done properly.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the campus, really good teaching staff and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The buildings are old. Well-equipped Labs and Classroom. The central library is the famous building of our college. The campus is very large and vast.  It has a hostel facility for girls. There are so many Pgs nearby. The food is very tasty. More than 6 canteens are there. A very sports complex is there with a Gym, basketball court volleyball, football, badminton, and tennis court.

However, there is no direct placement if you do M.Sc. in other subjects. The highest package is 3 LPA and the lowest is 1.5 LPA. This course does not have top offered roles and can be used in agriculture.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure here is good, and the environment is also pleasant. The hostel is well-maintained, and the canteen is good. However, very little attention is given to sports and games. The labs are clean, but the library is small, and there is no AC in the classrooms.

Applications for PRSU admissions are accepted via bothonlineandofflinemodes. For PG level course, such as MBA admission is based on various national-level entrance exam scores. Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University's admission process is inclusive of steps such as filling out application forms, qualifying for entrance exams and appearing for other selection rounds. Find below the detailed steps for the complete PRSU admission process:
Step 1: PRSU Application Process

To apply for any of the UG/ PG courses at PRSU, candidates have to fill an application form along with paying the application fee of INR 400. Pandit Ravishankar Shukla University accepts applications via bothonlineandofflinemodes. For an offline application, aspirants can visit the university campus and buy the admission form.
Step 2: PRSU Selection Rounds

PRSU admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For UG courses, candidates have to submit the scores of the last qualifying exams of their previous education. Whereas, for admission to PG and integrated courses, the university conducts its entrance exam. PRSU accepts valid scores ofCMAT/MAT/CAT/XAT/ATMAentrance exams for admission to MBA course.
Step 3: PRSU Counselling Process & Release of Merit List

After the completion of the selection rounds, PRSU conducts a counselling process. Later on, round-wise merit lists are released for candidates who get selected for the respective courses at Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University.

placement_data.title: PRSU Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: PRSU has yet to release its placement report for 2024, although the NIRF report for 2025 is now available. In the UG 3- yearprogram, 3 out of 8 students achieved placements. For the BPharma program, 16 out of 52 students secured jobs. In the PG 1-program, 40 out of 203 students were placed, while in the PG 2-year and PG 5-year programs, a total of 76 students found placements out of a total of 816 students.

The median salary for UG 3- year students was INR 2.60 LPA . For BPharma and MPharma , the median salaries were INR 3 LPA and INR 3.60 LPA , respectively. The PG 2-year course reported the highest median salary during PRSU placements was INR 4.55 LPA. The median salaries for PG 1-year and PG 5-year programs was INR 2.5 LPA and INR 3.25 LPA.

review_summary.college_name: College of Engineering Guindy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.

content.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students in Anna University Chennai got placements in good companies. The highest package is around 30 LPA to 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA to 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Anna University Chennai is good, and laboratories and libraries are available. They provide separate hostels for both boys and girls with free Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not bad. Average in taste. They give importance to sports as well as studies.

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Environmental Management - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I like hostel life more as college is strict.

content.Placements: The students from 3rd semester were eligible for placements. Companies like Toyota, EY, Micromax, Accenture, KPMG, Delliote, etc., will come to hire the freshers. The highest package offered was around 20 LPA, and the lowest package was around 4 LPA. The percentage of students getting placed was 70-80%. My plans after degree were to work for 5 years in an MNC.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus was good enough to accommodate 2500 students including two colleges as we had two colleges under the same campus. Blocks were different but common facilities were shared be it library, canteens, sports ground, or the perpetual seminar halls. We had plenty at our campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The pride in sharing the greatness of Asia's oldest college.

content.Placements: In our course last year, around 81% of students got placed. The remaining students opt for higher studies abroad. So the remaining students do not apply for placements. The students are being given an enormous number of opportunities for placements.
content.Infrastructure: It is the best infrastructure available among the government colleges. The standards and the fees that we pay are very different. Though the fee is low. The infrastructure is very good. The greenery of the trees within the campus gives a good feeling to stay.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My college is a 10 for those who prefer exposure rather than infrastructure.

content.Placements: 50% of students got placed in IT companies and manufacturing companies, mechanical sectors as well. Remaining students focused on building their own company, and some of them are getting into higher studies. The highest package known to me was 18LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Companies like TATA, Hyundai, Mahindra, CATERPILLAR, etc. Roles offered are mechanical, automobile, manufacturing, management, data analytics, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, but the maintenance is poor. Wi-Fi is available, but it lags sometimes. Medical facilities are good enough, and the food is also good. But there is no proper maintenance of restrooms and infrastructure. The canteen still doesn't have Epay, but it is still in development. Cleanliness is at its worst on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college with nice campus and social life.

content.Placements: 26 LPA is the highest package and 5.6 LPA is the lowest, and 6 LPA is the average. Associate engineer is the position offered. Caterpillar recruits more freshers here 70% of students are placed/in internships. The exact numbers are not known off-campus students are like 10.
content.Infrastructure: The campus life is lot enjoyable. There are lot of space to spend time inside campus, like clubs. Architecture classes are quite good. You can have Wi-Fi access on laptops for free. A wide range of sports are available. Two canteens are available. Hostel and mess food is decent.

reviews.review_text: The department has working labs and classrooms. There is a common library for all students within and outside the nearby campus. You cannot connect to data on your mobile within the department, but they will provide students with Wi-Fi that can be registered with your laptop. The quality of food is subpar in the international hostel. It is very repetitive. Housekeeping is prompt. The medical center closes by 5 pm, so in case of emergency, you have to visit Malar hospital nearby. Sports culture i...

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant Campus Life at CEG.
reviews.review_text: Even though our college is 200 years old, all the infrastructure is present and is very much available for students. But, we may not have a mobile network on the college campus. But there is Wi-Fi present all around the campus so it is very much helpful. Labs have very high facilities like the computers software required are very much pre-installed and ready to use. Hostels are affordable and manageable but still a bit of improvement is required.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, nothing negative as such.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure that is provided to us in our course is that we have access to Wi-Fi 24/7, labs, and also audio-video classrooms. The quality of the facilities that are provided to us in our hostel is really good, and the medical facilities are also really great.

reviews.review_heading: The best university with many facilities.
reviews.review_text: College facilities were good at our university. The infrastructure is very attractive. Our course provides Wi-Fi and a library that has books on all fields. The food quality in the mess is good. The hostel facilities are also good. Many sports events were conducted.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BSc at Punjabi University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for BSc Programmes offered at Punjabi University is between INR 8,060 to INR 4.80 lakh. Punjabi University offers BSc In various specialisations. The duration of the course is 3 years. Candidates who wish to take admission to these courses should fulfil the basic eligibility criteria. The basic criteria are that Candidate should have passed Class 12 with at least 50% marks in aggregate in any discipline. Punjabi University admissions are offered on the basis of merit in the qualifying examination and for some courses marks obtained in the entrance examination. The university conducts an interview for admission to every course.

Candidates who wish to take admission to these courses should fulfil the basic eligibility criteria. The basic criteria are that Candidate should have passed Class 12 with at least 50 percent marks in aggregate in any discipline. The Selection will be made on the 70 and 30 ratios. 70 percent weightage will be given to the qualifying examination and 30 percent to the aptitude test/Audition/Interview.

reviews.review_heading: Crazy campus Life, low study stress.

A big library and reading room on the campus. Every hostel has its own reading rooms. Mess food is affordable, and canteen food is ...

reviews.review_heading: The college helps provide practical knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities and infrastructure available, such as Wi-Fi for every hostel student, good classrooms, and a library. The quality of the hostel is also quite good. New hostels are being built for students. The food provided is liked by everyone, and I like it too.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: It has almost all kinds of facilities, good water, all labs have AC, the lecture hall has projectors, and the library area is good. The quality of food is average, but it has a canteen, Wi-Fi in the hostel too, and medical facilities all the time, and time to time events for hostelers at least once a year have been done.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2021Offered by Mata Gujri CollegeReviewed on 2 Oct 2025)

Libraries were like a mini knowledge hub with maximum collections of books and also available with soft copies which should be accessible by all the students studying in the college. The special access card for visiting libraries and laboratories was provided to all the students.

reviews.review_heading: This is my favorite university.
reviews.review_text: We are provided with all facilities on the campus, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, library, etc. The hotel facilities include AC rooms, RO Water, Wi-Fi, etc. The quality of food is poor. It is anyway, and the canteen is not even compulsory. We have infrastructure facilities for sports and games as well.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Lamrin Tech Skills UniversityReviewed on 18 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Overall average experience with decent facilities, basic placements, and scope for improvement.
reviews.review_text: All the basic facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are available, and they serve the purpose well. The hostel and mess also cover the basic needs, the food is manageable, and the canteen options are also too. Medical support, sports, and games are provided, though somewhere the infrastructure lags.

reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is best. There is so much garden greenery. One drawback in my college is that there is no Wi-Fi in the college, and also not in the hostel. If I am talking about food, then it is also average, not so good, not so bad. Can be eaten and survive.

reviews_list.review_title: PGDM in retail management at JIMS Rohini.

review_content.Placements: I joined PGD in Retail Management at JIMS Rohini and got so much industry exposure. reviews_list.review_title: Review of Jagan Institute of Management Studies, Rohini.

reviews_list.review_title: A complete review of JIMS Rohini.

review_content.Placements: Placements are average. Major companies come for sales roles, and finance jobs are limited. HR jobs are almost nil. Anyone can expect an average package of 7 LPA.

course_faqs.answer: The total fee of PGDM is INR 10.75 lakh at JIMS Rohini. This fee excludes life time alumni membership fee and refundable security deposit. CAT qualified students can opt for scholarship.

course_faqs.question: Is CAT scholarship applicable on all PGDM fee instalments at JIMS Rohini?
course_faqs.answer: CAT qualified students get a scholarship of INR 50,000 only if they meet the criteria. Students must secure 80 percentile in CAT and a minimum of 70% aggregate in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation. A partial fee waiver is applicable on second, third and fourth instalments.

hostel.description:
JIMS Hostel is located within 4 kms of radius from the institute, the hostel for boys provides excellent facilities for dining and sports area and well connected through public transport. The girls' hostel has 32 double occupancy rooms and 3 single occupancy rooms. The allocation of rooms is done on the basis of seniority and academic performance of the students. Hostel facilities include boarding, lodging and mess services.
The institute provides well-furnished hostel facility exclusively for males and females. The aim of the hostel is to make it a home away from home. It has spacious rooms with windows opening into balcony, other facilities include common room and dining room, Apart from the infrastructural soundness, it provides sufficient scope for interaction and relationship-building. It provides a congenial atmosphere that gives the new students full scope to know their seniors, learn from them, leverage their knowledge and build lasting relations with them. It is also a common sight to find study groups and project groups working away into the night in the hostel rooms. These interactions play an especially important role in a student’s life during placements and examinations.
facilities: Conference Rooms - The conference rooms are there to provide the necessary space for interactive and also experiential learning. The students participate in a large variety of activities that are designed specifically to enhance their skill sets

Auditorium - The college has 2 auditoriums on the campus. A large no. of activities can be hosted here. The auditorium provides a collaborative space for various students to interact with and also to get inspired by the visiting guests
Amphitheater - The amphitheater is a space for various student activities, fostering collaboration and creativity

Hostel and cafeteria - The college provides comfortable hotel facilities for male and female students. The hostels have spacious and well-ventilated rooms with a window and also a balcony. The college provides healthy and also fulfilling meals for students to ensure students are always fit and also energetic.

library.description: JIMS has two well stacked and fully equipped libraries separately for management and information technology programmes. The institute subscribes to a large number of national and international magazines, periodicals, journals and research paper of repute. The libraries also have reputed software packages of several journals. As a matter of policy, the institute pays special attention not only to strengthening the library with additional books and journals, but also to ensure that they are utilized well by the students both for their courses as well as to extend the frontiers of their general knoweldge. Audio and multimedia versions of some course modules are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good; its infrastructure and faculty are all good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average, not too good, but their classes and library are good. The only problem with the infrastructure is that their buildings are very small. There is a canteen which is also very small. Labs, classrooms, and the library are good, but the buildings are very small.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jagan Institute of Management Studies, Rohini.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very average. The campus is small. All the other facilities like the number of floors, and canteen have a very small space. There is no ground for sports for the students. The crowd is quite high during events which leads to overcrowding.

reviews.review_heading: PGDM in retail management at JIMS Rohini.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is compact but it has all the facilities. There are retail labs, where we learn how retail operations work. We have smart classrooms and two libraries with many books related to retail management. Wi-Fi all around the campus. We also have Nescafe and canteen to hang out with friends.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jagan Institute of Management Studies, Rohini.
reviews.review_text: They have a third party hostel not their own. Courses are up to date according to recent industry needs. Courses help with industry needs and requirements. They have good labs and classrooms with a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus. The campus is engaging neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: A complete review of JIMS Rohini.
reviews.review_text: The campus size is a big downside of this college. It is small. It has no cricket ground. However, the computer labs are good, sufficient, and helpful. The college also has a huge library with a large collection of books, which would be helpful for you.

reviews.review_heading: College review of JIMS, Rohini.
reviews.review_text: Campus is overall good but campus size is small. But the environment is quite well on campus. There are many sustainable features attached to the building. Playing ground is limited. They have underground indoor games like table tennis and treadmills.

reviews.review_heading: An absolute fun learning journey to be in.
reviews.review_text: All facilities one can expect are already there including Wi-Fi, labs, and digital classrooms. The hostel needs improvement in the mess, sports, and games. There is a gym but with very little to no equipment and no games present as such. The college is good but the only problem is non-residential hostels as it would be great if we only get a residential hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with college. A good option to boost your career.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure provided by college is good. It has a big library with a huge collection of books based on various subjects. Library also has laptops through which we can access the internet. The college also has a good computer lab.

reviews.review_heading: A good decision to take admission for PGDM in JIMS Rohini Sector 5 .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very limited; the campus is very small compared to other JIM's colleges, but all the facilities are there. Wi-Fi for students, labs, smartboards, a 2-floor library, a well-maintained park, 1 small basketball court, 1 fairly big indoor carrom and table tennis court, and 3 canteens. The hostel provided by the college is good, and the quality of food they offer is also good. If you don't like any meal, you can share the feedback, and they will listen to that feedback and improve a...

reviews.review_heading: I absolutely recommend this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very nice. We have smart classrooms, a very nice library, labs, canteens with good quality food, medical facilities, Wi-Fi, etc. We have all the facilities required. The campus is clean, and we have little space for sports as well, but we usually have our sports events organized outside the college.

reviews.review_heading: Unexpectedly excellent faculty, decent ROI, regular extracurriculars, and good college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really well maintained. The library, labs, and classrooms are nice, as are the food court and canteen provided, which are also really good and have an ambiance to them. Hostel facilities are really excellent, and staff as well as the boys hostel warden is really friendly and helpful, except the location of the hostel; everything else is perfect. In sports, indoor facilities are nice, but outdoor games are limited.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money and great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped. We have two libraries with tons of resources. There are modern classrooms. The canteen is great to catch up with friends and relax during break. Overall, the infrastructure makes campus life enjoyable. The college organizes an annual sports event which is an enriching experience. Hostels are off campus. The quality of food in the mess is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: I personally like that JIMS Rohini offers excellent resources and support.
reviews.review_text: JIMS has a well round infrastructure that supports both academics and student life. There 2 well - stocked libraries and 2 auditorium for events and seminars. The campus also have cafeteria and food stops which is perfect for relaxing between classes. There is also a hostel for both girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college in terms of return on investment.

All facilities are available for studying but there is no more exposure to extracurricular activities.
Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls. If I talk about hostel amenities, food is good, but the building of the hostel is away from the college; besides, the college provides bus service to pick up and drop off students.

faqs.answer: A:    The total amount of SoM PDEU MBA fee for both the years INR 11.55 lakh. faqs.answer: A:    Yes, PDEU accepts scores of CAT entrance exam for its MBA course. Candidates who have valid score of CAT can apply on the official website of SoM PDEU. Apart from this, the institute also accepts scores of other entrance exams such as XAT, MAT and NMAT. A total of 60% weightage is given for the entrance exam in the entire selection process. Candidates are able to proceed for futher rounds, only after the submission of the scores of respective entrance  exams.
faqs.question: Is CAT accepted for MBA at PDEU?

faqs.answer: A:    For admission to a two-year MBA course at SoM PDEU, candidates have to meet the basic educational requirements as per the course. To be eligible to apply for MBA programme, candidates must complete graduation with at least 50% aggregate in all semesters/ trimesters or equivalent CGPA.There is a relaxation of 5% in the aggregate for reserved category candidates. They have to get 45% aggregate as the minimum requirement for the course. Aspirants appearing for the final year semester exam of bachelor's degree or equivalent can also apply provided they score at least 50% aggregate in all semesters/ years.

courses_data.description: SoM PDEU offers full-time PhD to regular or sponsored students. Admission to PhD course is based on Written Aptitude Test and a personal interview/viva-voce round.

faqs.question: What is the selection criteria for PhD at SoM PDEU?
faqs.answer: School of Management, PDEU selects candidates for PhD programme based on Written Aptitude Test conducted by the school. WAT shall consist of 50% weightage on research methodology and 50% weightage on subject specific questions. Aspirants with 50% or more in WAT are further required to appear for personal interview or viva-voce. 70% weightage is given to entrance test and 30% to performance of the aspirants in the personal interview round for admission.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for PhD at SoM PDEU?

Hostel rooms are spacious with proper facilities. No infrastructure problems were faced except the chairs and Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: The students who want to do MBA in marketing can join the college, but others, please don't join.
reviews.review_text: The whole PDPU campus has Wi-Fi facility, classrooms are sufficiently big that an entire batch can sit in a class. Good benches, chairs, a projector and screen are available in the classrooms. A library with more than 14,000 books is available. Medical facilities are not proper as there is one doctor in the campus of 4000 students. Sports grounds for football, cricket, and volleyball are properly developed. Canteen food is good, but the mess food is not much good during dinner time. Hostel rooms...

reviews.review_heading: Best University for Petroleum Management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of PDPU is best. It is situated in Gandhinagar and in very peaceful and green place. Campus is having all high tech facilities in it. We have various sports grounds and pitchs, best library and large classrooms in our campus. Canteen of PDPU is also very best, it serves quality food to all. Hostel Rooms are also very much good which are having all the facilities which are required.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure, events in the college and also good placement.
reviews.review_text: It is located in Gandhinagar, the capital of Gujarat. PDPU is an impressive campus, spread over of about 50 acres and offers necessary infrastructure of the world-class institutes. It helps to expand the opportunities for students as well as professionals to develop intellectual knowledge base with leadership skills.

reviews.review_heading: Placements lower than expected.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great, and there is no problem. All the facilities are available in the college. The classrooms are very good with comfortable chairs, projectors, blackboard and fully air-conditioned. The quality of the food in a mess is good in the afternoon, but dinner is not good. It is 3 km inside of the main road, so if you have to go out, you have to go all the way 3 km as there are no shops inside for eating. Events are regularly conducted by the cultural committee.

reviews.review_heading: SPM-PDPU is good in placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities offered to the students by the college are good. The campus is WiFi enabled and is available all the time. All types of issues and queries regarding labs as well as classrooms are solved within 24 hrs of complaint. Food provided in the canteen is good, and the supervisors always take feedback from the students regularly and try to improve according to the requirements. The hostel rooms are spacious and well equipped.

reviews.review_heading: Great institute with great exposure towards the management, perspective of teaching.
reviews.review_text: The Campus has a very good infrastructure with highly equipped classrooms. SPM provides projectors ACs and other technical requirements along with state of the art facilities. The campus provides high-speed internet facilities. The library has been an integral part of SPM campus which has been a boon.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money. Excellent place for energy sector.
reviews.review_text: Entire PDPU campus is Wi-Fi zoned. JIO supports it. So you can enjoy the high-speed internet. The library has a full range of book from management to philosophy, operations, finance and every other subject. We have a rich collection of periodicals and magazines. Almost all good newspaper are provided. If there is some book which is not in the library we just need to give application, the book will be provided in a 1-2 week. Also, there is a separate library for the school of technology, school ...

reviews.review_heading: Experience at SPM - one of the most memorable one
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is one of the best among top management colleges. Our PDPU University has been known for its world-class infrastructure with all the requirements a student can ask for.
With sports ground to gym to swimming pool to classes, all have been best equipped.
A student never has to leave the university to find something as everything is available on campus.

individual_reviews.title: It is the best university for the M.A. in Education course.

content.Placements: Approximately 60 percent of the pupils got placed. The greatest compensation offered was around 12 LPA. Cuemath, Extramarks Education, Board Infinity, and other prominent employment firms were examples of recruiters. The minimum pay was 3 LPA, with an average of 7 LPA. Only around half of the students got internships with reputed companies. There were various high-level jobs available, including policy analyst and school counsellor.
content.Infrastructure: Although the housing and facilities were adequate, students had Wi-Fi problems. Everything was provided, and labs were top-notch. The classrooms were air-conditioned. The library, which had air conditioning and a large collection of books, was also excellent. The restaurants and dispensaries in the mess were not good, but the food was adequate.

content.Placements: As far as things concerning the UG course, too many companies don’t come for placement. No internships are provided during our college tenure. At last, some companies came like TCS, Accenture, Tech Mahindra, etc. The average placement offered was 2.5 LPA. They offered call center jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Everything like infrastructure and buildings was quite good, but there was no Wi-Fi available at our time on college campuses, nor in the library. The hostel food was not too good, not too bad; it was less than average. Wi-Fi was available in the hostels, but the connectivity was not so strong. Sports and games were given top priority. There is a lot of scope for sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Sc. B.Ed in Chemistry - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Campus of dreams ravenshaw university .

content.Placements: I am Subrata Pradhan. I started my integrated B.Ed course in chemistry in November 2022. 100 students were admitted during admission, and we are currently pursuing the 4th year of B.Ed. After completion, we will be placed. Our seniors got placed in different schools such as JNV, KV, OAV, and other state board schools. This course is job-oriented if you want to join as a teacher after completion. I am very proud to be a Ravenshawvian, and our seniors revolted and went on strike for job placement because, before that, JNV was not acknowledging our degree.

paragraphs: Ravenshaw University admission 2025is both merit and entrance-based. The university accepts CPET, OJEE, and other entrance-exam scores for admission to specific courses. Ravenshaw University offers UG, PG and doctoral-level courses in the field of Arts, Commerce, Management, Science and Software & IT, namely BSc, BA, BCom, BBA, BSc, MSc, MA, MCom, and PhD. Admission toRavenshaw Universityis conducted in online mode via SAMS, Odisha. Interested students need to visit the official website SAMS for the same. Before applying for admission, aspirants must check the course-specific eligibility requirements.

Ravenshaw University conducts courses in full-time mode at UG, PG and doctoral levels. Aspirants have to apply for the preferred course on the official website of the university. Some of the popular courses of the university are MBA, BBA and BCom. Below are the key highlights forRavenshaw University admissions:

The university begins the admission process with the opening of a registration portal. Candidates need to apply for the preferred programme before the deadline for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in the university:
STEP 1: Ravenshaw University Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online. Candidates can apply for a course with the link available on the official website of the university. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 500 for all professional UG courses. The application fee for PhD is INR 1,500.
STEP 2: Selection

Ravenshaw University selects candidates for BA (Hons), BBA, BCom, etc. based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. Besides, the university also accepts CPET and OJEE for admission to specific PG courses. Ravenshaw University also conducts RET for admission to the PhD programme.

Once the selection process is over, aspirants are informed about their admission. Selected aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

overview_faqs.question: Is Sambalpur University good for B.Tech?
overview_faqs.answer: Sambalpur University is decent University for B.Tech. It was established in 1967 and it is accredited by NAAC as 'A' grade University. The institute offer B.Tech in various branches like Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics and Communication engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, etc. The median package offered to the students pursuing B.Tech was INR 4.52 LPA during the 2023 campus placement drive. The university offers a blend of highly qualified faculty, state of art infrastructure, fair placement record, industry required academic curriculum and many more.

review_summary.college_name: Sambalpur University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college is an under-average college.

content.Placements: Our college is a government degree college. The placement facility is very poor, no students can be placed in a company, but our college provides internships for the students, Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 7,000 per month. I want to be a lecturer, so I continue my studies in Physics.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not so good in our college, only 2 buildings are provided for students' education. No hostel facility is provided by the college authority, and all students are day scholars. But the college authority provided a good Wi-Fi facility to all students, and labs are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Overall, GMU's fee structure, infrastructure, hostels and campus are very good.

content.Placements: I am pursuing B.Com, and in our batch, there are about 400 students. Nearly 10 percent of students have been placed by the university. The highest package was something around 3-5 LPA, and the lowest was 1-1.5 LPA. The top companies that are associated with GMU are Infotech, ICICI, Wipro, HDFC, Infosys, etc. About 10-12 percent of students have been placed in companies like HDFC and ICICI from our batch.
content.Infrastructure: The GMU in itself has a very good infrastructure, which gives positive vibes. As you enter the GATE of GMU, you'll SEE a blend of infrastructure and nature which holds the feeling of satisfaction. Talking about other facilities, there are classes with a smart board facility. This gives students a great learning experience. Moreover, there are ACs and Wi-Fi available in class. The library of GMU is also very big. You can grab any book and start studying. The library is open from 9 am to 5 pm. Talking about hostels, there are 5 hostels in GMU, each one with good water and food facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Government College, Rourkela.

content.Placements: The placement in our course or college is significant. Our college offers only basic courses, not vocational, so no active placement cell is present. Some students find internship offers by themselves. Career opportunities are Accountant, Auditor, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are average. The classroom is dirty, with bird dung. The library is present in the college. Basic medical facilities are available on the campus. The canteen was not in the college. Sports and games are not played.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I'm not satisfied in this college.

content.Placements: The placement in this college is very poor. There is no proper management regarding the placement in this college. There is a placement cell in college but they do nothing. We have to do hard work to get internship in the college. Seniors also get placed by their own hard work.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in this college is very poor. There is nothing in this college. The classrooms are not good as per the students. Library is very small and also the subject books are not available. Main problem comes with the hostel. The hostel mess area is very dirty. Not looking like a hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great 4 Years, major stress.

content.Placements: Placements for our batch are surprisingly good, honestly better than the hype. The training programs are really helpful, especially the workshops on aptitude tests and group discussions. They make a huge difference. Most people in my core branch got an offer. The big companies look for a high GPA, so don't fail to keep your scores up even in the fun subjects. The Placement Cell is kind of slow sometimes with paperwork, but they get the job done eventually.
content.Infrastructure: The campus looks great on the brochure and in person. Our department labs are fully equipped, and they actually upgrade the software every year, which is essential for our course. The classroom projectors are always working, which is a miracle. The hostel is decent, not luxury. Rooms are okay, usually shared by three, but the Wi-Fi is spotty in the evening. The mess food is the biggest letdown. It's edible but so boring. We all chip in for a monthly pizza night to survive. They have good sports facilities, though, like a massive cricket field, which is a plus.

paragraphs: Sambalpur University admission isprimarilyentrance-based. The university provides programmes at the UG, PG, diploma, PhD and certificate levels in Humanities & Social Sciences, Science, Arts (Fine/ Visual/ Performing), Business & Management Studies, Engineering, Law and IT & Software.Sambalpur Universityprovides programmes in regular and distance learning modes. The university also offers various self-financing courses.

Sambalpur University provides extensive range of courses through its various affiliated colleges. Students can opt for the desired course after they clear the admission criteria. The admission and application process of the university can be done online as well as offline. See the table below for Sambalpur University highlights:

The university's admission has multiple steps. Students looking to get in must fulfil the eligibility as per the university's admission guidelines. The admission process is mainly online, however, students can also send the downloaded form to the university's campus. See the pointers below forSambalpur University admission process:
Sambalpur University Application Process

Candidates can go to the website of the university and apply by submitting the application form online. To submit the form offline, students have to submit the completed application form to the university in person.
Sambalpur University Selection Process

Students are shortlisted based on various factors, like, entrance exam scores, academic scores, etc. The university accepts a valid score for various national and state-level entrance exams, like OJEE, JEE Mains, etc. Furthermore, Sambalpur University also conducts the SUET exam. For some of the courses, the university also considers student's performance in the written test, career mark, work experience (for E-MBA) performance test, etc.
Sambalpur University Admission Confirmation
Shortlisted students who meet the Sambalpur University cutoff need to pay the admission fee and go through document verification for admission confirmation.

faqs.question: Does Sambalpur University refund fees?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sambalpur University does refund fees in certain circumstances. The university mentions that fees once deposited shall not be refunded in any circumstance except caution money. The one-time caution money is refundable online after completion of the course. Every student must open a Saving Bank Account in the State Bank of India to claim the caution money. If the caution money is not claimed within three years from the date of completion of the course, the claim for the amount shall automatically stand forfeited.

reviews_list.review_title: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.

review_content.Placements: The highest package last year, 2024, was 1.45 crores, and the average package was almost 11.5 LPA. Almost every company has different roles offered here at the college. The placements record of this year has not come out as per true strength, but it is expected that the placements are more or less the same as the previous year.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable.
