review_summary.college_name: BIT Mesra Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA

content.Placements: In my course at BIT Mesra, about 65–70 percent students get placed consistently, but from the past few years it has dropped slightly. The highest package is 19 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA, and an average of 7.5–8 LPA is common. There are many top companies like Google, Microsoft, and a lot of core companies which visit the campus consistently. 60 percent of students get internships in core companies and tech companies. Roles include site engineer, design engineer, quantity surveyor, trainee engineer, and roles in structural, geotechnical, transportation, and environmental engineering.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 75% of students were placed in Civil this year. The highest package was around 16 LPA, the median package was around 8 LPA, and the lowest package was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include IOCL, Deloitte, Accenture, Hindalco, TATA, etc. Top roles include structural engineer, project manager, and urban planner.
content.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.

content.Placements: The highest package last year, 2024, was 1.45 crores, and the average package was almost 11.5 LPA. Almost every company has different roles offered here at the college. The placements record of this year has not come out as per true strength, but it is expected that the placements are more or less the same as the previous year.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.

content.Placements: Nearly 60-80 percent of my courses were placed last year. The highest is 50 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is around 15 LPA. Oracle, Infosys, Texas Instruments, Intel, Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Atlassian, etc. The roles offered are SDE, hardware engineer, network engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, but only recommend for branches like CSE and AIML.

content.Placements: Placement in AIML is similar to CSE, almost all companies allow students to sit in AIML. Till now, 40-50 percent of students are placed. The highest package is around 28 LPA, with an average of 16 LPA. In CSE, around 70 percent of students get placed, with an average package of around 16 LPA-18 LPA. Around 80 percent of students get placed.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, but there are some restrictions, like the game website is blocked, and the mess food is average, like in a week they give 4-5 good meals. The hostel room is quite small, not for 2 people. The classroom is good with proper projectors. Free medical facilities are also available sports facilities are also good.

hostel.description: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra is completely residential with eleven hostels for boys and three separate ones for girls. All student lodging houses are spacious and beautifully laid out amidst a lot greenery. Each male-student is provided with well-furnished single-accommodation while girls share their accommodation in spacious and adequately furnished rooms. Individual rooms are constructed in a row with a wide veranda for common use running along the length of passage. Common facilities at the hostel include dining halls and common rooms with provision for several indoor games. The reading room in each hostel subscribes to a large number of magazines, periodicals and newspapers. The entertainment hall in each hostel has a color television set. Each hostel has an independent mess, completely run and managed by the students themselves. The hostels are a hub of leisure activities. Students are encouraged to pursue a wide range of extra curricular activities and hobbies in their free time and events both entertaining and competitive are arranged quite frequently. Inter-hostel tournaments of indoor and outdoor games, quizzes, competitions and adventure trips are very popular at BIT Mesra. The 'Hostel Night' organized by resident students is a memorable yearly event where students interact with the faculty members amidst cultural programmes and a lot of fun in a shared mood of festivity.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is well maintained, and the placements are good, with the average being 11–12 LPA
reviews.review_text: Many equipment in the labs are damaged but still being used. The Wi-Fi connection is very good, giving a high-speed network of up to 100 Mbps. The library is quite disappointing as books are in bad condition and there are not enough facilities, and there is no AC in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled (around 150 Mbps if you get a strong signal). The hostel Wi-Fi works well most of the time, but sometimes it goes down. The food varies hostel-wise. It is better than other colleges (you won't find insects and all in your food daily).

reviews.review_heading: Good college, hostel facility avg, placements are avg, and lush green campus.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are good, but the water in the bathrooms is hard. The hair feels oily after a bath, and despite having a water purifying setup at Mesra, the drinking water is not up to that standard. The Wi-Fi here is not reliable. Sometimes it gets cut due to unnecessary reasons, and gaming on hostel Wi-Fi is restricted. You can't play any game here unless you find a solution. The food quality is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Used to be good, but now it's doomed.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is good, but is restricted to a limited number of sites. Labs aren't maintained regularly, and the classrooms are enough to accommodate, but not all the teachers are well-equipped to tech. The library is good, but the environment there isn't good. The hostel is just bad. The food is bad. The rooms that are meant to be for one person are currently given to two students.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but only recommend for branches like CSE and AIML.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but there are some restrictions, like the game website is blocked, and the mess food is average, like in a week they give 4-5 good meals. The hostel room is quite small, not for 2 people. The classroom is good with proper projectors. Free medical facilities are also available sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good Wi-Fi connection inside the campus, like in the hostel, classrooms, and labs. The classrooms are very clean, with AC, projectors, and well-ventilated. The labs are also good. We have a lab for every course. The hostels are neat and clean. Every day, the hostels are cleaned and the washrooms also, but the hostel rooms are to be cleaned by the students after that particular room.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with above average placement for both circuit and non-circuit branches.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi inside the campus is good, high-speed, but it fluctuates a lot, sometimes it gives 150 mbps and other times it goes down to kbps, so it's unpredictable. Labs have all the required equipment available, some equipment does need changes, and it is either broken or old, but overall, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in CSE are good, but for ECE, they are the worst. Good coding culture in college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are very small. In the first year, hostel rooms are still big, but from the second year, their size is very small. In a room, 2 students are present, which is something that I don't like about this college. There are also some three-sharing rooms in the hostel, and they are pretty good, but only a few students get them. Wi-Fi is average, like those students whose rooms are in the corners of the hostel didn't get much access to Wi-Fi. Classrooms are 10/10, like they are very good. La...

reviews.review_heading: A very good college but you have to spend 10 lakhs in 2 years.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, it is having large number of books. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Boys hostel is 4 to 5 km away from the college. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided are as follows: 5G Wi-Fi available 24/7, classroom projectors with centralized air conditioning, a very large library with all types of books available, hostel mess food above average, and night canteen available in each hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I will recommend Birla Institute of Technology Mesra.
reviews.review_text: The food menu is decided by the student body living in that. Home-like food in some hostels, like H5, is great. Any problem, we have Dean sir, for student affairs. If anyone is behaving rudely, you can talk to sir, and you do not need any other proof.

reviews.review_heading: Placement varies every year. Infrastructure and environment are good. Faculty depends on the course.
reviews.review_text: Management is questionable but the infrastructure is quite good. Hostel rooms are kind of small for two students but you will get used to them in no time. The Wi-Fi is available all around the campus so its a plus point. Sports facilities are decent. Dispensary provide free medicine.

reviews.review_heading: I am neither dissatisfied nor satisfied, but happy with what I got.
reviews.review_text: The campus is big, but it has great potential to be one of the greatest campuses in India. Many places on the campus are only trees, and all that's good because the AQI is good on the campus. Still, there are places where much infrastructure can be built.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for circuit courses in B.Tech and for mechanical engineering only.
reviews.review_text: The library, playgrounds, and classrooms are good with AC and smartboards. Hostels aren't that good, with quite small rooms, but we would adjust. Food in the mess is okay, and Wi-Fi is decent. Labs are all well-equipped, and we won't face any problem regarding that. Apart from that, the campus is very beautiful and pollution-free with a lot of trees.

reviews.review_heading: The college is satisfactory with above-average sports facilities and curriculum in QEDS.

reviews_list.review_title: Amity University Gurgaon B.Tech CSE review.

review_content.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in CSE from Amity University, Haryana. In our current batch 2025, many students who appeared for placement have relevant skills get placed in their placement session. The highest package is around 15 LPA above, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA - 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, TCS, Yamaha, and many startups. Role offered is software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. You can also make a good connection here. There are only few places where you can get Wi-Fi. Library is one of them and college classrooms are air-conditioned. Hostel is overall good with good facilities for hostel mess. There are 2 messes at Amity and many other outlets for food. Amity has a very big sports complex timing is 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM only.

review_content.Placements: 100% of students got placed in this course. The average salary is 3 LPA to 5 LPA. review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 80-85% of the students are placed in my senior year while they are still attending classes, and with a very decent and respectful package. Recruiting companies like Medanta, Fortis, Paras, and Sri Gangaram Hospital. We have a 6-month internship in the last semester in a community setting at Medanta and Civil Hospital, Gurugram. Top roles offered are staff nurse, operation theatre nurse, and availability to higher courses.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.

paragraphs: Amity University Gurgaon admission is a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to various courses of the university must apply at the official website. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling out the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for the Amity University Gurugram fees at the time of final admission.
Step 1: Amity University Gurgaon Application Process 2025

Students must fill out an application form on the official admission website of Amity University Gurugram (https://portal.amity.edu/NewOnlineForm/Candidate/SignUp). With candidates needing to fill out a separate form in case of multiple course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,100for each form. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill out an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity University Gurgaon.
Step 2: Amity University Gurgaon Selection Process

Amity University Gurgaon admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round as per course requirements. The students are selected based on Amity PhD Entrance Test +Interview by Faculty Member or All India National Level Competitive Examination or NET (viz. UGC / CSIR -NET in Category 1,2 or 3, ICMR- JRF/SRF, ICAR-AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD),GATE, GPAT, DST – INSPIRE, DBT-JRF etc.
Step 3: Final Offer Letter

The final results are declared after the completion of all previous rounds. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay a certain amount as per theAmity University Gurugram feesstructure to secure their seats.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: It is great. The hostel is very comfortable with a friendly atmosphere everywhere. Students taking the AC hostel are given separate rooms with an almirah. For a non-AC hostel, the same things are given, but instead of separate rooms for students. They are given 3 sharing and 2 sharing rooms. The food quality is really good in the mess. reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. reviews.review_heading: Amity University is considered as a good university for studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.
reviews.review_text: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is good and canteen food is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, classroom is ventilated, and AC is available. Number of options and variety are available. Classrooms and corridors are always clean. Washrooms are clean and hygienic. Air-conditioned classrooms are available. It provides proper uniforms for clinicals. It also provides laboratory facilities and training.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members. There are 99% placements and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college and hostel is amazing. It has availability of Wi-Fi. Hostel provides clean and quiet environment. Hostel also has medical facilities. We also have labs, library, and classroom. Quality of food is like home and great mess is there.

reviews.review_heading: Studying here always feels like learning something new every day.
reviews.review_text: The environment of the college is very well. They provide good care to the students. Faculty members are very helpful to the students. The canteens are good and only veg and hygiene food is served. Library is also good and all new books are available.

reviews.review_heading: I feel proud as a student of Amity University Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Amity University Haryana has one of the best infrastructure, which is well-maintained in terms of lab classes, library facilities, and the list goes on. AC, non-AC rooms, water cooler, lift, study table, medical facilities, sports complex, playground, and mess food. These are some facilities which are provided to hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University provided what students needed the most.
reviews.review_text: The facility and the infrastructure are amazing. Classrooms, water facility, library, labs, and Wi-Fi facility are amazing and have all the equipment and books that are needed in the course, and every necessary thing required for the course. Hostel, if we talk about hostel, food is the first thing we have in our mind, and here the food is amazing, including other facilities too, good food quality, and medical facilities, everything is good here.

reviews.review_heading: "Great infrastructure and facilities with diverse student amenities."
reviews.review_text: The ASH department offers excellent infrastructure, including Wi-Fi-enabled campuses and modern classrooms. reviews.review_heading: I would recommend others take admission here, especially if they are looking for hotel management.
reviews.review_text: Students who are interested in sports will find a decent sports complex at this university, and tournaments are held at specific times of the year. Hostels are also decent, with food quality being good and offering variations. Hostels also have recreational rooms.

reviews.review_heading: A balanced college with good opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually better than many universities. We have a front office lab, restaurant, kitchen, bakery lab, Wi-Fi, and a library everything. There are approximately 5-6 canteens, and they are very clean. The food is also very good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The best private university in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Clean and tidy classrooms with state-of-the-art infrastructure provide a smooth learning experience. The library is a very comfortable place to study. faqs.answer: CAT is not a necessary requirement for Pune Institute of Business Management (PIBM) Pune. For admissions at PIBM, it is a must that candidates have undergone an education programme under a three-year or four-year graduation system with at least 50% or above aggregate marks in Class 10, 12 and Graduation courses. Besides this, candidates’ performance in aptitude tests such as CAT/ XAT/ MAT/ CMAT is evaluated. If a candidate has scored average marks in one of the above, they have to sit for the PMAT which is PIBM’s aptitude test. Candidates can also take this test solely in the beginning without the hassle of sitting for other aptitude tests. The evaluation process is similar to CAT/ MAT/ CMAT etc.

paragraphs: To get admission to any of the Management course at PIBM Pune, students need to follow a three-step admission process. Find all the steps of the PIBM admission process in the following section:
Step 1: PIBM Pune Online Application

For admission to the Pune Institute of Business Management courses, candidates need to visit the official website and fill out an online application form for PGDM/ MBA courses. Along with that, they must pay an application fee of INR 1,000.
Step 2: PIBM Pune Selection Rounds

PIBM Pune admissions are entrance-based. Candidates are admitted based on either PMAT or any other state/national-level entrance exams, which are particularly conducted for Management courses with a valid score. For the final selection, PIBM Pune conducts a Written Test, Group Discussion, and Personal Interview rounds that are mandatory to qualify for admission to PIBM Pune Management courses.
Step 3: Final Admission
Afte the completion of the final selection process, the selected candidates are required to pay a certain amount of course fees to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in PIBM Pune?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission is not possible at PIBM Pune. The institute offers PG level Management courses of MBA & PGDM for a duration of two years. Candidates seeking for admission to these courses have to go through a selection process. PIBM Pune admission is entirely entrance-based. Here, aspirants get two options to qualify for the selection process. They need to either qualify for PIBM's in-house entrance exam or the scores of other national-level entrance exams such as CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ MAH-CET/ PMAT are also accepted by the institute.

faqs.question: Does PIBM Pune accept MAT score?
faqs.answer: Yes, PIBM Pune accepts MAT scores for admission to its management programs. The institution accepts test scores of CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, and PMAT (PIBM's aptitude test). For the MBA program, it is mandatory to appear in at least one of the above exams. If a student has not appeared for any of the above exams and wishes to apply for PGDM, they have to take the PMAT test, which is an internal entrance exam conducted by PIBM itself

faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted for PIBM Pune MBA admissions?
faqs.answer: PIBM accepts valid scores from national exams including CAT, XAT, MAT or CMAT. If a student has not taken these, they must appear for the PMAT (PIBM's Management Aptitude Test), an internal 75-minute online assessment.

reviews.review_heading: The college location is good. It is surrounded by mountains.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are very good, with decent room accommodations. However, students from North and Northeast India may face challenges with the food options available. In the second year, students can choose to either continue living in the hostel or move to rented apartments, which typically cost around Rs. 10,000 to 15,000 monthly. The hostel fee is Rs. 1,50,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: Best place for growth and skill graduation.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities need to be upgraded a little. There is Wi-Fi available in rooms but room quality is low. Food is average and the canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities available on campus are available 24X7 but the sports and game facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for learning.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good and lavish. The food provided is average. The college has a full-fledged library that consists of various informative books. Classrooms consist of E-boards which makes learning easy for students. Medical Facilities are provided 24x7 on campus.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best place for knowledge enhancement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch, but the food provided is average. The college and the hostel have the necessary Wi-Fi facilities and a library with fully equipped e-classrooms. The medical and sports facilities are good, and it helps to make a full-fledged campus for students.

reviews.review_heading: A perfect college for your better education.
reviews.review_text: All kinds of facilities are available for better education and comfort. The food quality is average. Canteen and medical facilities are available 24/7. There is a basketball court and a cricket court to boost students.

reviews.review_heading: PIBM – An Ultimate Management College.
reviews.review_text: All over, the college infrastructure is pretty fine, not much good, and facilities are not much there. If I talk about the hostel, then there are many hostels associated with us, but if I talk about mine, it's a decent hostel named Dreams, and yes, there is an issue with electricity sometimes.

reviews.review_heading: College and faculty members give their 100% for students.
reviews.review_text: In PIBM, all facilities like Wi-Fi, e-classrooms, labs, and library are provided as mentioned in their brochure. This college will absolutely help one build their career as one want. Also, college invites various corporates for interactive sessions.

reviews.review_heading: I am so satisfied with my collage.
reviews.review_text: See, the campus isn't too good but the surrounding area of campus is very great. It's all green everywhere. The hostel is good but there are some restrictions for hostels that students must adhere. Wifi, labs, classroom, library are all good. Mess isn't too good and medical facilities, sports are also not up to mark.

reviews.review_heading: The college is value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average, and the hostels are not on campus. There is a small sports complex and gym. The food is average, and the hostel facilities are good enough for students. There is also a paid canteen available for food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Pune Institute of Business Management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not up to the mark; just one big building, that's it but Wi-Fi and internet are available in the computer lab. The library has a sitting area but important books are fewer as the syllabus has changed but the library still has old books. The college does not have its own hostel but they provide society apartments for stay. Food hygiene is okay; the fee is 1.35 lacs per year. Food is more like survival food. PGs are available nearby; the rate is 7-8k monthly.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with its faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel fee is high, but it does not provide many facilities. The food quality is not good. Medical facilities are good. Gym and many indoor games are available. Wi-Fi facility is enabled on campus and hostel as well. It also provides a library, and several books are available.

reviews.review_heading: College provides very good placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are quite good and the college provides Wi-Fi facility. Hostel fee is high because there is a facility of food and laundry also. College has a gym facility also. The college provides indoor games like table tennis, Carrom, Chess, etc..

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are very good, and the placements are good even in the pandemic.
reviews.review_text: PIBM has good hostel facilities, and they provide good flats on a sharing basis. Wi-Fi and food facilities are provided in the hostel. We had an open ground behind hostel and also in college premises. Medical facilities are available in college and hostel too. Overall, all the things are provided by the college, which is a must.

The selection is based on performance in national-level entrance exams likeJEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, etc. Candidates applying for courses, including BTech, MSc, and MTech, must also appear for the counselling rounds conducted by the respective bodies. To seek admission toIIT Jodhpur, aspirants can visit the official website of the entrance exam, and fill out and submit the applications. Read on to know more aboutIIT Jodhpur admissions 2025:
IIT Jodhpur Admission 2025: Highlights

IIT Jodhpur course admission begins with the application process of the accepted entrance exams. Admission to most of the offered courses is entrance-based. Candidates can check out the below table for some key highlights:

Admission to courses offered by IIT Jodhpur is entrance-based. Candidates are shortlisted based on performance in the national-level examinations and interview rounds (if valid). Students wanting to pursue any of the offered courses must complete the application process of the respective entrance examination. Further, the table given below carries course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related to IIT Jodhpur admissions 2025:
Eligibility

Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree (three-year) or equivalent from a recognised university with 60%
Bachelor’s degree in relevant specialisation
BTech degree with 60% aggregate
Pass Class 12 from a recognised board
Hold a Master’s degree
To get details around the IIT Jodhpur admission process for other UG & PG courses,click here
IIT Jodhpur Fees & Seats 2025

IIT Jodhpur fees for all UG & PG include components such as tuition fees, hostel fees and one-time fee payments. The lowest tuition fee for IITJodhpur courses is INR 40,000, whereas the highest fees goes up to INR 2.90 lakh. IIT Jodhpur admission process consists of multiple steps. The admission procedure involves registration, entrance exam, shortlisting, release of merit list, counselling, and admission confirmation. The complete IIT Jodhpur admission process is explained below:
Step 1: IIT Jodhpur Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Jodhpur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application. Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MBA admission, candidates have to fill an online application form on the official website of IIT Jodhpur.
Step 2: IIT Jodhpur Selection Criteria 2025

After filling the application form, students are required to take the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After which, counselling rounds are carried out for some of the programmess for the seat allotment process.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Candidates selected after all the selection rounds can confirm their admission/seat by paying the required amount of fee.

To qualify JEE Main exam, an advanced and well-planned study plan is required. A good preparation strategy can help students in securing a seat for the BTech course at IIT Jodhpur. Below are the pointers that can help students in the preparations for JEE Main entrance exam:
The first step is to clear JEE Main, however, the ultimate objective must be to qualify JEE Advanced exam, check out thepreparation strategy for JEE Advanced.

courses_data.description: IIT Jodhpur offers a full-timeBTechprogramme that lasts four years. To get into this programme, students need to have good scores in the JEE Main exam. Check out the following video for a comparison between IIT Jodhpur and IIT Delhi:

faqs.question: Is IIT Jodhpur good for BTech?
faqs.answer: The institute is ranked 30 among the top colleges of India under the “Engineering” category by NIRF in 2022 rankings. DuringIIT Jodhpur placementsin 2022, the median and average package offered to BTech CSE students was INR 28.7 LPA and INR 28 LPA, respectively. The top recruiters of IIT Jodhpur in 2022 included Accenture, Amazon, IBM, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Adobe, etc.

faqs.question: How to apply for BTech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Admission to the course is entrance-based. Aspirants are required to take JEE Main and JEE Advanced. The selected students based on merit in JEE Advanced further have to participate in JoSAA rounds of counselling. The seat allotment process is then carried out as per performance in counselling and other selection rounds.

faqs.question: How can I get into IIT Jodhpur for BTech?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at IIT Jodhpur is based on performance in the all-India level Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Main), followed by JEE Advanced. Based on JEE Advanced score, candidates need to take part in JoSAA counselling. Candidates can apply on the JEE official website (nta.ac.in). Candidates who secure a rank more than or equal to the IITJ BTech cutoff become eligible for admission.

courses_data.name: IIT Jodhpur MTech Admission 2025
courses_data.description: At the PG level, candidates are selected for MTech at IIT Jodhpur via a valid GATE score. Aspirants must apply and appear for the entrance exam along with fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria to apply for the course.

faqs.question: Is it worth doing MTech from IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: IITJ is ranked 30 among top Engineering institutes as per the NIRF 2022 rankings. The institute has a good placements record. The median package offered to MTech CSE and M.Tech AI students were INR 14 LPA and INR 14.5 LPA, respectively. Some of the top companies that participated in the IIT Jodhpur placements drive were Accenture, Adobe, Amazon, IBM, TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, etc.

faqs.question: Is any financial assistance given to M.Tech programme students at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a BE, BTech, BS, or BDes degree and a GATE or GPAT qualification are eligible for financial aid worth INR 12,400 per month. Even if they do not pass the GATE exam, IIT BTech graduates with a CGPA of 8 or higher are eligible for assistantships. Sponsored category students cannot get an IITJ assistantship, nevertheless. This data is as per past years' records and hence may vary.

faqs.question: How to get admission in a M.Tech course at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The selection is based on GATE scores followed by COAP Counselling. Candidates shortlisted are invited for written exam or interview round for final selections. Aspirants shall complete theGATE application process(gate.iitk.ac.in) within the due date to be eligible for admission as there is no other provision for admission. With a valid COAP score, students may have to apply on IITJ website as well.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to participate in COAP counselling for M.Tech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP) is a registration portal. Candidates who pass GATE exam are required to apply on COAP portal for counselling. Only the students who register successfully on the portal become eligible for admission in an M.Tech course of IIT Jodhpur.

courses_data.description: Admission to IIT Jodhpur MBA course is entirely entrance-based. Candidates must qualify for either CAT or GATE as per the course requirements. Furthermore, a PI round is also conducted to finalise the shortlisted candidates.

faqs.question: Can I do MBA in IIT Jodhpur without CAT?
faqs.answer: Admission to MBA course at IIT Jodhpur is entirely entrance-based. To get admission to MBA and MBA Technology at IIT Jodhpur, candidates must apply with a valid CAT percentile. However, the institute also provides admission to Non-CAT qualifiers. For admission to MBA in FinTech and Cyber Security, aspirants are selected based on a valid GATE score.The online application form can be filled out by visiting the institute's official website. faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Jodhpur MBA?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission to a full-time MBA course at IIT Jodhpur, candidates have to apply and qualify for CAT entrance exam. Candidates who passed graduation with minimum 60% aggregate or 6.00 CGPA (55% aggregate or 5.00 for SC/ST/PwD categories) are eligible to sit for CAT and apply for admission to IIT Jodhpur MBA course. faqs.question: What is the eligibility requirement for IIT Jodhpur MBA course?
faqs.answer: To be eligible to apply for MBA admission at IIT Jodhpur, candidates must pass Class 12 and graduation in the respective subjects. Candidates who secured minimum 60% aggregate or 6.00 CGPA in their graduation are eligible to apply for MBA. However, there is a five percent relaxation is given to SC/ST/PwD candidates. They must obtain a minimum of 55% aggregate or 5.00 CGPA in the same subjects. Other than this, final year students of graduation may also apply for the course.

To fill out the application form, aspirants have to complete a login ID on the JAM Online Application Processing System.

faqs.question: Can I apply for branch change in IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, the branch can be changed at the end of the second semester. But, the student must meet the required criteria- a CGPA greater than or equal to 8.0 and 7.0 for SC, ST and PD applicants.  They must have completed all prescribed course credits for the first two semesters.

faqs.question: How to get admission in the MSc course at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Admission to the PG-level course is through the IIT Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM). Candidates shall apply for the IIT JAM exam and secure a valid score for admission. The application process is carried out online on the official website of the university. Candidates who score as per the cutoff get selected forCCMN Counsellingduring which the seat allotment procedure is carried out.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Master in Optometry (M.OPT) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: The research scope is great here.

content.Placements: An optometrist role is offered at the initial average salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Students generally get placed in hospitals. People do internships in a nearby hospital, which is linked to the university. Our university has 100% placements, and many of them opt to study abroad for better opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Health Psychology - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: We have a good placement cell on our campus. Every year, we use to invite them for the campus selection. We used to go for higher studies rather than going for a job, most of us are pursuing a Ph.D. now. Still, we have some opportunities to get a job. The list of companies includes Velammal Educational Institutions, DuPont, and some renowned IT companies. We can do an internship under a professor.
content.Infrastructure: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a problem at all. Playgrounds are available at hostels. The gym is also there for students, which is very nice. For every semester, the hostel fees are so feasible for everyone.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of students are successfully placed in our Hyderabad University. Our course has the highest package of 37 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3-7 LPA. Recruitment agencies include IMD, IIRS, MoES, and many others. Opportunities for internships are great, with more than 85% of students placed in good companies. The top roles offered are oceanographer, climate modeler, and more.
content.Infrastructure: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Financial Economics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.

content.Placements: Placement percentage is 12% - 15%. The highest package is 14 LPA. The lowest package is 5 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Recruiting companies are Federal Bank and Synchrony. Internship percentage is 20%. Roles and companies are research assistant in IITs, research institutes, RBI, and NABARD. Roles offered are research and data analysis.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best affordable university with great amenities.

content.Placements: As far as I know, you will have a good placement percentage but don't expect a package like 20LPA. If you are well talented, you can surely get placements as many companies will come for placements. The eligibility criteria depend upon the company, and some companies have minimum CGPA but some consider an interview irrespective of your CGPA. As I am still in 2nd semester this much only I can provide information about this section.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.

reviews.review_heading: The research scope is great here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a pro...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.
reviews.review_text: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Best affordable university with great amenities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.

reviews.review_heading: If you're planning to come here for studying M.A. Economics, please don't.
reviews.review_text: The Infrastructure is very poorly planned and designed. Apart from old and depressing architecture, the locations of different buildings are also not well thought out. Some of the hostels are in the north campus and some are in the south, which are 3-4 km apart. Some departments are in the middle, some are in the east campus (3 km from the north campus), and some are in the south. There aren't enough buses to carry all the students to their respective classes. But, the library is in the middle, ...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied as they are very affordable, large campus area, and have a lot of greenery.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is up to the mark especially in south campus whereas it is not as much good in north as they all are so old. South campus hostels are well-equipped with geyser, RO, water cooler, and Wi-Fi both LAN and outer near to rooms. We need not worry about the classrooms as they are best in infrastructure wise with the modern equipment. Labs are also well maintained. Hostels need a little bit of maintenance but academic buildings are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Everyone is friendly.
reviews.review_text: We have a big library where many books are available. We have playgrounds, a gym, and yoga. Many tournaments are held here. The food is good, and hostels are always clean. We have a separate medical center where people there take care of us. Wi-Fi is provided in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: UOH is one of the best universities if you are looking for research. Faculty members are really good
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is really good; some of the buildings of the college are really good. Wi-Fi, the library, and all are really good. In the hostel, we have to stay with 2 members in each room, and ethernet facilities are available in all hostels. The food quality is average.

reviews.review_heading: This institute has got the title of "Institute of Eminence."
reviews.review_text: This university has a library named Indira Gandhi Memorial. It has many books and journals for every respective field. The books here cover linguistics, such as Hindi and Urdu, and technology engineering. Many clubs are running here, such as the Arts, Dance, Science, and Junior Clubs, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied! It's really a great college.
reviews.review_text: Food quality is very good and offers many dishes in one place. There is a big library with seating arrangements, and we can also borrow books from the library for study. Computer labs and science labs are available. Our college has plenty of space with multiple washrooms and ample space with an auditorium and multiple computer labs. We have a huge cricket playground with turfs. Great Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science in University of Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text:
The hostel is good but not too clean, with corridors full of dogs but not much charm.
Labs are good except when it comes to computer labs. 
There are study rooms, reading rooms, and libraries open 24/7 except on some major holidays. 
Okay canteen, faculty members, and good medical facilities. Not much support in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Integrated economics at the University of Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: College campus is very big and full of greenery. Department buildings have good and advanced facilities. There is 24/7 library and reading room are avilable. Wi-Fi is enabled in hostels and all public places. Good indoor, outdoor sports facilities, and good gym facilities. Hostel rooms are decent with 2 students per room.

reviews.review_heading: Curriculum and campus environment are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is amazing. Over 2300 acres campus with good connectivity, free bus service, advanced department building, and classrooms. Big and decent library which is 24/7 open. Full-time Wi-Fi is available in all public areas, including the shopping complex, hostels, lecture halls, and departments. Hostel rooms are good we have to share a room with one of our roommates. All other basic facilities are available such as gym, stadium, and sports complex for almost all indoor and outdoor sports....

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, but administration is poor.
reviews.review_text: Bad condition of infrastructure and technology, provided by the administration, buildings are in worse condition in my school, but the library is the finest place where students rush to. The mess condition is even worse, but the quality of food sanitation is good.

1. Lucknow University Application Process 2026

The application process is carried out in online mode. Aspirants must fill in all the details in theLucknow University admission form 2026-26carefully. To apply successfully, candidates have to pay an application fee ofINR 800.
2. Appear for the Entrance Test

Once the registration has been completed successfully, Lucknow University will announce the schedule of the entrance test in the UG and in the PG programs.To get admission at LU, registered applicants will be required to take the entrance test.Applicants are required to download Lucknow University admit card to appear in the university-level entrances.
3. Announcement of Merit List

LU will publish the course-wise tentative merit lists based on the performance of the candidates in the entrance test.A list of candidates whose name has been included in the merit list would then attend the centralised counselling round.
4. Fee Payment & Confirmation of Admission
After the counselling round, the University will release the seat allocation list for final admission. Candidates selected must pay the tuition fees to confirm admission.

paragraphs: University of Lucknow has released the placement details for the Class of 2025. The University achived 81% placements in the academic year 2024-25. faqs.question: How much is the Lucknow University MBA fees?
faqs.answer: Lucknow University MBA fee will range between INR 1.3 lakh and INR 3.2 lakh. In addition to the fee mentioned here, an amount of INR 5,000 will have to be deposited as refundable caution money by all candidates at the time of admission. Also, students who graduated from Universities other than the University of Lucknow (including associated Colleges) have to deposit a one-time non-refundable enrollment fee of INR 500. The given fee is taken from an unofficial source. Hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: How much is Lucknow University's MBA average package?

The median package mentioned here is the overall median salary for PG two-year courses, including MBA, MA and MSc.

The mess provides a very healthy breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The canteen is open 24/7, and there are good medical facilities provided by Sharda Hospital, including free check-ups for Sharda students.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best place for taking admission. We can enhance our knowledge, skills, and progress.

reviews.review_heading: Strong placement opportunities for new skills activities.

reviews.review_heading: Sharda University life of student.

reviews.review_heading: Sharda university is very good to pursue further studies .
reviews.review_text:
The facilities and infrastructure are very good, not only in our course but in every course. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, and classrooms are very furnished, and centralized AC is there in the whole building of the college library, which is very huge with AC and proper facilities. 
The hostel rooms are not that good, and mess food is also fine, and the hospital is there on the campus only, and both indoor and outdoor sports facilities are there in the university.

reviews.review_heading: BBA in Sharda University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. Fully covered with centralized AC, with Wi-Fi, though sometimes Wi-Fi is working very slow. reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive learning and placement support with room

reviews.review_text: The campus life is good, with plenty of greenery and trees that provide nice places to sit and hang out with others. reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied by the facilities, placement and the infrastructure.

The university also provides outdoor and indoor games for students to play and practice for tournaments.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the exposure is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has an enriching environment, making it an apt choice for PGDM.

reviews.review_heading: Our college gives versatile opportunities to grow.
reviews.review_text: Library is huge and has air-conditioned classrooms that make things more convenient. Campus is away from city life. Hostel is nice with good campus life.

The lush green and peaceful environment will not let you go back. The hostel facilities are more than what I expected. I am sure that you will get everything you require. Mess food quality is hygienic and delicious. The only disadvantage is for non-vegetarians, as only pure vegetarian dishes are served inside the mess. But...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best B-School among MAT based colleges.

Medical and sports facilities are available inside the campus only so that students do not have to go out of campus for any needs. There is a centralised library with the latest editions of books, which help students to grow and learn in a better way.

reviews.review_heading: I think it is the best college in Indore.
reviews.review_text: It is a residential campus, and it has a gym, common room, basketball court, mini-library etc. The campus is safe for students. The hostels are just like 3-star hotels with proper sanitation facilities as well.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life is really good here, and the placement team is very hard working.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with the college and would recommended joining it.
reviews.review_text: All the necessary facilities like Wi-Fi, medical, sports (indoor & outdoor), laundry, and stationery are provided. The food served in the mess is good. There are two separate canteens for vegetarian students and non-vegetarian students. But the mess only serves vegetarian food.

reviews.review_heading: The surrounding is peaceful and the course curriculum gives an  insights about the industry.

paragraphs: OP Jindal University Raigarh admission 2025is open. The University offers merit-based admission. Further, for BTech and MBA university accepts various entrance exam scores.OP Jindal University Raigarhoffers UG, PG, diploma and doctoral courses in various specialisations. Students interested in admission to OP Jindal University Raigarh must appear for entrance exams and fill out the eligibility criteria to apply for admission. Want to know more about the OP Jindal University Raigarh admission process 2025 read below:

OP Jindal University Raigarh admission to all the courses is merit-based. However, for admission to BTech and MBA university accepts various national levels exams such as JEE/admission CGPET/CAT/MAT and others. Admission to all UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses is open. Candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective course. Additionaly, candidates must appear for the entrance exam for admission to BTech and MBA courses. OP Jindal University Raigarh admission procedure has a multi-step process, which has to be fulfilled by all the students to get admission. It starts with the application, students are required to apply and appear for the respective entrance exam and counselling for their desired course. Find below the OP Jindal University Raigarh admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Students seeking admission to OP Jindal University Raigarh must apply for the entrance exam accepted by OP Jindal University Raigarh for admission to BTech and MBA courses. Additionaly, students are also required to register themselves by visiting the official website.
Step 2: OP Jindal University Raigarh Selection Criteria

After applying for the entrance exam accepted by the university for admission to BTech and MBA, students are required to appear for the same to fill out the selection criteria for admission. Additionally, for other courses, students must fill out the basic eligibility criteria which include that UG candidates must pass Class 12 with 50% aggregate and PG candidates must have a graduation degree with 50% aggregate.
Step 3: Counselling
For admission to all the courses, it is mandatory to appear for the counselling round conducted by the university for the allocation of seats.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation

After the final round, the university releases the merit list based on the counselling round. The students get shortlisted in the counselling round, they are required to submit theOP Jindal University Raigarh feeto lock in the final seat. If the candidate doesn’t pay the full fee by the stipulated date, the admission will be deemed cancelled and the seat will become vacant for the next round of counselling.

content.Infrastructure: We have a software skills lab ( Autocad, Staad Pro, Revit, Primavera), a department library which has our books and also some ancient collections on the subject. We have a lab the size of a warehouse, which is divided into many sections to accommodate the equipment used in our practical subjects.

individual_reviews.title: Great academics and infra, average placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life.

content.Placements: 90 percent of students are placed. The packages offered are 3.6 LPA, 2.4 LPA, and 1.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's, Pfizer, Aurobindo, Hetero, and Novartis. It is not an internship but 100 percent placement. Roles offered include direct patient care, industry roles such as R&D scientist, QA/QC officer, medical writers, regulatory affairs, sales/marketing, and government roles like drug inspector and jhospital pharmacist, focusing on drug development, safety, quality, and patient counseling.
content.Infrastructure: Modern, air-conditioned smart classrooms, advanced tech-enabled labs, and a library with digital access are available, supported by 24/7 Wi-Fi and sports facilities. Now, the quality of the hostel facilities is better compared to before. The facilities now serve good food with good-quality mess and canteen. Medical facilities are available 24/7 with an ambulance. All sports are conducted, and all games competitions are held.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Everything is acceptable.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed in my course. The highest package is 12 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package offered is 6 LPA. review_summary.college_name: GJUST Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Facilities are average, like infrastructure, campus life, crowd, teachers, and hostel.

content.Placements: The highest package from CSE is 6 LPA, and the average package is around 3 LPA. 5-10 students are generally placed till now (mid placement season). Most of the students try to find internships off campus by building their skills on their own, and mostly get their placements off campus.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library are good. There are all the facilities for a studious student who genuinely wants to study. But the hostel provided for B.Tech students is very bad. No space in the room, no separate almirah, table, chair, or even bed. The food is also very bad at this hostel.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure. The faculty is supportive and caring.

content.Placements: No placements are available in my course at my college. But it gives placements in internships, which are very few. They are given to about 2-3 students in a full batch only, which is a very bad thing. I am absolutely dissatisfied with it, and it should give placements for jobs also.
content.Infrastructure: Benches in classrooms are bad and broken. Fans are not working properly. Hostels are average, and the food is average. The good thing about the college is that it has a very large sports complex, which has many indoor game courts and outdoor sports as well. There is a good library which is very large, and seats are available in very good condition.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review from 2nd sem B.Tech E&C student.

content.Placements: The placements are even less than what we call decent here. You cant expect more from the on campus placements from this college. They roam around 3 to 4 LPA as the average package. Of course, it depends on the crowd as well, but still, there are very few packages offered here.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels of the university are in a way like, like you get a hostel in just 1st year, after that, there will be no hostels facility for students and still the hostels are not that good. 4 to5 students live in a single room and it becomes impossible for someone to study.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: GJU, Hisar, college life review.

content.Placements: In our university, almost 50 percent of the students are placed on the campus. The average package is 4 LPA, and the highest package is 23 LPA. Some of the companies that are enrolled in our university are Wipro, Infosys, TVS, etc. Data scientist, data analytics, and AI engineering are the top courses seen in placement and internship.
content.Infrastructure: There is very good infrastructure that helps us to learn easily. Very good classrooms and smart classes with Wi-Fi for each student are provided in the hostel. The food quality is not very good, but it has good medical facilities and a good sports ground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Packaging Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A great place for practical learning in printing & packaging.

content.Placements: Placements in the printing & packaging technology course are decent but still improving. Around 60-70% students get placed every year. Top recruiting companies include ITC, Parksons Packaging, Zircon, TCPL, and Natraj. The highest package goes around 7-8 LPA, the average is around 3-4 LPA, and the lowest can be 2-2.5 LPA. Many students also get internships in corrugation, label printing and flexible packaging companies, which helps in gaining industry exposure. More core printing companies are expected to come in future.
content.Infrastructure: The university has a large campus with greenery and well-maintained buildings. The printing department is equipped with modern labs, offset and flexographic printing machines, computer labs, and a good library. Wi-Fi is available, and classrooms are clean and spacious. Hostel facilities are good, rooms are maintained properly, and the mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities, medical centre, canteen and stationery shops are available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are average, like infrastructure, campus life, crowd, teachers, and hostel.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library are good. There are all the facilities for a studious student who genuinely wants to study. But the hostel provided for B.Tech students is very bad. No space in the room, no separate almirah, table, chair, or even bed. The food is also very bad at this hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure. The faculty is supportive and caring.
reviews.review_text: Benches in classrooms are bad and broken. Fans are not working properly. Hostels are average, and the food is average. The good thing about the college is that it has a very large sports complex, which has many indoor game courts and outdoor sports as well. There is a good library which is very large, and seats are available in very good condition.

reviews.review_heading: Review from 2nd sem B.Tech E&C student.
reviews.review_text: The hostels of the university are in a way like, like you get a hostel in just 1st year, after that, there will be no hostels facility for students and still the hostels are not that good. 4 to5 students live in a single room and it becomes impossible for someone to study.

reviews.review_heading: GJU, Hisar, college life review.
reviews.review_text: There is very good infrastructure that helps us to learn easily. Very good classrooms and smart classes with Wi-Fi for each student are provided in the hostel. The food quality is not very good, but it has good medical facilities and a good sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: A great place for practical learning in printing & packaging.
reviews.review_text: The university has a large campus with greenery and well-maintained buildings. The printing department is equipped with modern labs, offset and flexographic printing machines, computer labs, and a good library. Wi-Fi is available, and classrooms are clean and spacious. Hostel facilities are good, rooms are maintained properly, and the mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities, medical centre, canteen and stationery shops are available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology is an overall good university.
reviews.review_text: Basically, there are 4 hostels. Each hostel has Wi-Fi, a canteen, a mess, and TV rooms. There are grounds for playing as well. There are study rooms that are as good as libraries. Medical facilities are also available, as the health center is not far from the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is very good in every field, with lots of greenery and best studies.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good on our campus, including fully AC labs for new ideas, coding practice, Chemistry lab, AutoCAD lab, and more. Hostels have luxurious rooms and clean washrooms. Mess food is average in hostels, and there are four hostels for girls and four hostels for boys.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is so well. Placement and crowd need to improve if a student is serious about them.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is decent like we get separate Wi-Fi and pass so like you can do your basic work easily. Labs are well-equipped and fully running condition. Library is also AC equipped and fully running well cleaned and big. Quality of students is fine only, like for the first student who got the new hostel, else they will get the old wing that is just average. Quality of food varies to change our meals according to taste. Canteen is available. Medical facility is top notch but...

reviews.review_heading: GJU lifestyle of students.
reviews.review_text: Very neat and clean rooms. I like to spend time with my friends in these classrooms. We talk for hours sitting here, and we always miss this time when we all together sit here and talk to each other and make each other laugh. Sitting in canteen etc. I like it.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Shekhawati Group of InstitutionsReviewed on 27 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good institute of the city.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities on the campus. And all the services provided by the college are the best. The college department is very gentle. There are many facilities like Wi-Fi, Science lab, computer lab, playground, NCC, classroom, off-course, and a big library.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 23 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The best college in Haryana
reviews.review_text: My college facilities and infrastructure are very good, and the department is very neat and clean. The classroom is very big and the air facilities are very good. My college hostel facilities and infrastructure are very good, and the food quality is very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Dayanand CollegeReviewed on 14 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College is moderate with decent campus.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi at all. It is only available in computer labs and library. Labs are well furnished and equipped with all the required equipments and materials. Hostel facility is not available for boys but available for girls. There is only a first aid kit in medical facility terms. Sports and games are encouraged. We have dedicated ground and field for specific sports like cricket, football, tennis, handball, etc.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 9 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities and infrastructure are good and the best. The department is very neat and clean. The rooms, labs, library, and classrooms and the hostel facilities are very good, and the food quality is very good. The mess, canteen, medical, and sports facilities are also very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 12 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college in Punjab and Haryana.
reviews.review_text: My college facility and infrastructure are very good and the best. Class, library, and labs are very great and air-free rooms, all rooms are neat and clean. My college hostel facilities are very good, and the food quality is very good. My college hostel mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports and games facilities are the best.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of placement and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in this college is very good, but it is only the infrastructure, not the study or courses. There is no space in hostels for students, and there is no generator to support electricity after a cut. No one is interested in listening to your problems. You have to buy your light for the room.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Technology Management in Agriculture - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in terms of ROI, culture, learning environment and diversity.

review_content.Placements: The college has witnessed 100% placement since inception, and it is getting better year by year. Organisations lying in the nexus of agribusiness and allied sectors are frequent visitors to our academy. The speciality of our academy lies in academic rigour and competitive spirit as a result of which we participate and perform well in national level B-Fest. Our college students have won in various events like B-fests in IIM-Ahmedabad, IIM-Raipur, Agrimach by FICCI, SIBM-h, etc. The average salary package offered ranges between 7.5-8 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 6.5 LPA. Students undergo summer as well as winter internships, and they also work on live projects. We have technology business incubator as well. So, one interested in startups can be associated with them and learn, work with them. Within a short span, our college has established its name in the industry. Major recruiters are from Agri input, commodities, banking, NBFC, consultancy, supply chain management and development sector.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: I would recommend joining here after 12th as college life here is full of adventures.

review_content.Placements: Almost 60 to 70% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 8 LPA. Even my elder sister from BBA here got placed in top tier company.

Moreover, internet connection is also available here for virtual meetups or for virtual interviews. The hostel is amazing with decent food facility and 24x7 light availability.
