review_summary.college_name: SBM NMIMS Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Pharmaceutical Management - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My review about this college.

content.Placements: It is regarded as one of the best colleges in terms of placement and job opportunities. Job placement is amazing. The average placement is around 7 LPA-8 LPA. GSK and Boehringer Ingelheim offered 8 LPA, Sanofi and DRL offered 10 LPA, while Sun Pharma offered 7 LPA. Abbott offered 7.5 LPA. You name the Pharma company and it visits campus. Roles offered include sales executive, marketing trainee, marketing associate fellow, junior project manager, junior analyst, and management trainee. Projects range from different assignments in sales, to target, and deadline-based tasks.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: NMIMS College review based on my experience.

content.Placements: Placements are not that good. In the start, they offer good placements but no good companies come for the same. According to the fees, placements are not that effective. It is suggested to try off-campus placements. There are no such top recruiting companies.
content.Faculty: Semester exams are moderate and not that much difficult. If we are prepared well and have gone through books once then we can appear well for the exam without any difficulty. The course curriculum does not make students industry-ready as it does not provide real-life explanations and no projects based on reality. It is more theoretical-based rather than practical-based. There is no real-life explanation in the course. Lectures are recorded and then uploaded on our portals. We can access them at any time. The suggestion is to read from books for conceptual clarity and to know about the subject.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has a good course curriculum and a plethora of opportunities.

content.Placements: There are 100% placements in college. A lot of major companies visit campus including Microsoft and Google. Students with work experience have an edge over freshers when it comes to final placements but still have access to great opportunities and roles.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is no less than a 5-star hotel. It is always well-maintained and well-lit. There is excellent Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the campus. The library is huge and the go-to place for many students particularly in the exam season. The canteen provides all kinds of cuisines. Sports area is also available.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Business Analytics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My best experience in this college.

content.Placements: The company provides internship opportunities for various profiles and roles. A stipend is also provided interesting and engaging products are offered. As the listener we have been able to analyze that this college provides the best opportunity available in the market. Opportunities are almost as same with the students. As students get the almost flexible to every company setup and working atmosphere they almost crack all the GDPI grounds. Endurance, Barclays, and many more are some of the top-paying companies that visited our college. Many students got internships as well, but I am not aware of the percentage.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for a Master of Business Administration course.

content.Placements: Placements of the previous years' MBA students were excellent. The college promises 100% placement in this particular course. The highest salary package offered is 27 LPA. The average salary package offered is 6.07 LPA. Companies that visited the campus were from all domains like marketing, IT consulting, automobile, infrastructure, real estate, etc. Also, companies like HP, Accenture, Mahindra, LG, Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Idea, Reliance, Daikin, etc., visited the college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Labs here are equipped with new systems. Facilities for sports like table tennis, football ground, cricket ground, basketball court and badminton court are present. Labs here are up-to-date, and modern PCs are also installed. There is also a theatre for the students on the campus in which movies are projected monthly. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and they are quite well-maintained with projector facilities in every classroom.

paragraphs: School of Business Management NMIMS accepts NMAT by GMAC scores for admission to the MBA courses. Candidates seeking admission to the MBA course need to follow the step-wiseSBM NMIMS admission process, which includes registration for NMAT, registration for NMIMS, appearing for the NMAT exam, selection process, fee payment and document submission.
Step 1: SBM NMIMS Application Process 2025

The B-School accept applications via online mode. Aspirants shall apply for the respective entrance exam through the official website of the exam conducting body. Candidates need to pay an application fee to register for a course.
Step 2: Register at NMIMS

It is mandatory to complete the NMAT by GMAC test registration and payment before proceeding with the NMIMS application. To register at NMIMS, aspirants need to visit www.nmims.edu with their NMAT by GMAC™ registration number to complete the application process.
Step 3: Selection Process

The next step is to shortlist the candidates for the next round. In this round candidates will be selected based on NMAT sectional and total scores. After this, NMIMS will conduct a psychometric test or Written Analytic Test (WAT) along with a personal Interview for the final shortlisting process. For MBA Part-time and diploma course, the institute conducts an essay test followed by a personal interview round for selection.
Step 4. Admission Confirmation & Fee Payment

Shortlisted candidates are then required to submit the admission fee to confirm their seats. Call letters will neither be emailed nor sent by post. The call letter will be declared on the students’ dashboard.

faqs.answer: NMIMS School of Business Management admission is entrance-based for most of the courses. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the institute to apply online. placement_data.title: SBM NMIMS Mumbai Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: INR 67.7 LPA was the highest, and INR 25.13 LPA was the average salary package offered in 2024 for the MBA batch of students. For HR specialisation, the highest package offered was INR 25.02 LPA , while the average package stood at INR 18.64 LPA . For MBA in Pharmaceutical Management, INR 25 LPA was the highest package offered. The average package for the same specialisation stood at INR 10.4 LPA.

Regarding the Business Analytics and Digital Transformation, the highest salary package offered was INR 26.13 LPA in 2023. For the same courses, INR 15.9 LPA and INR 17.85 LPA were the average packages offered in 2023.
Placement Batch Details:

The student ratio of the MBA batch during SBM NMIMS Mumbai placements 2024 was 71% and 29%. The average age of the students was 23.8 years . 32% of the MBA batch was in the Fresher category whereas the remaining students enrolled had work experience of between 1 month and above 36 months.

The MBA HR batch comprised 56% male students and 44% female students during the placement drive 2024. 38% of the batch was in the Fresher category whereas the remaining students had work experience between 1 month and 36 months.

A total of 97 students were there in the MBA Pharmaceutical Management batch during placements 2024. Among the entire batch, 49% were male students and 51% comprised female students. Other than this, 54% of the batch enrolled were Fresher whereas the rest of the students had work experience between 1 and 36 months.

The batch size for the MBA Digital Transformation was 92 students during the placement drive 2023. The entire batch comprised 66% students from Engineering background , 33% students from Commerce background and 1% students from other background. The number of total students enrolled in the MBA Business Analytics program during placements 2023 was 144. The batch included 51% students with work experience of the IT and EComm sector .

hostel.description: Hostel facility includes two full fledged hostels and four rented residential accommodations in Mumbai where students are admitted on first come first serve basis, preference is given to students from outside of Mumbai. Students are entitled to stay in the hostel during the academic session only and are required to vacate the rooms during the summer vacations for maintenance work. Hostel facilities include- hostel mess, outdoor sports facilities etc.

library.description: Fully air-conditioned library namely Prof. Y. K. Bhushan Information & Knowledge Resource Centre has a collection of more than 50,000+ volumes including books, journals (National/International), audio-visuals, CDs, VCDs, annual reports, management games, newsletters, etc. It is also equipped with digital facilities with around 40 machines for access to databases and A-V materials with a 20 seater conference room and a separate reading hall. The center has an institutional membership with BCL (British Council Library), BMA (Bombay Management Association), MANLIBNET (Management Library Network), and Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT) Bombay.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is amazing and appreciable. The rooms are maintained like in a 3-star hotel and the food provided in the mess is no less. The rooms are shared between 4 people, individual single beds with individual cupboards and study desks, equipped with AC if needed and 24-hour electricity backup.

reviews.review_heading: NMIMS College review based on my experience.
reviews.review_text: Placements are not that good. In the start, they offer good placements but no good companies come for the same. According to the fees, placements are not that effective. It is suggested to try off-campus placements. There are no such top recruiting companies.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good course curriculum and a plethora of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The campus is no less than a 5-star hotel. It is always well-maintained and well-lit. There is excellent Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the campus. The library is huge and the go-to place for many students particularly in the exam season. The canteen provides all kinds of cuisines. Sports area is also available.

reviews.review_heading: My best experience in this college.
reviews.review_text: The syllabus is updated and equipped with the best of industrial exposure through webinars. Faculty members are always helpful. They are always available for you. They explain everything based on practical situations. The hostel is really good. The food compared to other hostels is nice. Rooms are big. There's a gym with two trainers. There's also a game room in the hostel along with a consumer shop that has snacks and stationery for students. It's open till 12 at night. There's a night canteen ...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for a Master of Business Administration course.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Labs here are equipped with new systems. Facilities for sports like table tennis, football ground, cricket ground, basketball court and badminton court are present. Labs here are up-to-date, and modern PCs are also installed. There is also a theatre for the students on the campus in which movies are projected monthly. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and they are quite well-maintained with projector facilities in every classroom.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NMIMS School of Business Management .
reviews.review_text: A library is available for studying. Wi-Fi facilities are also available. The college organizes different fairs in collaboration with others for exciting events. The hostels are very good but separate for boys and girls. Hostel food is okay. Medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: The College Provides Great Placements
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is awesome, and the facilities are good. The college building design is very nice. The classrooms are good with AC. All the books are available in the library, and the labs are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available for everyone. The hostel facilities are good, and the canteen is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Summary of NMIMS College.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very clear in the college; all the libraries have all the resources that are required, not only in terms of knowledge but also to clear the semester. Classrooms have smart facilities as well as air conditioning rooms for these students.

reviews.review_heading: 100% placements, good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college offered many facilities like an AC, library, gym, and TV room, but the gym and TV room have time restrictions. The ground is small, but for cricket and football, we have a combined ground. Hostel and mess facility costs are very high (2.1 lakh per year), and colleges have very few rooms. There are no medical facilities; only first aid kits are available on each floor. Wi-Fi is also available all over campus, but its speed is slower and there are search restrictions.

reviews.review_heading: Nmims have lots of facilities, it has a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: NMIMS provides lots of facilities to students who are pursuing a Master in business management course in any field from any stream. They provide live online lectures and recorded videos. They provide various e-materials like book pdf, mok papers etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for students.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms were spacious. All facilities were available in the hostel. The food quality was great. Drinking water facility was also available.

reviews.review_heading: Very well satisfied and Impressed with the college studies.
reviews.review_text: Superb infrastructure is their that no one can say that their infrastructure is bad, Very well and modernize classrooms with best furniture facilities and amazing Computer systems, so good library facilities for students to do their studies peacefully and focused.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has excellent facilities and infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Our labs, classrooms, and library are well-organised and luxurious. The hostel facilities are not available. The quality of food available in the canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty members, college environment, and supportive teachers and students.
reviews.review_text: Our facilities and infrastructure are very good, and you will get internet in all areas of campus. Wherever you wanted to study, you would get the environment. Our college has smart classrooms and a library. The hostel is good. There is a playground on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a traditional library and an electronic library with e-books. Books are sent through courier in an online scenario. Classrooms are equipped with seats, air-conditioning, whiteboards, projectors, lights, and fans.

Dayananda Sagar Business School Application Process

Candidates seeking admission to DSBS Bangalore must complete the application process. The B-School accept applications in online mode. Candidates are advised to confirm that they comply with the eligibility criteria for their chosen course. Candidates will be required to pay theDSBS Bangalore application feesto confirm their admission.
Shortlisting Process of Applications

During the shortlisting process, candidates who fulfill the eligibility criteria and score an appripriate rank will be the ones to gain admissions. DSBS Bangalore accepts several national andstate level entrance exam scores such as CAT, MAT, CMAT, XAT, KMAT and others. The weightage of academic performance is and the entrance exam score is 15% each. The aspirants without national-level entrance test scores may appear for the DSBS entrance test.
Personal Interview

Candidates whose applications are shortlisted by the DSBS Bangalore will be called for the personal interview round. The personal interview round involves a Micro-Presentation session and a personal interview round. The PI can be conducted in both online and offline mode. The personal interview involves the candidate appearing before a selection committee to answer several questions regarding their personal interests, knowledge of the field, reasons for choosing their course and their plans for the future.
Confirmation of Admissions
The business school shall inform the selected candidates over email or any other means. Candidates have to pay the first instalment fee to confirm their seat.

paragraphs: The SIOM Nashik application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates applying for the MBA have to register for SNAP. SIOM Nashik admission is a multi-step process. Candidates can refer to the following steps to understand each stage of the admission process:
STEP 1: SIOM Nashik Application Process 2025

The applications are accepted via online mode. Eligible candidates can apply via the official website (https://www.snaptest.org/). Aspirants should ensure that they submit the application form on or before the prescribed deadline. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000 (non-refundable).
STEP 2: Entrance Exam
SIOM Nashik MBA course admission is done based on the candidate's score on SNAP + Group Exercise-Perosnal Interview.
STEP 3: Selection Rounds
Candidates are shortlisted based on scores in the entrance exam. Candidates who have applied for an MBA have to participate in group exercises and an interview round.
STEP 4: Seat Allotment & Admission Confirmation

The institute releases the merit list on the official website of the institute. Following the seat matrix, the seats are allotted to candidates based on merit in the entrance exam and personal interview. Selected candidates can pay theSIOM Nashik feeto further confirm their seats.

college_info.intro:
ITM Navi Mumbai provides five-month industry internships to various course students. At the PG level, the college offers two-year full-time ITM MBA iConnect courses in 10 specialisations. Out of these 10 specialisations, five are Core specialisations and the rest five are Tech + Management specialisations. The college also provides Global Immersion programmes (GIP) to students.
ITM Navi Mumbai is known for its popular programme which is MBA as the college is ranked eighth in the Top B Schools in the Mumbai category by Business Today 2023. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by ITM College and their respective eligibility and ITM Navi Mumbai fee:

placements.overview:
ITM Navi Mumbai admissions 2026 are open for all the courses. Interested students can visit the official website to apply for the desired course.

ITM Business School Navi Mumbai is a part of the ITM Group of Institutions and was established in 1991 as a private college. Located in Navi Mumbai, ITM Kharghar is ranked 19 in the Times Anual B School Ranking Survey 2024. ITM Business School offers the AIU and UGC-approved BBA iConnect and MBA iConnect programmes from ITM Skills University. The institute has 100% placement rates with 6 months internships.

ITM Kharghar offers ITM MBA iConnect courses and also provides more than 35 add-on certifications and Global Immersion programmes (GIP) to the students. The college is popular for its MBA courses. ITM Kharghar admission is based on merit and entrance exams. The institute accepts national entrance exams such as MAT, CAT, NMAT, CMAT, and others. reviews_list.review_title: Good PGDM college in Navi Mumbai.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of students who were placed was 99 percent. The highest package offered is 12 lacs, the lowest package is 4 lacs, and the average package is 5.5 lacs. reviews_list.review_title: Great college and 5 months internship is good .

review_content.Placements: ITM has a very good 5-month internship program, which really helps me get corporate world exposure. reviews_list.review_title: An enriching journey of 1 year.

review_content.Placements: Soil institute of management has had a good placement run year with 95% of the students being placed by February 2022. admission_process.title: SOIL Institute of Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: Admissions at SOIL Institute of Management are completely entrance-based. To secure a seat in either of the one or two-year Management programmes at the institute, candidates must apply for the programme and complete all the selection rounds. Check below the steps to get a seat in the institute:
1: Application Process
Candidates can apply for courses at SOIL Institute of Management online. Aspirants have to pay an applicaton fee of INR 2,000 for PGPM and PGDM courses.
2: Shortlisting

The institute shortlists candidates for PGPM courses based on a profile-based selection process. This evaluates the academic performance, extra-curricular activities, work experience and leadership potential of the candidates. Aspirants are selected based on their scores in CAT, XAT, NMAT, GMAT, etc. Candidates can also appear for SAT (SOIL Aptitude Test) for selection.
For PGDM, selection is based on past academic performance, addmission test scores (CAT, XAT, MAT, GMAT, CMAT) and relevant work experience of the candidates.
3. Group Exercise and Leadership Assessment
Design Thinking Workshop

This step is common to both PGDM and PGPM courses. Aspirants have to participate inDesign Thinking Workship, half day event. Students are required to solve real-life problems using Design Thinking Principles.
SOIL Leadership Assessment
Applicants have to also take SOIL Leadership Assessment for PGPM courses. It is a 60 minutes pyschometric assessment.
4. Personal Interview
The SOIL faculty and senior industry professionals take a personal interview of selected aspirants to evaluates their interest in the course, leadership abilities and career goals.
5: Final Selection
Candidates are shortlisted based on their academic performance, test scores, work experience,e xtra-curricular achievements, performance in Design Thinking Workship and personal interview.
7. Admission Intimation
The institute informs the selected candidates about admission process and payment of admission fees via email.

reviews.review_heading: Decent institute providing a good learning experience to upskill yourself, not just for placement.
reviews.review_text: The institute has pretty good facilities with a decent canteen. I didn't use the hostel, hence I can't provide an opinion on that. Students have the option to maximize the facilities, and there are many who do not use them. So it all depends on how a student wants to use the given facilities.

reviews.review_heading: An enriching journey of 1 year.
reviews.review_text: The campus is one single building with 4 floors that hosts one large classroom on each floor. The classrooms are spacious and well-equipped to conduct hybrid modes of classes smoothly. The topmost floor has an auditorium meant for events and large gatherings. The building also houses a full stacked library which is useful for academic reference purposes.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has value for money for a one-year MBA program at Soil Institute.
reviews.review_text: After the pandemic, the curriculum is being conducted in a hybrid model. Students could experience its classroom-like environment on online, thanks to its infrastructure available. The Wi-Fi works well on the campus, and we never faced any major issues. Other facilities like the food, library, and sports area are available where students can enjoy the experience.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The campus is good. The hostel facility is provided by the college. The college has a game room and a library. The food and coffee served in the canteen are good. The location is good in the city and easily reachable.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Soil Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: There is a good infrastructure and the best hostel. There are amenities like Wi-Fi, 24x7 power backup and kitchen facilities for all students. Moreover, students can cook their own food, and all amenities are available for the kitchen and other services. There are medical facilities with best-class doctors.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, good placement, good infrastructure, best faculty, diverse crowd.
reviews.review_text: College is located at a very prime location in Gurgaon which is very close to Huda city center. Infrastructure is very elite and all the classrooms are designed in a very modern way. Library is very well-equipped. There is also a hostel facility available by college 2 kms from the campus.

reviews.review_heading: This is a perfect place for aspirants with 2 or more years of work experience.
reviews.review_text: The state-of-the-art facility is good, and it has been very efficient even in conducting HYBRID classes as all students are not able to join the live sessions. The hostel is available also students have to get into private PGs or rented flats.

reviews.review_heading: It has amazing faculty members and curriculum, but placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average with just bare minimum requirements. I never stayed in the hostel, so I can't say anything about that. Food quality is good in our college canteen. Sports and games keep on happening, but the curriculum is very hectic that you won't get time for that.

reviews.review_heading: Place where Learning is mail objective.
reviews.review_text: SOIL is located near Huda city metro station. It provides free Wi-Fi. Library of SOIL provides not only books but also give us journals and CMIE data is also provided to us. Girls and boys have separate hostel and provides Wi-Fi. Also,  24*7 there is a helper in both hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the way I performed (I don't believe in blame game).
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is in campus. Students enrolled will be provided with the Id Password to get connected. We don't have labs. There are classrooms dedicated to specializations but in 1st term since most of the subjects are same across specializations so classes are conducted in the Auditorium pertaining to the class strength. We do have a library. We also have tied up with MDI Library for students to take advantage of. Basic Medical Facilities are there on campus. Whereas every single student is medically i...

reviews.review_heading: A good place if you want to learn with excellent faculty members and one of the best curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Good. For a small batch size of approximately 150 students the building provide ample smace and amenities. Wi-Fi is painful though. Building is modern. Cafeteria is where you get free lunch daily. Nothing else much left. No restaurants or cafes there. Classrooms are big and spacious. Auditorium is good.

reviews.review_heading: A place where you can grow personally and professionally.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also good. The boardroom class structure with glass walls. Even for other cohorts, there is a circular loop structure with projector classrooms and high-speed internet connectivity. The books which you can find in the library are of great authors and nice place to get more explored. The lunch at canteen is included in the fee. It is also quite good compared to other places. The hostel is well furnished and has A/C rooms. Coming to the extracurricular activities, there are s...

reviews.review_heading: Great institute for 1 year MBA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is nice and located in the corporate hub of Gurgaon. Wi-Fi with a great speed is available. The library is quite rich and the college has provided a space for various indoor games like pools, table tennis. The current campus is small but they are soon going to start a new campus in Manesar, Gurugram.

reviews.review_heading: A school which not only teaches you academics.
reviews.review_text: Given the location where it is located, it is good. It is not very big campus but all the facilities that are required in a campus are available. Currently, there is no hostel facility but they have tie-ups with PG and home stays. The food available in the canteen is pure vegetarian and it is pretty good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best campus in Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The campus building is designed to be in balance with nature, featuring natural lighting in all rooms, lecture halls, an auditorium, a rainwater harvesting system, and energy-saving equipment. The hostel provides all the facilities. They are good. The hostel has spacious rooms. The campus is for first-year MBA students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with infrastructure and best campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good infrastructure. We have an updated library system that has all the study materials. Labs are well equipped with the latest system software. Wi-Fi is available on the campus and is fast. There is a canteen nearby where you can relax with your friends.

reviews.review_heading: Highly satisfied with the overall well managed system.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a library which is available online as well as offline where the students can access the library from any corner of the globe. Classrooms for each stream are available and all the classrooms have centralised air conditioning systems with Wi-Fi to. As of now are college do not have its own hostel but it supports the students in getting rooms or PG facilities. Our college has a canteen committee in place which look of after all the aspects of canteen including hygiene, its menu and...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, bad placements and average faculty.
reviews.review_text: The library here is very extensive with many books to pass the exams. The canteen is not that great, and it is better to avoid. However, it is spacious, but the food provided is average. There is good Wi-Fi facility in the college. There are good labs facilities in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Great College, Faculty and placement.
reviews.review_text: Basic facility is there is college. Wi-Fi, Labs, Library, Canteen, Cafeteria, Basketball court, Auditorium, parking space. Quality of food in canteen is good and the prices are not that high. No college hostel is there. But there are few good private hostels near by.

reviews.review_heading: It is a really good college with qualified faculty and industry touchpoints.
reviews.review_text: We had Wi-Fi, computer lab, indoor games room, gymnasium, amphitheatre, etc. Our college did not have hostel facilities on our campus. However, references were provided by the college for the purpose of paying guest homes. The canteen food was hygienic and affordable. No major emphasis was placed on sports in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college overall in a similar tier.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned and are pretty comfortable. There are free Wi-Fi facility and computer labs, and the library also has all the required books. There is no hostel facility, and the quality of food and prices in the canteen are good. There are good affordable restaurants nearby.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides very supportive professors.
reviews.review_text: The college is located in Nerul. It is just 20 minutes walking from the railway station. The entire campus is enabled with free Wi-Fi facility. Even online and offline library facilities are provided by the college. There are two canteens; one is a cafe and the other one is the main canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, great faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Situated in the heart of navi Mumbai-nerul. This college is best known for management studies. Free Wi-Fi is provided throughout the campus. Also there is a full digitalized library. Two canteens are available in the management building. There aren't any hostel services provided by the college but you can find PGs outside.

reviews.review_heading: College is worth the money.
reviews.review_text: Situated just 10 min. from Nerul station. This college is known for management and technology students. Classrooms are centralized AC and IT labs are situated on every floor of the college. There are two canteens one is Nescafe and the other is a bigger canteen.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: There are many buildings in our college, one of which is specifically for management students. It is a four-storeyed building. Wi-Fi service is available throughout the campus. Even there is an auditorium on each floor. The main auditorium is on the ground floor.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is enabled with free Wi-Fi facility. The learning techniques used is E-learning. Moreover, lots of presentations and projects are done in our college. Many extracurricular activities are also conducted by the college. The library is fully digitalised and well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: The college is value for money in placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is decent, but not exceptional. It could have been a little big, but as it is situated in Navi Mumbai, there is a lack of space in this city. All the necessary things are available for teaching and practicals. All other daily needs are also provided, and the campus is pretty clean.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides the best platform to learn many skills.
reviews.review_text: SIES College has very good infrastructure with a library and sports facilities. Many events are also organised for students, and the college also has two canteens. The canteen provides good food at reasonable rates. The college doesn't have any hostels, but there are PGs available near our college for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for MBA. Worth the money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great. Facilities like Wi-Fi connection, well-equipped labs, library, medical facility, etc., are nice. The quality of the food served is quite good. The college doesn't provide hostel facility. Quality of labs and classrooms is good, and they are equipped with air-conditioners.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good in each and every term. Good in every aspect.
reviews.review_text: Almost all facilities are available like Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, library, sports, games etc. Almost everything is available in the campus. The quality of the labs is too good and even the classrooms are air conditioned and digitilised. The food quality is good to eat and also the college provides 2 canteens. Hostel facility is not available but there are many PG'S and rented rooms available nearby. No as such not any issues are faced in terms of infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The college is located in Rajagiri Valley.
reviews.review_text: This college is located in Rajagiri Valley, which has a beautiful and peaceful ambience for studying. This is also one of the major reasons why most students choose this college for higher education. It is accredited by AICTE and affiliated with Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam.

reviews.review_heading: The best institute for M.A-HRM.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled and has AV rooms, classrooms with projector and a large computer lab with adequate computers and printers. There are two libraries that contain a wide variety of academic and non-academic books. The hostel has above-average rooms and dining rooms. The clinic is always visited three times a week by a nursing assistant and a doctor. Our college is very active in the football and cricket fields. Volleyball, badminton, basketball courts and a gym are also available...

reviews.review_heading: Our college helped me to identify many of my fears and also helped me to overcome them.
reviews.review_text: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and there are AV rooms, classrooms with projectors and a huge computer lab with ample computers and printers. In the hostel, there are above average rooms and canteen. A clinic is always available with a nursing assistant, and a doctor visits thrice every week. Our college has a huge ground with both football turf and cricket pitch. Volleyball, badminton and basketball courts and gym are also available here.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely wonderful experience with my college .
reviews.review_text: All kinds of infrastructure facilities for both academic and non academic. 2 Libraries,  5 seminar Halls, Cricket ground, Basketball court, Badminton court,  4 Hostel, Zoo, Rural camp to understand social sensibilities,  2 computer Lab, Incubation Center are available.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure, very good faculty members, good placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is excellent. College is located in a very vibrant location, optimum for students and education. Wi-Fi enabled classrooms, Labs and Library. Women's hostel is within the campus boundary and means hostel is located around 300 meters away from the college. Hostel facilities are good enough. Food is not satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. There are Wi-Fi, labs, air-conditioned classrooms, a library, etc. in college. Hostel facilities are average except for the food. They provide oily food which affects our health. Canteen is not available, and there is only one small shop for an emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, best B-School u can have in Kerala (after IIM) and best in south India.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure is top class with full campus Wi-Fi, lab, spacious classroom with AC and library facility (online and offline). And for hostel there are few single room available, then there is 2 and three sharing rooms with high-speed internet. And food provided is good. Value for money.

reviews.review_heading: Extremely satisfied on the college life and atmosphere they offer but can improve placements.
reviews.review_text: The college offers all the facilities when it comes to infrastructure, labs, the library, etc. The food offered in the hostel is questionable. I won't say it is bad. But sometimes cases like food poisoning has been reported. But even if someone faces any problem, they were soon taken to the hospital. Basketball court, football court and badminton court available.

reviews.review_heading: The college has the best infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very good and nice infrastructure, and the college is friendly-environment. Classrooms are neat and clean, and the Wi-Fi facility is available in college and hostel. There are two libraries with a wide variety of books. The college also has two computer labs. There is a separate hostel for boys and girls. The girls' hostel is very good, and the boys' hostel is not that good when compared to the girls' hostel. The food given here is good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is so good and relaxing. The classrooms are well equipped and library is vast and wide. The labs are having a facility of  accommodating more than 100 student at the same time. The hostel facilities are so good and the food that is offered in the canteen is of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good faculty members and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, neat and in good condition. Wi-Fi facilities are available, and each building has separate computer labs which can accommodate at least 90 people at a time. The hostel is good. The food is very delicious, and it's better than any hostel foods. You also get tea and snacks at 4 pm every day. So overall everything is good.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty, outstanding placements and marvellous infrastructure facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure facilities. The classrooms and the various labs are well-equipped. The faculty is also one of the best in the country right now. The college has got excellent canteen facilities. The college also provided facilities for sports like cricket, basketball and even gym facilities.

admission_overview.college_name: Welingkar Bangalore Course Admission 2025 (Open): Eligibility, Application Process, Last Date

paragraphs: Welingkar Bangalore Admission 2025 is open for the full-time Postgraduate Diploma in Management (PGDM). Admission to Welingkar Bangalore's full-time PGDM programme is based on national-level entrance exams such as CAT, XAT, CMAT, ATMA, GMAT, etc. Further, candidates are shortlisted based on their profile and percentile in the entrance exams. Welingkar Bangalore offers a vast range of PGDM and executive MDP courses to students in the field of Management. PGDM is the flagship programme ofWelingkar Institute of Management Development and Research (WeSchool), Bangalore. Check out the table below for admission highlights of Welingkar Bangalore:
Particulars

Mode of study
Full-Time/ Part-Time

5+ courses across multiple specialisations

Popular programmes

Admission to the flagship course is based on a valid score obtained by the candidates in national-level entrance exams along with other selection rounds. Admission to all the courses offered Welingkar Bangalore is subject to merit in the entrance exam, selection rounds, and past academics. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection criteria for all WE School programmes:
Bachelor's degree with a minimum 50% aggregate from a recognised University
Academic Perfromamce + Work Expirence + Group Activity + PI +

The admission process for Welingkar Bangalore is done in two phases, i.e., phase 1 and phase 2. Phase 1 includes Profile Calls, which are not relevant in Phase 2. Therefore, aspirants with a strong academic profile (60% or above) should consider this an advantage for cracking a GDPI Call. These candidates can be CAT, XAT, CMAT, ATMA, or GMAT takers. Any pending scores can be updated later. The Welingkar Bangalore admission process is a multi-step process inclusive of application, appearance in the selection rounds, offline admission process, and document verification. A step-by-step process that students need to follow is as follows:
STEP 1: Welingkar Bangalore Application Process 2025

The application process for all programmes at Welingkar Bangalore is done online. Candidates can fill out the Welingkar Bangalore application form 2025 on the official website for the respective course accepting exam as given above. The registration fee for all programmes varies as per the counselling bodies & official website of Welingkar Bangalore for short-term courses. The application process includes multiple steps.
Step 2: Welingkar Bangalore Selection Process 2025

Candidates are shortlisted based on their profile and percentile in the entrance exams. Shortlisted candidates are further required to appear for the group and personal interviews as per the respective course.
Step 3: Merit list
Welingkar Bangalore makes admission offers to applicants who make the merit list after calculating total composite score merit for each applicant based on all selection criteria.
Step 4: Welingkar Bangalore Document Verification & Payment of Admission Fee

Candidates who are shortlisted based on merit lists must submit the specified admission fee for their respective courses. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theWelingkar Bangalore feeto confirm their seats at the institute.

reviews.review_heading: True colour of Welingkar.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is small and no play area or sports area in this college. Classrooms are good and spacious. AC is also available. Hostel is great and flats are provided with 2&3 bhk with all furniture. There are no AC, geyser, iron board, beds, sofa, tv, dining table, fridge, microwave oven, or cloth dryer.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers good placements, faculty, and infrastructure , but fees are dissatisfied.
reviews.review_text: I think the building is very small. college should be bigger and it does not have a ground. There should be at least one ground. But, Wi-Fi, library, and classroom facilities are very good. Talking about the hostel, I don't like the canteen food, but aside from the food, everything else is quite good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with college.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned and have Wi-Fi. There are also a library and a lab for business design domain students with a dedicated coach. It also has lots of activities and campaigns which encourage lots of creative and innovative solutions to challenge real-world problems.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent placements. Students are given an insight of industry via industrial visits
reviews.review_text: Library and classrooms are good, Wi-Fi is also provided, some indoor games are also present, canteen facility is there. The hostel is a service apartment and all the amenities are present, including gym, sports, canteen, cleanliness is taken care.

reviews.review_heading: Ample opportunities for placements. Good industry exposure
reviews.review_text: You will get all the required amenities here. Food is far better compared to college canteen. Daily cleaning is done by the stanza staff. You will get a card in which you will get a balance of 2750 at the starting of each month. Breakfast is provided every morning by hostel. You will have to get used to idlis and dosa.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placement scenario.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in college available are Wi-Fi, IT labs, Air Conditioned Classrooms, Library, Auditorium, lack of proper medical facilities and sports ground Facilities in hostel includes Wi-Fi. Quality of food is not good, no proper medical facilities, badminton court is available.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the college faculty.
reviews.review_text: We have bloomberg terminal, Well stocked library, modern infrastructure and a good canteen facility. The hostel is really good with all basic amenities like TV, laundry, play area, a good canteen, house keeping 24*7 We have place to play badminton, foosball, also have gym facilities, dance classes etc.

reviews.review_heading: Quite satisfied with the placements and happy with the knowledge I had gained from my faculties.
reviews.review_text:
1. Wi-Fi, behavioural lab, computer lab, library etc. 
2. The quality of food is good along with good medical facilities. The canteen keeps all kind of food from drinks, wafers to eggs. The food is available for both vegetarians as well as non-vegetarians. The food is cooked separately for vegetarians and non vegetarians.

reviews.review_heading: College is good in terms of teaching and placements are good as well.
reviews.review_text:
1. The infrastructure is good though the area is small, All classes are having centralized AC's. IT lab, prototype lab is present in call, college has an inhouse canteen facility a small backyard as well. 
2. The hostel is a service apartment so all the facilities like Gym, carrom, chess, snooker, T. T, Badminton are available along with one cafeteria and one mess.

reviews.review_heading: Its a place filled with opportunities and competition but make sure you grab the right one!
reviews.review_text:
The infra of the college is very good and equipped with state of art tech.
Hostel is a service apartment and takes care of all the needs.
The food has been proved since stanza has taken over. 
Though the timings are quite restricted but still its a good place to stay and almost all the students stay here so its better for getting work done.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the faculty, but placements should be improved.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good facilities. It has brainstorming rooms, a library, and a creative lab for a prototype in case we have an idea. We even have Bloomberg subscription, and the best part is we have subscribed magazines. Hostel facilities are good here, and all other facilities are also available here.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the course, but everything should be student-driven.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides very good labs, library and mainly access to different kinds of magazines subscription. They also have Bloomberg access for data. There is also a creativity lab for the creation of prototypes to our ideas. The hostel facility is good, and as it is a third-party service, their maintenance is very good. Food quality can be improved. For sports, it has its own limitations, like only indoor games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members in our college are best and knowledgeable.
reviews.review_text: Facilities offered by Welingkar include 24x7 Wi-Fi facility, breakfast and dinner, library, computers, cleaning facility. Twin sharing hostel is available about 3 km away from the college. There is a bus facility for pick and drop from college to hostel and vice versa for convenience.

reviews.review_heading: I am really happy to be a part of WeSchool.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided by the college are very good. Breakfast and lunch are provided here. We have good washrooms and good water facility for drinking. The infrastructure of the college is also very pleasant. We have big enough classrooms. The entire campus is centralised air-conditioned. Separate library and board room are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good decent college level.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure facilities are good. Library with a wide variety of books are available. Wi-Fi is not provided though. Classrooms with projectors, AC and reading rooms are also provided. In hostel Wi-Fi, washing and iroing clothes, room cleaning service, TV, are provided. Food is not that good.

hostel.description: The hostel has fully furnished rooms with attached bathrooms (2-seater and 3-seater), canteen, large dining hall furnished to accommodate 32 diners at a time, kitchen, common living area fitted with LCD TV, terrace, microwave ovens, refrigerator, water coolers and purifiers, ironing table, irons, recreational facilities like carom etc. and professional round the clock security services.

library.description: The library of Indian Institute of Social Welfare and Business Management has a total collection of about 53765 books. It has a central library which subscribes around 84 national and international journal. Central Library has the open-access facility for the members. It provides lending, reprographic and bibliographic and other services to the students, faculty and other scholars. The books in the Library are arranged according to the DDC numbers mainly on specialized subjects on management, Social Welfare, Industrial safety, Transport, Environment, Energy, Health Services, Economics, Mercantile and Labour Law, Bio-Informatics, Sports and Intellectual property etc. It subscribes the good number of foreign as well as Indian periodicals and journals. It also has e-journal and e-books for the benefit of the users.

reviews.review_heading: Best infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Luxury rooms were available; 1, 2, 3, and 4-seater rooms with CCTV footage. Wi-Fi was also provided with speeds up to 40 Mbps. Mess food is disappointing. Sports activities and a gym are also provided. Medical facilities are available 24/7, and there is a hospital at the main gate.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the hostel, campus and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the whole university is fabulous. Hostel food is also good they provide and maintain cleanliness. It is also widely appreciated for its modern and well planned infrastructure. SMART classrooms, well stocked libraries, advanced laboratories and innovation and research centres that help student work in competitions. It actually offers a well rounded environment.

reviews.review_heading: Chitkara University – BBA review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in the classes is great, with fully air-conditioned rooms and smart TVs in each class. But the mess food is just the worst food ever, with cheap quality items being used, such as Delicious in place of Amul butter. Also, hygiene is not being met as per the money they take from us.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college and college placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course and hostel is very good and well maintained. The hostel has spacious rooms. The mess is neat, clean, and healthy. Greenery is available everywhere, and sweepers do cleaning every day. Sports clubs are provided to every student according to their talent.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college, and all faculty members are good, and the campus is the best.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities and infrastructure are very good and nice, and all the things are available. The quality of the hostel is, on average, good, but all the things are available. The quality of food in the mess is okay, but all the other options for eating, like in Square 1, are the best.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, online exams, good sports events, but just not worth that much money.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi works really well. There are libraries for every department. Hostel food is not so good, but the arrangements for B.Ed study tables and everything are there. Also, there is a facility for washing clothes, so that's a bonus. Permission things while going out might be helpful for parents.

reviews.review_heading: The college is a little bit expensive.
reviews.review_text: You can visit anytime with your queries. Hostels are comparable to other universities, and the food is eatable. Medical facilities and sports are available and quite good. Free Wi-Fi is provided. Classrooms are air-conditioned and feel luxurious.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and open environment.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is good as well so many a variety of rooms like 4 seater, 3 seater, and 2 seater with AC non AC rooms so it's good. Students can make flexible changes, mess food is also flexible you get so many options. In food as well, overall college infrastructure is good and environment is open, sports tournaments are also conducted.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members, a supportive environment, and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus has good Wi-Fi, clean classrooms, and a decent library. Hostels are well-maintained, and the mess food is average. Sports and medical facilities are available. The library has a decent selection of books and digital resources. The campus is very elegant.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with amazing placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. It provides clean drinking water, good Wi-Fi, spacious labs, and classrooms. The library is also good. The hostel is good. Overall, the rooms are good as well. The food is average, and medical facilities are good. Sports and games do happen. There is a gym as well.

reviews.review_heading: It is the worst college. I am dissatisfied, and it is not recommended.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and the library are good. The hostel food is the worst. There are 4 congested beds in a room. The infrastructure is not that great. We found insects in the hostel food. Every activity, function, and DJ night is there for hostel students and not for any other day scholar students, which is the worst.

reviews.review_heading: Our university is the best compared to others.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our university include a large playground, indoor and outdoor games, clean classrooms, drinking water facilities, lift facilities, Wi-Fi facilities, and a library. Canteen food is good but costly. The hostel facilities are also good. Electricity, water, gym, and food in the mess are sometimes good

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities are also fine.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this department is beautiful and fully developed. Classrooms are well-built and have AC. When it comes to libraries, they have different libraries for different disciplines, like engineering students have their own library in their building. Business students have their library in their building, and students are only allowed to enter their respective libraries. The library of business school has numerous books, but when it comes to the subjects related to data science, esp...

reviews.review_heading: This university provides knowledge with fun.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are so well-maintained and fully equipped with furniture, AC, projector, powerpoints, beautiful view, ventilation, and washrooms are clean. Hostel facilities are good. Food is amazing and buses are so comfortable. It also provides adequate medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: My college is great in terms of infrastructure and the type of quality food we get.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is marvellous. I am a day scholar, so I don't know the condition of the mess or hostel. It is average. Sports and games facilities are hygienic and quite nice with a bunch of co-curricular activities and clubs to join.

Shoolini University has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for Shoolini University indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. It has been seen that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Shoolini University climbed 1 rank to #69 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 9 ranks to #101 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.

reviews.review_heading: A place to relax and win in life.
reviews.review_text: It has a very beautiful campus, no honking, no noise, it's all greenery, and peaceful with amazing place to sit and relax. Our hostel is so clean with amazing people working to keep it peaceful, with different events like marathon and yoga sessions in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: The university location is great and peaceful.
reviews.review_text: In our college, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and library are available. Top-notch classrooms, electricity, a purified water project, and research labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The quality of food is nice, and a medical facility is available 24 hours a day at the nearby hospital. Sports and games are average.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, updated curriculum, and more. Come if a remote location is not a problem.
reviews.review_text: The library is pretty big and useful, with a huge set of books. Wi-Fi is amazing (hostel excluded). You'll find exceptions even on roads while you are walking on campus. Classrooms & labs for this course in the AI building are unarguably one of the best in the country, not exaggerating. Hostel rooms are comparable to the ones from dorms of international universities, with the option of attached washrooms too. Even common washrooms are clean all the time as they're thoroughly cleaned several time...

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, always willing to help beyond expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed with spacious classrooms, projectors and access to labs with updated equipment. The hostel is clean and secure offering basic amenities like Wi-Fi and laundry though food quality can improve.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college and satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is quite good. It provides well-furnished smart classes with projectors. Different labs according to subjects are provided with the necessary chemicals and equipment. The different equipment is provided for good knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: This university is good for your overall development.
reviews.review_text: The college has modern infrastructure, and the hostels provide very good services, especially in my hostel, for village students. The boys' hostel is located off the campus, and the girls' hostel is on the campus. There is 24 hour Wi-Fi service available. The labs are good, and there is an Apple lab in the AI block.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and my college offers a great.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed, with spacious classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs that support practical learning. The department also has access to a good library with relevant reference materials and digital resources. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and regular maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: It has great labs for research and a peaceful campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped with different facilities. For food technology students, there are advanced labs for research. The university itself carries many patients which helps a lot in research programs. It has modern classrooms with Wi-Fi ensuring a seamless learning experience. The hostel is good here. There is an indoor cafe built in girls' hostel. It has different games and modernized infrastructure which make it feel like our second home.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available are good. The washrooms are clean, classrooms are clean and spacious, and there is good Wi-Fi connectivity. The library is also amazing, open 24/7, 365 days a year, which is the best part. The hostel is also good, with good rooms, good food, and medical facilities available.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus and reliable faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very bad. Labs are not that bad. Quality of food is okay-okay. Some of the classrooms are very well-facilitated, and some are good ones. Good medical facilities are available. From time to time, game matches are held, and there is a sports complex with a gym also included in it.

reviews.review_heading: Strong digital marketing program with great placement and scenic campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our department has smart classrooms and high-speed Wi-Fi. The infrastructure is modern and well-maintained. Hostel is clean. The mess food is decent with a mix of dishes, and the mess offered good snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports like basketball, volleyball, badminton, and gym are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: The environment and atmosphere here are really good.
reviews.review_text: Well, I would say that the facilities are fairly good and good Wi-Fi speed, and libraries (study rooms) are there. Overall the facilities are good and the hostel is near campus. It is a very big advantage for me at the very least. Also, there are proper labs in my department.

reviews.review_heading: After so many days of worrying, I finally found my fit.
reviews.review_text: My department is very well equipped with laboratories which are really important for my course. Hostel facilities are at par, especially with the dead stories that I have heard from my older cousins. The hostel has been a relief. Moreover, they do listen. Feedback is taken often and acted upon.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the university for now.
reviews.review_text: They have high-speed Wi-Fi everywhere but in the AI block they have a speed of around 200 Mbps. The food is average and their cleanliness is maintained throughout the university. All the equipment is present in the labs and maintained by the university.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, they do provide placements, and everything is amazing.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. I didn't opt for a hostel, so I don't know about it. There are clean washrooms, a 24/7 library, and good Wi-Fi. The classrooms are clean, and the food is average. Medical facilities are available, which are good. There are sports and games, a stadium, a basketball court, and a gym to stay fit.
